John and Tim have talked across ten sessions, from the evening of 21 May 2023 to the evening of 31 August 2023. John is a basketball shooting guard who recently signed with the Minnesota Wolves, a new team. His stated goal is to improve his shooting percentage, and his main ambition is to win a championship. On 15 June he said he was exploring endorsements with Nike and Under Armour and promised to keep Tim updated. On 16 July he reported a 40-point game, his highest ever, followed by a team win and a restaurant celebration, and he described teammates who share his passion as a second family. In the same session he announced a signed shoe and gear deal with Nike, crediting his industry contacts, marketing skills, and networking. Gatorade talks were still in progress, he still hoped to work with Under Armour, and he shared a Seattle skyline photo, saying he had a game there in August.

On 2 August John congratulated Tim on a milestone and described a charity Harry Potter trivia contest he joined with a friend, Anthony. He said he was reading an inspiring book about dreaming and reaching for new goals. On 9 August his team won a very intense game by a tight score, and he scored the last basket, calling the team a family away from home. On 11 August he returned from a Chicago trip with great energy and friendly locals. He shared a photo of his lucky basketball shoes, which symbolize resilience, and described his father taking him to NBA games, signing him up for a local league at ten, earning a college scholarship, and being drafted as a dream come true. He wants to help disadvantaged kids through a local organization that combines sports and school. On 17 August he said he had rejoined his teammates on 15 August, that everyone had missed him, and that the atmosphere was electric. He asked Tim whether he had ever truly belonged somewhere. On 21 August he settled on a routine mixing basketball work with strength training, which he credited with better shooting accuracy, agility, and speed. On 26 August he said he had visited home, caught up with family and old friends, and shared a photo of a girls' team he had played with for four years in high school. His account of his background has shifted over time. Earlier he described an NBA-linked path, while later he spoke only of high school teammates without revisiting those details.

Tim's interests have stayed centered on Harry Potter, fantasy novels, and the escape they provide. In the first session he was working on a Harry Potter fan project and described a London place that felt like a film set, and he hopes to visit more real Harry Potter locations. In June he joined a fantasy literature forum and found a chance to write articles about fantasy novels for an online magazine. He names Harry Potter and Game of Thrones as his favorite series to write about. In July he described a magical chat with a Harry Potter fan in California, and in August they skyped and discussed possibly collaborating, which remains open. He recommended "The Name of the Wind," and John said he was adding it to his list. He hoped to attend a book conference in September, but whether he went is unknown. On 21 August he said he was focusing on school, fantasy reading, and piano, and that his favorite piece to play is the theme from "Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone." John said he owns the whole Harry Potter collection. Tim also described a family Thanksgiving, where everyone shares what they are thankful for and watches "Home Alone," "Elf," and "The Santa Clause," and he shared a Harry Potter-themed Christmas tree he had decorated. On 26 August he said exams and assignments were overwhelming, but he was not giving up. He has never been on a sports team, and he loves sinking into magical worlds, which is one reason he enjoys traveling to new places. He added New York City to his travel list, and John offered to help once he had dates. Tim has not yet given travel dates.

The session of 31 August opened with Tim saying it had been a few days since they last spoke. He had been turned down for a summer job he wanted, which he called not great, but he was staying positive. He asked whether John had run into trouble on his NYC trip and how he handled it. John said the trip went okay, though he struggled with the subway at first until someone explained it. Tim said that on 30 August he gave a presentation in class, his first new challenge of the week. He was nervous but got through it and called it a small step that still felt like progress. John encouraged him and said progress is progress. John then shared a photo of a bowl of soup with a spoon, with a butternut squash on a cutting board beside it. He said he had made it up on the spot, so he had no recipe, and that he seasoned it with sage. Tim said he loves experimenting with spices and would look up a recipe himself. Tim then said he is planning a trip to Universal Studios next month, his first visit, and he is super excited for the Harry Potter attractions. John said he has not been yet but has it on his bucket list. They agreed to catch up soon, and Tim promised to report back on the trip.

Both users have repeatedly encouraged each other's interests and dreams, and their conversations have grown more personal over time. Open threads for John include whether the Under Armour deal happened, whether the Gatorade talks concluded, whether the Seattle game took place, whether he finished the Rothfuss novel, and whether his community work has begun. Open threads for Tim include whether he attended his book conference, whether his collaboration with the California fan has moved forward, whether he has received other job opportunities after the summer job rejection, how his class presentation and Universal Studios trip went, and when he will travel to New York City, since that plan still has no dates.

Caroline and Melanie are friends who check in every few weeks, sharing photos and talking about mental health, self-care, identity, family, creative work, and the futures they are building. They celebrate each other's progress and encourage each other's goals. Seventeen sessions are recorded, from 8 May 2023 to 13 October 2023. The most recent session came after a longer gap than usual.

Caroline is a transgender woman who began transitioning about three years before June 2023. She moved from Sweden roughly four years earlier, around when her current friendships began. After a painful breakup, her friends and mentors helped her through, and she calls them her "rocks." Family is everything to her. She keeps a necklace from her grandmother in Sweden with a cross and a heart for love, faith, and strength. Her favorite book is "Becoming Nicole" by Amy Ellis Nutt. She loves horses, a love that began when she rode with her father as a child.

Caroline has long wanted to become a mother. In the second session (25 May) she said she had chosen an adoption agency that supports LGBTQ+ adoptive parents, and that she felt ready, though single parenthood will be hard. In July she was building a children's library for her future kids, and an adoption council meeting on 14 July made her more determined. Between 21 and 23 August she applied to adoption agencies, her first concrete step toward motherhood, and felt ready but a little nervous. In the seventeenth session she said she had just contacted her mentor for adoption advice and described wanting to share her love and provide a safe home for kids who need one. Whether any agency has accepted her application is not yet known.

Melanie has been married for about five years and has young kids. She works, looks after the family, and makes time for running, reading, violin, and painting, though in the fifteenth session she also said she plays clarinet, which conflicts with the violin she mentioned earlier. In July she said her mental health had improved. She signed up for a pottery class on 2 July, which she says feels like therapy, and on 24 August she shared a flower plate she made in class. Her favorite subjects are landscapes and still life. Her family life includes shared outings: camping in the mountains around 20 June, a museum trip on 5 July, a concert for her daughter's birthday on 13 August, and a recent camping trip with the kids, with hiking and roasting marshmallows. In the fourteenth session she recalled volunteering with her family at a homeless shelter.

In the seventeenth session Melanie raised adoption because a friend had adopted the previous year. She said the process was long but the family is now very happy, and that it made her wonder whether she should adopt too. Caroline offered to help if Melanie goes ahead and gave tips: research agencies or adoption lawyers, gather documents such as references, financial information, and medical checks, and prepare emotionally, since the waiting can be hard. Melanie said she would do that. Whether she has taken any concrete steps is not known. In the same session Melanie reported a setback. Last month she got hurt and had to take a break from pottery, which she uses for self-expression and peace. She said she is doing okay, has been keeping busy with a book Caroline recommended and with painting. Whether she has returned to pottery is not known.

Art remains a strong thread for both of them. Melanie shared a sunset painting with a pink sky from the previous week, which she said makes her feel calm, and an abstract painting on a blue background with peaceful streaks meant to show tranquility. Caroline said she has been trying abstract work, which feels freeing because she can put her feelings on canvas without much of a plan. Earlier, in the eleventh session, Caroline shared "Embracing Identity," a painting of a woman in a red shirt, and said art teaches her to accept the beauty of imperfections. In the thirteenth session she shared a self-portrait of a woman with a blue face, which made her feel liberated and empowered. In the sixteenth session she said her work's impact on the LGBTQ+ community inspires her. She has painted since about age 17. She announced an LGBTQ art show of her paintings for August 2023 on 17 July, and on 25 August she said she was putting it together "next month," which would mean September. Whether it has happened is not known.

Caroline's community work has grown steadily. In early June she gave a school talk about her transgender journey. She attended pride parades in late June, on 14 July, and around 11 August, where she felt she belonged and could be herself without fear. Around 10 July she attended an LGBTQ conference where she felt totally accepted. Around 15 or 16 July she joined a mentorship program for LGBTQ youth and began mentoring a transgender teen, and on 18 July she joined the activist group "Connected LGBTQ Activists." She has volunteered at an LGBTQ+ youth center and plans to continue, and she is helping organize a youth talent show for September. In the seventeenth session she described a transgender poetry reading she attended on Friday, 6 October, where trans people shared their stories in a safe, empowering room. It inspired her to draw a woman in a dress, which she said stands for freedom and being real, and a reminder to stay true to herself.

Caroline still meets hostility at times. On 17 August she described running into religious conservatives on a hike, whose remarks upset her and reminded her how much work remains for LGBTQ rights. In the fourteenth session she said a bad encounter on a hike the week before had bothered her a lot, and that she tried to apologize. The outcome is not recorded. Music is another outlet. In the fifteenth session she said playing helps her get her emotions out. She has played acoustic guitar for about five years, and "Brave" by Sara Bareilles is deeply significant to her because it is about courage and fighting for what is right. In the sixteenth session she said some close friends kept supporting her while a few could not handle her identity, and that her relationships now feel more genuine.

Some earlier exchanges remain open. In the thirteenth session Melanie shared a painting of a horse, which reminded Caroline of riding with her dad. In the twelfth session the two agreed in principle to a summer family outing or something special for just the two of them, but chose no date or format, and it has not been planned since. In the sixteenth session Melanie shared a photo of a café door sign saying someone was not able to leave. Caroline asked whether anything had happened, and Melanie said it was only a precaution. Caroline then said she was glad Melanie had a good time at the park, which seems to be a mix-up, since Melanie had mentioned the café.

Several threads remain open. Caroline plans to raise a child as a single parent, and her children's library may be tied to this, though she has not said so directly. Whether an agency has accepted her application is unknown. Melanie is considering adoption herself, but has not said whether she has begun. The art show and the talent show were both planned for September, and neither outcome is known. How the apology after the hike turned out, whether Melanie has returned to pottery, and whether the summer outing will be scheduled are also unknown. Both women see self-care, community, and family as central to how they want to live. Melanie affirms Caroline's path toward counseling, adoption, mentoring, volunteering, and art, and Caroline cheers on Melanie's running, pottery, painting, music, and family life. In the seventeenth session they closed on a shared note: Caroline said being yourself is an ongoing adventure of learning and growing, and Melanie agreed that life is about learning and exploring and that she is glad they are on this trip together.

The memory covers five conversations between Calvin and Dave in spring 2023, beginning with their first meeting on 23 March and ending with a fifth session on 3 May.

In the first session, at 11:53 am on 23 March 2023, Calvin and Dave met for the first time. Dave said things had been going well since they last talked and that he had recently attended a car event full of classic cars, where he spoke with owners and heard their stories. Calvin said he had just gone through a big life change and shared a photo of his new mansion, a building with a sign on its front. He framed the change around learning about Japanese culture and getting a chance to expand. Calvin has never been to Japan and is fascinated by its traditions. He planned to leave for Japan in April 2023. His agent found him a place to stay there, and he shared a photo of its cozy living room with a couch, table, and television. In Japan he planned to explore the city, try local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with local musicians. He would stay a few months and then travel to Boston. Dave had been spending a lot of time at a beautiful, calming park with a lake and a few boats, and he shared a photo of it. Calvin had never been there but said he would check it out when he returned. Dave offered more recommendations if Calvin needed them, and they ended by wishing each other well for the trip.

The second session took place at 4:45 pm on 26 March 2023. Calvin said it had been a few days since they last talked and announced that he had just bought a new car, a luxury car he described as a long-held dream come true. He called it smooth and powerful, said driving it made him feel like a rockstar, and said it was what he deserved after all his hard work. He shared a photo of a red sports car parked on the side of the road, taken the previous day (25 March) when he first took it for a ride. He did not name the car's make or model when Dave asked. Calvin also said he was on cloud nine. Dave reported that he was doing well and that the previous weekend (around 18 to 19 March) he had gone to a music festival in Boston, which he loved and which reminded him why he loves music. He shared a photo of a large crowd at a concert. Dave said his favorite band there was Aerosmith, whose performance he found incredible. He shared two photos: one of a concert stage with a large eagle, and one of two people on stage with guitars and a microphone. He said he had finally seen them live and that the singer was jamming to one of their hits. Dave said he did not get to hang out with the band after the show. When Dave asked about news in Calvin's life, Calvin said he had got a new ride, had written some new tunes, and had had several studio sessions the previous week. He said he was excited to collaborate and would share the music with everyone once it was ready. He promised to keep Dave updated on how the collaborations went, and the two signed off by wishing each other well and staying safe.

The third session took place at 4:15 pm on 20 April 2023. Calvin said it had been a long time since they had seen each other and reported that he had just been to a music festival in Tokyo, which he called awesome. He did not see any bands there, but he met many talented artists and industry people, and he found the experience enriching. He said he learned a lot and got valuable advice from professionals in the music industry. A producer told him to stay true to himself and sound unique, which got him thinking about where he wants his music to go. His long-term dream is to tour the world, performing for different people and connecting with them, and he hopes his music can reach a global audience and make an impact. He said he was looking forward to an upcoming trip to Boston after he finishes the Frank Ocean tour, and he had heard the music scene there is awesome. Dave responded enthusiastically and offered to show Calvin around Boston and its cool spots. He recommended Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park as places with a great music scene, and said he would be in the front row whenever Calvin performed onstage. Dave shared a photo of a city skyline with a boat in the water, which Calvin admired. Dave also said that the previous weekend (around 15 to 16 April) he had gone to a car show, where he found classic cars charming and admired the dedication people put into restoring them. This is why he is so into auto engineering. He shared a photo of a green Mustang parked in a field of grass. Calvin replied that the car looked great and shared a photo of a red sports car on display at a show, saying he had put a lot of work into it and could not wait to see more cars in Boston. This red car appears to be the same sports car Calvin bought in March, now shown at an event. When Dave asked whether Calvin had seen anything in Boston beyond the gigs, Calvin said not yet, because he had been busy with rehearsals and traveling, but he was looking forward to exploring the city, trying delicious food, and visiting popular attractions. He suggested they grab a bite together when he arrives, and Dave agreed to share his favorite spots in the city. The conversation ended with both expressing excitement about meeting in Boston and seeing each other soon.

The fourth session took place at 6:24 pm on 1 May 2023, and it was a longer, more upbeat exchange in which Dave shared big news about his career. He said it had been a long time since they last talked and announced that he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop, which he described as a dream come true and a spot to work on cars that he finds deeply satisfying. He shared a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it. Calvin congratulated him and shared a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage. Dave thanked him, said the shop had been his dream and that it took a lot of hard work, but that it was worth it. Calvin praised his guts and ambition and shared a photo of a book with a space theme on its cover. Dave said the shop is a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars, which he loves for their design and engineering. Calvin shared a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot and said that going for classic cars was cool. Dave said he is obsessed with classic cars because of their unique charm, and that last year he had been thrilled to restore one, which he called a labor of love that was challenging but worth it. He shared a photo of the restored car's engine, which has a small air filter. Calvin said it looked awesome, and the two exchanged a series of messages about how satisfying it is to see something you worked on come back to life and to see hard work pay off. Dave then shared a photo of his shop, a group of people standing in front of a car, and invited Calvin to come by if he could. Calvin said he would love to visit and asked what cars Dave works on. Dave said he works on all kinds of cars, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars, and that he finds it rewarding to see transformations and to know he is helping people keep their cars in good condition. Calvin encouraged him to keep up the great work. Calvin then shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant and called it stunning. When Dave asked where he got it, Calvin said it was a gift from another artist and a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician. The two closed by encouraging each other to keep pushing, with Calvin saying that they should keep each other motivated.

The fifth session took place at 1:16 pm on 3 May 2023. Dave opened by saying it had been a long time since they talked and announced that he was teaming up with a local garage, sharing a photo of a car being worked on in a garage. Calvin congratulated him, called the news inspiring, and shared a photo of a green car in a garage with a sign in the background. Dave said he was loving the job, getting to work with skilled mechanics and share his knowledge about cars. He shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage, describing it as a cool project that was a bit challenging. Calvin said the car looked awesome and encouraged him to keep up the good work. Dave said he planned to keep learning about auto engineering and hoped to build a custom car from scratch someday, which is his dream. For now he would keep working on the current project and assisting customers. Calvin called him inspiring and told him to relax and enjoy the process. Dave said he needed to take time to chill and asked whether Calvin had hobbies that helped him relax. Calvin said long drives in his red sports car, the one he shared a photo of, really helped him relax, because the wind and open road were freeing and cleared his head. Dave said driving with the wind in your hair was calming and that walking and exploring, taking in the sights and sounds, was a peaceful way for him to destress. Calvin agreed that embracing nature had been calming for him as well, and said he had been loving getting to know Japanese culture. He then admitted that he was stuck with his music, that his creativity felt frozen, and asked for tips. Dave suggested immersing himself in something he loves, such as concerts or favorite albums, which usually jumpstarts his inspiration, and recommended taking a break from music to explore other things and have some fun. Calvin said taking a break was great for getting his mojo back and that he would take the advice and explore. Dave encouraged him to keep pursuing music and never give up. The two agreed to stay in touch, said goodbye, and Calvin signed off with a thank-you.

Audrey said she had made blueberry muffins the week before and proposed a pastry party, which Andrew agreed to, saying her dogs would be welcome there too. Audrey shared a photo of a dog running with three other dogs and said her dogs mean the world to her. She got a tattoo on her arm of a dog and sunflowers, which represents her love for her dogs and nature's beauty, and shared a photo of herself walking her dogs in the woods. She said she has a strong bond with her dogs and wants to see their happy faces even when they are apart. Andrew said he is glad they bring her so much joy.

He shared a photo of a large crowd at a concert. Dave said his favorite band there was Aerosmith, whose performance he found incredible. He said he had finally seen them live and that the singer was jamming to one of their hits. Dave said he did not get to hang out with the band after the show. When Dave asked about news in Calvin's life, Calvin said he had got a new ride, had written some new tunes, and had had several studio sessions the previous week. He said he was excited to collaborate and would share the music with everyone once it was ready. He promised to keep Dave updated on how the collaborations went, and the two signed off by wishing each other well and staying safe.

The third session took place at 4:15 pm on 20 April 2023. Calvin said it had been a long time since they had seen each other and reported that he had just been to a music festival in Tokyo, which he called awesome. He did not see any bands there, but he met many talented artists and industry people, and he found the experience enriching. He said he learned a lot and got valuable advice from professionals in the music industry. A producer told him to stay true to himself and sound unique, which got him thinking about where he wants his music to go. His long-term dream is to tour the world, performing for different people and connecting with them, and he hopes his music can reach a global audience and make an impact. He said he was looking forward to an upcoming trip to Boston after he finishes the Frank Ocean tour, and he had heard the music scene there is awesome. Dave responded enthusiastically and offered to show Calvin around Boston and its cool spots. He recommended Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park as places with a great music scene, and said he would be in the front row whenever Calvin performed onstage. Dave shared a photo of a city skyline with a boat in the water, which Calvin admired. Dave also said that the previous weekend (around 15 to 16 April) he had gone to a car show, where he found classic cars charming and admired the dedication people put into restoring them. This is why he is so into auto engineering. He shared a photo of a green Mustang parked in a field of grass. Calvin replied that the car looked great and shared a photo of a red sports car on display at a show, saying he had put a lot of work into it and could not wait to see more cars in Boston. This red car appears to be the same sports car Calvin bought in March, now shown at an event. When Dave asked whether Calvin had seen anything in Boston beyond the gigs, Calvin said not yet, because he had been busy with rehearsals and traveling, but he was looking forward to exploring the city, trying delicious food, and visiting popular attractions. He suggested they grab a bite together when he arrives, and Dave agreed to share his favorite spots in the city. The conversation ended with both expressing excitement about meeting in Boston and seeing each other soon.

The fourth session took place at 6:24 pm on 1 May 2023, and it was a longer, more upbeat exchange in which Dave shared big news about his career. He said it had been a long time since they last talked and announced that he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop, which he described as a dream come true and a spot to work on cars that he finds deeply satisfying. He shared a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it. Calvin congratulated him and shared a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage. Dave thanked him, said the shop had been his dream and that it took a lot of hard work, but that it was worth it. Calvin praised his guts and ambition and shared a photo of a book with a space theme on its cover. Dave said the shop is a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars, which he loves for their design and engineering. Calvin shared a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot and said that going for classic cars was cool. Dave said he is obsessed with classic cars because of their unique charm, and that last year he had been thrilled to restore one, which he called a labor of love that was challenging but worth it. He shared a photo of the restored car's engine, which has a small air filter. Calvin said it looked awesome, and the two exchanged a series of messages about how satisfying it is to see something you worked on come back to life and to see hard work pay off. Dave then shared a photo of his shop, a group of people standing in front of a car, and invited Calvin to come by if he could. Calvin said he would love to visit and asked what cars Dave works on. Dave said he works on all kinds of cars, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars, and that he finds it rewarding to see transformations and to know he is helping people keep their cars in good condition. Calvin encouraged him to keep up the great work. Calvin then shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant and called it stunning. When Dave asked where he got it, Calvin said it was a gift from another artist and a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician. The two closed by encouraging each other to keep pushing, with Calvin saying that they should keep each other motivated.

The fifth session took place at 1:16 pm on 3 May 2023. Dave opened by saying it had been a long time since they talked and announced that he was teaming up with a local garage, sharing a photo of a car being worked on in a garage. Calvin congratulated him, called the news inspiring, and shared a photo of a green car in a garage with a sign in the background. Dave said he was loving the job, getting to work with skilled mechanics and share his knowledge about cars. He shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage, describing it as a cool project that was a bit challenging. Calvin said the car looked awesome and encouraged him to keep up the good work. Dave said he planned to keep learning about auto engineering and hoped to build a custom car from scratch someday, which is his dream. For now he would keep working on the current project and assisting customers. Calvin called him inspiring and told him to relax and enjoy the process. Dave said he needed to take time to chill and asked whether Calvin had hobbies that helped him relax. Calvin said long drives in his red sports car, the one he shared a photo of, really helped him relax, because the wind and open road were freeing and cleared his head. Dave said driving with the wind in your hair was calming and that walking and exploring, taking in the sights and sounds, was a peaceful way for him to destress. Calvin agreed that embracing nature had been calming for him as well, and said he had been loving getting to know Japanese culture. He then admitted that he was stuck with his music, that his creativity felt frozen, and asked for tips. Dave suggested immersing himself in something he loves, such as concerts or favorite albums, which usually jumpstarts his inspiration, and recommended taking a break from music to explore other things and have some fun. Calvin said taking a break was great for getting his mojo back and that he would take the advice and explore. Dave encouraged him to keep pursuing music and never give up. The two agreed to stay in touch, said goodbye, and Calvin signed off with a thank-you.

The sixth session took place at 11:50 am on 16 May 2023, and it was a more mixed exchange. Calvin opened by saying it had been a long time since they chatted and that a lot had happened. He reported that things had not been going smoothly: about a week earlier (around 9 May, "last week") his place had been flooded. He managed to save his music gear and his favorite microphone, and he said it had been tough but he was staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed. Dave sympathized, said he was glad the important gear was saved, and offered help. Calvin said he was waiting on insurance to kick in before starting repairs and hoped it would not take long. He shared a photo of his music studio, a room with a keyboard, a synthesizer, and other musical equipment, which he called his creative haven where he pours his heart into music. Dave said the studio looked awesome and hoped it would be fixed soon. Calvin asked Dave about exciting work, and Dave said he had opened his car shop "last week," invited friends over to celebrate, and found it amazing; he said he was stoked to share his passion and help folks with their rides. (This is a little inconsistent with the 1 May session, where Dave first announced the shop's opening.) Calvin congratulated him. Calvin then said he had an upcoming performance in Tokyo "this month" (May 2023) and hoped to show his music to a new crowd and expand his following. Dave wished him luck and asked to hear how it went, and Calvin promised to keep him posted. Calvin then shared a photo of a city at night full of lights, saying he took it in Tokyo "last night" (15 May) and that the skyline was stunning. Dave said the skyline looked great and that he hoped to visit Tokyo soon, and Calvin encouraged him to visit. Dave said he was adding it to his list.

John and Tim have talked across twelve sessions, from 21 May 2023 to 2 October 2023. John is a basketball shooting guard and sneaker collector, and Tim is a fantasy reader and Harry Potter fan who is also a student.

On 21 May 2023 (session 1, 7:48 pm), John and Tim first met. John had recently signed with the Minnesota Wolves, with his season opener set for around late May 2023. His main season goal was to improve his shooting percentage, and he said he had been practising hard toward it. His biggest pre-season challenge was fitting into the new team's style of play, but he said things were going well, the team had been very welcoming, and he was having fun. He collects sneakers and enjoys talking about his collection. He shared photos of basketball jerseys laid out on a bed, a basketball game in progress, two men beside a basketball machine, a locker room bench, a circle of shoes on a floor, and a bookcase full of books and toys. Tim is working on a Harry Potter fan project built around collaboration, covering characters, spells, and magical creatures, which he described as a way for fans to come together. The week before, he had talked through the ideas with a friend who is a big Harry Potter fan. He shared a photo of a table covered in books. A few years earlier he had visited a London location that felt like walking into a Harry Potter movie and had taken a tour there, which he found amazing. He would like to visit more real filming and related locations someday and offered John tips if John decides to go. John had not yet visited any real Harry Potter locations but said it was on his to-do list, and Tim encouraged him to add it.

On 15 June 2023 (session 2, 5:08 pm), Tim said that on 14 June he had joined a fantasy literature forum and had a great, enriching talk about his favourite books. John said he was exploring endorsement opportunities and that the possibilities excited him. Working with brands would be amazing, and seeing his hard work pay off felt rewarding. When Tim asked which brands, John said he was considering sports brands such as Nike and Under Armour, because sports-related collaborations appealed to him, though he was open to other brands that fit his values and interests. He promised to keep Tim updated on his choices, and Tim promised support. Tim shared a photo of his growing book collection, a bookshelf holding books and a picture from MinaLima, the studio that made the Harry Potter film props, whose work Tim loves. He said owning their pieces is like owning a piece of the wizarding world at home, and that his Harry Potter reminders help him escape reality. He said there is a definite chance he will visit more Harry Potter spots, and that it feels like stepping into the books. John shared a photo from a recent gym game in which he had played himself. He said being out there doing what he loves felt awesome and that he gives his all every time he is on the court. Tim praised the photo, asked whether John had been playing or watching, and told him not to give up on his dreams.

On 16 July 2023 (session 3, 4:21 pm), John said a lot had happened in the past month. The biggest moment was that the previous week he scored 40 points, his highest ever, and he felt his hard work was paying off. His team pulled off a tough win in that game, with an electric atmosphere. Afterward the players were exhausted but happy and celebrated at a restaurant, reliving the intense moments. John described his team as a second family, with teammates equally passionate about the game who push each other to be their best. On endorsements, John said he had talked to some big names and was getting somewhere. He credited his contacts in the basketball industry and his marketing skills, and said networking plays a big role in getting endorsements. He has now signed a basketball shoe and gear deal with Nike, and he is in talks with Gatorade about a potential sponsorship. He still admires Under Armour and said working with them would be really cool. He was headed to Seattle for a game there the following month, in August 2023. He called Seattle one of his favourite cities, praising its energy, diversity, awesome food, and passionate fans, and said trying local seafood is a must. Tim said he has always wanted to try Seattle seafood. John loves the ocean and had an awesome summer with friends surfing. He started surfing five years earlier and loves the connection to nature and the free feeling of being in the water. Tim does not surf, but said reading a great fantasy book helps him escape and feel free, and that it is bliss for him in a comfy spot, like being in another world. He shared photos of a Harry Potter-covered book and a living room with a brown couch and a white ottoman. John closed by saying he hoped everyone finds their own bliss.

On 2 August 2023 (session 4, 4:17 pm), Tim said he had started writing articles about fantasy novels for an online magazine, which he found very rewarding. He had found the opportunity on a fantasy literature forum, pitched his ideas, and the magazine liked them. His articles study characters and themes in fantasy novels and make book recommendations. His favourite subjects are Harry Potter and Game of Thrones, and he said he could chat about them forever. John congratulated him and said he remembered Tim talking about Harry Potter. John told a story about himself and a friend named Anthony, who went to a charity event and ended up in an intense Harry Potter trivia contest. They did alright, but one super-nerd won a prize, a signed book, which John shared a photo of (a book with a picture of a person holding a bookmark). Tim said the signature was sweet. John said he had been reading an inspiring book that reminds him to keep dreaming, and that he wants to keep reaching for new goals. Tim said books can help keep dreams alive and that he is in the same mindset. John wished Tim fun with his writing, and Tim said they should talk soon.

On 9 August 2023 (session 5, 10:29 am), Tim said it had been a long time and that he had been super busy. He had just had a Skype call with a Harry Potter fan he had met in California, which went very well. They talked about characters and possibly collaborating, and Tim said it was great to talk with someone who understands the fandom. John said a lot had happened. The previous week he had played a crazy, intense game that his team won by a tight score. He scored the final basket and said hearing the crowd cheer was awesome. He shared a photo of a basketball game in a large arena, and when Tim asked for other photos, John said it was the only one he had to share. The team was hyped afterward. John described the team bond as awesome and said it makes the hard work worth it. He called the team a family away from home, said they push each other to improve, and said he is thankful for them. Teammates encourage him when he is down, the support extends to other parts of life, and they spend a lot of time together outside basketball. Tim said having another family helps his home life and hobbies. John asked what Tim was reading. Tim said he was reading a fantasy book by Patrick Rothfuss that captivates him and transports him to another world. He praised the world-building and characters and recommended it. John said he would check it out and let Tim know what he thought once he finished it.

On 11 August 2023 (session 6, 1:08 pm), John apologised for missing Tim, saying it had been a crazy few days. He had taken a trip to a new place that was amazing, with energy he loved. Tim said he had recently attended a fantastic event, and that being with other fans was special. The trip was to Chicago, which John said was awesome, with a lot of energy and friendly locals. He said experiencing other cultures and connecting with new people is great. Asked whether he felt a real connection with other fans at a sports game, John said there is nothing like the energy in a stadium, with everyone cheering, chanting, and getting excited. Tim said he has been writing more articles, which lets him combine his love of reading with sharing great stories, and he shared a photo of a book opened to a page with a picture of a man. Tim recommended The Name of the Wind, a fantasy novel with a magician and musician protagonist, praising its world-building and character development, and shared a photo of three books on a wooden table. John said he loves fantasy with strong characters and cool world-building, and added the book to his reading list. John then shared a photo of a pair of sneakers in a box, calling them his lucky basketball shoes that have been with him through the good and bad, with every mark telling a story. He said the shoes have been with him since the beginning, through successes, failures, and friendships, and that they symbolise resilience, determination, and his love for the game. John explained how he got into basketball. As a kid he watched NBA games with his dad and dreamed of playing on those big courts. When he turned ten, his dad signed him up for a local league, and he has played ever since, through middle and high school, before earning a college scholarship. After college he was drafted by a team, which he called his dream come true. (This conflicts with the earlier account that he had recently signed with the Minnesota Wolves in May 2023; the conversation does not reconcile the two.) His number one goal is to win a championship. He also wants to make a difference off the court through charity and inspiration, because basketball has been good to him and he wants to give back. He is teaming up with a local organisation that helps disadvantaged kids with sports and school, and hopes to use his platform to have a positive impact on the community. Tim encouraged him throughout, and John said he would do his best.

On 17 August 2023 (session 7, 7:54 pm), John said that after his trip he met back up with his teammates on 15 August, and it was amazing. Everyone had missed him, the atmosphere was electric, and he felt very welcome back. He said he feels lucky to be part of this team. Tim said he was happy for him and described sharing passions and talents with others as like finding your true place in the world. John asked whether Tim had ever felt he truly belonged somewhere. Tim said yes, a few times, and that an event he attended in July 2023 was one of his favourites, because everyone shared the same love for it and it felt like being in a world where everyone understood it. John said it is great when you find a group that appreciates the same things. Tim said he has no big events coming up but hopes to attend a book conference next month, September 2023, a gathering of authors, publishers, and book lovers to talk about favourite novels and new releases. He is excited because he wants to learn more about literature and build a stronger bond with it. John joked that he is a real bookworm and said it would be awesome to go to a book conference with him. John shared a photo of a basketball with autographs on it, sitting on a table, which his teammates gave him when they met up. He described it as a sign of their friendship, the love they have for each other, and a reminder of their bond. Tim asked whether they signed it for a special reason, and John said they did it to show their friendship and appreciation. The ball reminds John why he started playing basketball and motivates him to stay strong and give his all. Tim said he would keep that kind of motivation in mind when he needs a push to reach his goals. John compared supportive people to a cheer team that helps you through tough times, and Tim agreed that having people cheer you on is a powerful source of strength. John said that support encourages him to give his all and never give up. Tim ended with a farewell.

On 21 August 2023 (session 8, 4:29 pm), John opened by saying it had been a long time since they talked and that crazy things had been going on in his life. A few days earlier he had found a new gym to keep his basketball game sharp. He said staying fit is essential to surviving pro ball, so he needed a place that fit the bill, and finding the right spot had been tough. He shared a photo of a gym with a basketball court and cones. He said the gym is awesome but he had to overcome the hurdle of adapting and tweaking his routine. Finding the right balance was tricky, but he eventually got the hang of it. Through trial and error he settled on a schedule that combines basketball work with strength training. Listening to his body and giving it enough rest made it easier to push himself in practice while still looking after himself. He shared a photo of a notebook with a list on it, which was his workout plan, and said it helps him stay on track. Asked why he includes strength training, John said it builds muscle, increases power, prevents injuries, makes him more explosive in games, and boosts his overall athleticism. He said it has changed the game for him, improving his shooting accuracy, agility, and speed, giving him an edge over opponents, and giving him the confidence to take on whatever comes his way. He said it has been a journey and he is happy with the progress, and asked how Tim had been.

Tim said things had been great. He has been focusing on school and reading a bunch of fantasy books, which is a nice break from stress. He has also started learning to play the piano, a learning curve he finds satisfying as he sees progress. John said learning piano is awesome and asked for favourite songs. Tim said his favourite to jam to is the theme from a movie he really enjoys, which brings back great memories. He named "Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone," the first film in the series, which he watched with his family. He said it was magical, and recalled that the family would get comfy with snacks and a blanket and be totally absorbed. John said he loves that first movie too and that he has the whole film collection. He shared a photo of a DVD cover with a castle in the background, and said it must have been a dream to watch it with family. Tim called it a dream come true and a special memory.

Turning to family, John said family time is great and that his family gets together all the time. He shared a photo of a group of people standing around a kitchen table. Tim said family time means a lot to him and shared a photo of his family sitting on a couch in front of a fireplace, from a special day when they all got together to eat, full of love and laughter. John asked about favourite Thanksgiving traditions. Tim said Thanksgiving is always special for them. They love prepping the feast, talking about what they are thankful for, and watching movies afterward. Among their Thanksgiving movies, they love "Home Alone," which always brings lots of laughs (Tim shared a DVD cover with a child in a house). They also watch "Elf" during the holidays, which makes them laugh and feel festive (Tim shared a DVD cover that he described as showing a leprechaun). They also love "The Santa Clause," which is heartwarming and gets the whole family feeling festive, and he shared its DVD cover. John called The Santa Clause a classic that captures the Christmas magic, and shared a photo of his family's Christmas tree from last year, covered in lights. Tim shared a photo of a Christmas tree he decorated himself with a Harry Potter theme, going all out, which he said was a blast and which turned out how he hoped. John said the themed tree looked amazing and that Tim really knows how to get the vibes right. The two said goodbye, with Tim saying talk soon and John saying he would talk soon and wishing Tim a good rest of the day.

On 26 August 2023 (session 9, 6:59 pm), Tim said this week had been really busy, with assignments and exams feeling overwhelming. He said he was not giving up and was trying to find a way to juggle studying with his fantasy reading hobby. He shared a photo of a stack of books on a table. John said he knew the stress of exams and homework, told Tim he had this, and said he was doing okay. The previous week John had visited home, where he caught up with his family and old friends and talked about their childhood, which he said reminded him of the good old times. He shared a photo of a group of girls basketball players posing for a picture. When Tim asked how long they had played together, John said they were teammates for four years in high school. John asked whether Tim had ever been part of a sports team. Tim said he had never been on one and is more into reading and fantasy novels, loving to sink into different magical worlds. He said that is one of the reasons he loves travelling to new places, to experience a different kind of magic. He shared a photo of a bookshelf with books and a clock. John called it an awesome book collection and said it is cool to escape to different worlds through a hobby. John said he loves discovering new cities and shared a photo of a cityscape with a view of a skyscraper from one of his trips to New York City. Tim said the skyline looked amazing and that he had been wanting to visit NYC, and asked how it was. John said it was amazing, that there is always something new and exciting everywhere you go, and that exploring the city and trying all the restaurants was awesome, calling it a must-visit. Tim said he was adding NYC to his travel list. John said NYC has so much to check out, including the culture and food, and that Tim would not regret it. Tim said he could not wait to experience it for himself. John said he wanted to hear when Tim was going and that he could help him out. Tim said he would let John know and thanked him for being so helpful. John said Tim could reach out any time he needed help, and Tim thanked him again, saying his support meant a lot, and said goodbye.

On 31 August 2023 (session 10, 2:52 pm), Tim opened by saying it had been a few days and that he had not got a summer job he wanted, which was not great, but he was staying positive. He asked John whether he had any troubles on his NYC trip and how he handled them. John said he was sorry about the job and that Tim's positivity would help him find something great. John said his trip went okay, and that he had some trouble figuring out the subway at first, but it became easy after someone helped explain it. He asked Tim whether he had tackled anything new lately. Tim said that the day before, on 30 August, he had given a presentation in class. He was nervous but made it through, and said it was a small step but felt like progress. John called it awesome work, said taking the plunge and presenting can be tough, and told Tim that progress is progress and to keep it up. John said he had been trying out cooking recipes and had recently made a tasty soup that was really good. He shared a photo of a bowl of soup with a spoon, next to a butternut squash on a cutting board. Tim asked how he made it and whether he had a recipe to share. John said he had mostly made it up on the spot, so he had no recipe. Tim said that was fine and that he could look some up, and asked which spices John used. John said he added some sage for flavour. Tim said he was excited to try it and loves experimenting with spices. Tim then asked whether John had been to Universal Studios, and said he was planning a trip there next month, in September 2023. John said he had not been yet but had heard great things, and that it was on his bucket list. Tim said this would be his first time going and that he was super stoked for the Harry Potter parts in particular. John said it would be a blast, like stepping into another world, and wished him a great time. Tim said he would let John know how it went. John asked Tim to have a safe trip and said he could not wait to hear about it. The two said goodbye, with John saying they should catch up soon, and Tim saying he could not wait to catch up and would talk soon.

On 21 September 2023 (session 11, 8:17 pm), John opened by saying it had been a while and that something cool had happened. The previous week (around 14 September 2023) he had gone to a local restaurant with some new teammates, and it was great getting to know them better. Tim said good support is essential and asked how John felt about them. John said they are great friends who connected over their shared love for basketball, and they had a ton of fun. John said the team is planning a team trip next month, October 2023, to explore a new city. He said he was still deciding on the destination and asked for suggestions. Tim suggested Edinburgh, Scotland, which he said would give a magical vibe, calling it the birthplace of Harry Potter with awesome history and architecture, and shared a photo of a city with a clock tower and a setting sun. John said he had not been to Edinburgh yet but that it sounded worth considering, and said he would reach out if he needed more suggestions. John shared a photo of a basketball on the ground with a hoop in the background, taken during one of the team's practices, saying the sunset on the court looked amazing and that such moments make him grateful for his career. Tim asked what he loved most about it. John said he loves playing pro ball because it is a constant challenge that keeps him growing, that there is nothing like seeing himself improve and hitting goals, and that playing with teammates and hearing the fans cheer gives him a great sense of satisfaction and purpose. Asked about specific targets, John said he is focusing on better shooting and making more of an impact on the court, wants to be known as a consistent performer who helps his team, and is looking into more endorsements and building his brand off the court, because he is thinking about life after basketball. He said he wants to use his platform to make a positive difference and inspire others, perhaps by starting a foundation and doing charity work, and wants to leave a meaningful legacy. Tim said he was sure John would succeed and asked whether there was anything he could do to help. John asked for advice on how to pick the right endorsements. Tim advised choosing endorsements that align with his values and brand, look for a company that shares his desire to make a change and help others, and make sure the endorsement feels authentic to his followers. He shared a photo of a stack of books on a counter. John asked for book recommendations for his trip, and Tim recommended a fantasy novel by Patrick Rothfuss (The Name of the Wind, shown by a cover with a man in a hooded jacket), saying it would take him to a different world and be great for travelling. John said he would check it out. He then shared a photo of his bookshelf with many books on it, and Tim noted he saw The Alchemist there, one of Tim's favourites. John said he had read it and loved it, that it made him think about life and the importance of following one's dreams, and he highly recommended it. The two said goodbye, with Tim wishing John a good time and saying they would talk soon.

On 2 October 2023 (session 12, 3:00 pm), Tim opened by saying it was awesome catching up and that a lot had changed since last time. He shared a photo of a bookcase filled with DVDs and games. John said a lot had been going on with him: he and his girlfriend had an amazing and emotional wedding ceremony the previous week, around late September 2023. He shared a photo of the ceremony in a greenhouse with people taking pictures. Tim congratulated him and asked how they had managed a ceremony during these times. John said they found a lovely greenhouse venue for a smaller, more intimate gathering, followed the necessary safety protocols, and made sure everyone felt safe, and that it was wonderful to have loved ones celebrate with them. John said he had never felt so much love and happiness, and that some of his hiking club friends came even though he had only just joined the club. Asked for favourite memories, John said picking one was tough, but seeing his bride walk down the aisle, her face lit up, got him choked up. He shared a photo of a bride walking down the aisle with her groom. Tim said he had seen a photo of them dancing, although John had not shared one in the conversation. John said their first dance took place at a cozy restaurant, dreamy with music and candlelight, and that they were lucky to have everyone with them. Tim said it sounded like a fairytale and that he was happy for John and his new wife. John thanked him and said Tim's friendship means a lot. Tim then said he wanted to share his bookshelf of favourite fantasy novels and posted a photo of a bookcase filled with DVDs and games (the same image he had shared at the start). Asked what he enjoys about these books, Tim said they fire up his imagination, take him to alternate realities, and are his escape from reality. John said books and movies make us escape to different places, and that he collects jerseys, sharing a photo of basketball jerseys laid on a bed. Asked for his favourite team and player, John said the Wolves are his team for sure and that LeBron is the man, whose skills and leadership he loves. He admires LeBron's work ethic and dedication to the game and shared a photo of a group of people standing on a basketball court. John said he has met LeBron a few times, found him very chill, and that it was a wild experience. He had also seen LeBron play live, which was tough but taught him a lot from watching a top player. Tim shared a photo of a crowd at a concert with hands in the air. John said the live game energy was crazy and that seeing top players was so motivating that it made him want to work even harder, and he shared a photo of a basketball game with a crowd watching. Tim said the crowd looked wild. John said such moments make him love his job, and Tim said it is great to find something you enjoy and encouraged him to keep going, then said goodbye.
