Maria and John reconnected in Session 1 on 17 December 2022 after a long gap. John said he had returned the day before, on 16 December 2022, from a family road trip. Maria said she had been volunteering at a homeless shelter and keeping fit, and that she had recently started aerial yoga, which she enjoys. John said he does kickboxing, which gives him a lot of energy, and Maria called it a good way to stay in shape and de-stress. John's main goal is to get into local politics because he loves helping the community. His two main focuses are improving education and infrastructure. His interest dates back to growing up, when he saw how a lack of education and crumbling infrastructure affected his neighborhood. He does not want future generations to face the same problems and believes schools and infrastructure should be funded properly. He shared a photo of a school from 2021 after it received funding, showing a group of men working on a building. He explained that the funding paid for repairs and renovations that made the school safer and more modern. His next step was to talk with local leaders and organizations to gain support and ideas. Maria asked him to keep her updated on the campaign, and he agreed.

In Session 2, on 22 December 2022 at 6:10 pm, Maria said it had been a few days since they last chatted. The day before, on 21 December 2022, she donated her old car to the homeless shelter where she volunteers. John said the campaign has been interesting and that he has been networking with people to get their input. He said he recently talked with someone who shared some amazing stories, which fired up his passion for improving education in their area. He stressed that investing in future generations, giving them the right tools for success, is the foundation of progress. Maria encouraged him, and he said her support motivates him. He then shared a photo of his family having a picnic in the park, and said they are the reason he never gives up and that their love gives him strength. They help him stay centered and remind him why he is passionate about making a positive impact. He called his family his rock in tough times, and said family time means a lot to him. He shared a photo of his family enjoying a playground swing and said they love climbing, sliding, and playing games together. Maria described her family as small but said she loves spending time with her friends, usually watching movies, hiking, and hosting game nights at her place, and that quality connections matter most to her. John shared a photo of his family gathered at a kitchen table for dinner and said shared meals help them stay close. He then shared a photo of a table with pizzas and salads, explaining that the family made pizza together and enjoyed picking toppings. Maria said she had recently made peach cobbler. The session ended with John saying he was off to do taekwondo, a new activity he mentioned in this session, separate from the kickboxing he described earlier. Maria said she would keep encouraging him, and both agreed to keep cherishing time with loved ones.

In Session 3, on 1 January 2023 at 8:30 pm, John said he had joined a service-focused online group the previous week, around late December 2022, and that it had been an emotional experience. He said the members have inspiring stories of their own, which have opened his eyes to new perspectives and given him a sense of connection and purpose. He shared a photo of a man sitting on a bed using a laptop, which appears to be a picture of someone in the group or of the online setting. Maria called the news amazing and praised the supportive community. John said the group shares a passion for serving and that members share stories, advice, and encouragement. Maria asked whether he had met any of them in person. John said the group had held events and met people in person. They went to a homeless shelter to hand out food and supplies, and he said seeing people's smiles showed them they had made a real difference. He shared a photo of a poster on a table with a Santa Claus, which fits the toy drive mentioned next. The group also organized a toy drive for children in need, and John said it was wonderful to see the community come together to spread joy. Maria asked about future projects. John said the group is brainstorming ways to help underserved communities gain access to education, mentorship, job training, and resume building, with the aim of empowering individuals to reach their aspirations. Maria said empowering people through education and mentorship is crucial, and John said he believes the right assistance and resources can make a lasting impact. Maria agreed that a bit of support can make an amazing change. John then revealed that he recently failed a military aptitude test, which has left him feeling stressed. He said Maria's support means a lot to him. Maria reassured him that she has his back and said that nature's beauty reminds her to slow down and enjoy small things. She shared a photo of a sunset over the ocean with a wave coming in, and said she took it at the beach the previous month, in December 2022. Watching the sunset made her feel connected to nature and grateful for life's small moments. John said the picture was chill and recalled the film camera he had as a child, with which he took plenty of beach pictures. He said nature helps people remember small joys, especially when life gets busy. He ended the session by sharing a photo of a group of people standing around a field, without further comment.

In Session 4, on 9 January 2023 at 7:06 pm, Maria opened by saying she had become friends with one of her fellow volunteers, and that they both love helping others. John said he had been busy with work and family, but that the previous week, roughly in the first week of January 2023, he had an unexpected incident on his way home, which reminded him how life can throw unexpected troubles at people. He shared a photo of a car with a broken windshield. Maria said she was glad he was alright. John then shared a photo of a tattoo with a quote, saying it reminds him to stay strong in tough times. He said he handled the incident by staying calm and asking for assistance, which helped him get back home safely. Maria praised his resilience and resourcefulness. John said he felt relieved and grateful to make it through without incident. Maria encouraged him to appreciate what he has. When she asked what he does to calm down in such times, John said he likes to look at the sunset, which reminds him to enjoy small things in life. Maria then asked about his political goals. John said he had been keeping busy by looking into local politics, talking to community leaders, and learning about the needs and hopes of his neighborhood. He found it very informative and said he feels optimistic. Maria praised his dedication and said she had been taking notes about local politics in her notebook, and she shared a photo of a notebook with a pencil and notepad on a table. John thanked her and said her notes gave him new ideas and plans for the community. John said he has a community meeting coming up next week, around mid-January 2023, where education and infrastructure upgrades will be discussed. He shared a photo of a microphone and a charger on a table. He said he will stand up for the community and that discussing these issues is important. Maria said speaking out is admirable and inspiring. John shared a photo of a group of people sitting around a table with a laptop, and Maria said that working together as a team could bring positive changes to the neighborhood. John then shared a photo of a man and a woman shaking hands. Maria said unity is essential and that standing together lets them tackle any problems and build a great community. John thanked Maria for being an awesome friend and said her support means a lot. Maria replied that it is nice to help and that they make a great team, and John agreed that they rock as a team and that he is glad to have her.

On 27 March 2023 at about 1:10 pm, Audrey and Andrew caught up in a chat. Andrew said he had started a new job as a Financial Analyst the previous week, a big change from his former job. Audrey said she had recently bought new collars and tags for her dogs and sent a photo of them in the grass with their mouths open. The photo shows two dogs, though she named three: Pepper, Precious, and Panda. She had had them for 3 years and said she can't live without them. Audrey lives in the city and described her dogs as city dogs who often explore parks and trails and go on adventures with her very frequently. Andrew said he was a bit jealous of those outings. He did not have any pets at that time but said he loves animals. His favorite animal is the bird, because he is awed by their ability to soar and explore new places, and his favorite bird is the eagle, which he finds strong and graceful. He shared a photo of two eagles flying against a sun. He had not gone bird-watching on purpose but sees birds when he hikes. He recommended Fox Hollow, a trail he likes for weekend hikes because of its great views. Audrey said she would try Fox Hollow and promised to let Andrew know how she liked it. The conversation ended with both wishing each other well.

On 2 April 2023 at about 2:42 pm, in a new session, Audrey announced that she and her household had adopted another puppy named Pixie, a small white dog, and shared a photo of herself sitting on a carpet. Andrew asked whether she had checked out Fox Hollow, and Audrey said she had not yet, because Pixie had been keeping them busy. Pixie took a few days to get used to the other dogs but then became good friends with them; they love playing and exploring the house. Audrey shared a photo of Pixie playing with a group of other dogs. She said Pepper took a bit of time to get used to Pixie, but the two are now always together, and she shared a photo of two dogs standing in grass near a fence. Andrew said he was considering getting a dog of his own but found it challenging to find a dog-friendly place in the city, so he asked Audrey for tips. Audrey said she and her family had used websites with filters that helped them find a place that allowed dogs, and that they found a perfect spot through them. She shared a photo of a dog sitting in a field of flowers. Andrew said he would try those websites and hoped to find an apartment and a furry friend soon. He shared a photo of his family's dog on a couch and said he misses exploring nature trails with that dog, recalling hiking photos of the two of them. Audrey shared a photo of one of her dogs lying on a couch with a pillow and said taking dogs on hikes must be awesome and made her want to hike with hers. Andrew shared a photo of a man sitting on a rock with a dog and said hiking with a dog is a great way to bond and make memories. He said he needed to find a dog-friendly spot soon and would keep looking until he found it. Audrey wished him the best, and Andrew said he would keep her posted before saying goodbye.

On 16 April 2023 at 4:19 pm, in a new session, Andrew said he had missed chatting and that he and his girlfriend (whom he called "my girl") had tried a new cafe in the city the previous weekend. He said it was super fun but that being out of nature is sad for him, because nature is where he feels he really thrives. He misses the peacefulness of hiking and feels connected and restored outdoors, describing nature as a home for his soul. Audrey agreed that nature's beauty and peace are unbeatable compared with concrete jungles, and said that walking her dogs in the park helps her find her center and recharges her. Andrew said he cannot do that in the city, and that he misses the connection and companionship, sometimes feeling like he is missing out. Audrey asked what he likes to do in the city, and he said he and his girlfriend love discovering new places to eat around town, which helps them try new things and unwind after a long week. They had found a cafe with amazing pastries, and he shared a photo of a bakery display with pastries and coffee. They had eaten croissants, muffins, and tarts. Audrey said she had made some of her favorite treats the week before and proposed a pastry party sometime, sharing a photo of a muffin pan filled with blueberries and muffins. Andrew said he would count himself in. Audrey said her dogs would tag along and would love it, and Andrew said he was excited to see all of them together. Audrey shared a photo of a dog running with three other dogs in the background and said she cannot imagine life without her dogs. Andrew said their happy faces must mean a lot to her. Audrey said she had gotten a tattoo of her dogs on her arm a while ago, which also includes sunflowers and represents her love for her pups and nature's beauty. She shared a photo of the tattoo on a woman's arm and a photo of a woman walking with her dogs in the woods. Andrew said the tattoo looked great and asked why she got it. Audrey said she has always had a strong bond with her dogs, that they make her very happy, and that she wants to see their happy faces even when they are not with her. Andrew said he was glad they bring so much joy into her life. Audrey did not mention Fox Hollow in this session, and Andrew's goal of finding a dog-friendly apartment and a furry friend was still unresolved.

On 3 May 2023 at 5:41 pm, in a new session, Audrey said it had been a long time since they talked and that the previous week she had finally gone on a hike, where she had a memorable encounter with a hummingbird darting around on its wings. She shared a photo of a hummingbird sitting on a branch with its wings spread. She did not name the trail, so it remains unclear whether she hiked Fox Hollow, and her promise to report back on it is not explicitly closed. Andrew said he was glad to hear from her and that he had been feeling down because he could not get out into nature often, but he had found a new open space to hike nearby, which felt refreshing. He shared a photo of a lake and mountains at sunset. He said he usually tries to escape the city at least once a weekend, calling it his much-needed break, and described nature as therapeutic. He shared a photo of a mountain range with a sunset in the background. Audrey said the view captured a calming feeling, and Andrew said he tries to capture special moments in nature and share that feeling with others. Both agreed that spreading peace and positivity is meaningful; Andrew described it as a ripple effect and said even small gestures can make a big difference. Andrew asked what was new with Audrey. She said not much had changed, that she was busy caring for her pets and spending time with them, which she found fulfilling, and she shared a photo of a group of dogs sitting on a lush green field. Andrew asked whether her dogs enjoy hikes. Audrey said they go wild on hikes, love exploring new scents, and that nature is their happy place, which she can tell from their wagging tails and expressions. She shared a photo of a dog running in a field with other dogs. Andrew asked for tips on keeping dogs safe when out and about. Audrey said safety is very important to her and that she had gotten them something special, which looks funny but works; she shared a photo of a dog wearing a leash and shoes. When Andrew asked what else she does when walking them, Audrey said they usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee and meet other dog owners in the park for doggie playdates, which lets her chat with people and lets the dogs make new friends. She shared a photo of a dog catching a frisbee in a field, and said the dogs adore fetch, have lots of energy, and get excited when she brings out the toys. She shared a photo of a dog wearing a party hat on a couch and said the hats do not bother the dogs, who wear them for fun and treats. Andrew asked where the playdates happen, and Audrey recommended the dog park right beside the park they usually walk, which has lots of trees and benches for watching the dogs play. She shared a photo of a dog jumping through a ring in a park. Andrew said he would check out the dog park and thanked her. Audrey asked him to let her know how it goes, and Andrew agreed. The conversation ended with Andrew saying goodbye. As of this session, Andrew's goal of finding a dog-friendly apartment and a furry friend remained unresolved, and he had found a new nearby hiking area and planned to visit the dog park Audrey recommended.

On 6 May 2023 at 10:47 am, in a new session (Session 5), Andrew said that since they last spoke he had been looking for a dog to adopt, browsing websites, visiting shelters, and asking friends, which he called both fun and annoying. He shared a photo of a dog looking through a cage at the camera. Audrey said it sounded like a fun but demanding task and asked what he could do to make the process smoother. She shared a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouths. Andrew said meeting all these adorable pups had been awesome and gave advice for anyone considering a dog: the size of the living space and the breed's exercise needs matter. For himself, as someone living in an apartment, a smaller dog would be best, but if one is active, a dog that loves to play and run is a good fit. Audrey agreed that it is important to consider a dog's space and energy needs. Andrew said finding a pet-friendly place to live had been tough too, and that he was contacting landlords and checking out neighborhoods. Audrey guessed housing was hard to find and asked which part of town he wanted. Andrew said he was looking for a place near a park or woods, so he could stay close to nature and give a dog a large open space to run around. Audrey said that was a good plan and that she was lucky to have a park near her, which is great for her pup's walks. She said that last Friday they had taken a road trip to a beautiful national park, where her dogs had a blast, and she shared a photo of three dogs running through a field of grass. Andrew asked whether she takes them on road trips often. Audrey said she takes them about once every couple of months, as a great way for them to explore and stay active. Andrew said he really wished he could go on a road trip with a furry companion, and Audrey said it is an amazing experience that makes it fun and exciting. Andrew said he was adding that to his bucket list. Audrey wished him good luck and said she hoped he found the perfect dog. Andrew thanked her for her help and said he would let her know how it goes. Audrey asked him to keep her posted and to ask for suggestions or help if needed, and said she would be expecting a picture of his dog soon. Andrew said he could not wait, and that he would talk later, since he had to check out another shelter soon. Audrey said to have fun, and the conversation ended. As of this session, Andrew still does not have a dog or an apartment. He has not confirmed visiting the dog park Audrey recommended, and Fox Hollow remains unconfirmed as hiked by Audrey.

On 11 May 2023 at 2:03 pm, in a new session (Session 6), Andrew said he had a great hike the previous weekend with some friends and his girlfriend at a spot they had found recently, and that nature was very peaceful, a chance to relax and take it in. The trail is not named, so it is unclear whether it is Fox Hollow. He shared a photo of a dirt path leading to a grassy hill. Audrey said nature is good for the soul and that her week had been good, with taking care of her "four doggies" (her household now includes four dogs, Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie, though earlier photos showed fewer dogs at once) and keeping them happy and healthy taking up most of her free time. She announced that she had signed up for a workshop about bonding with her pet next month, which is June 2023, and said she was eager to learn and strengthen her bond with her pets. She shared a photo of a group of dogs with a yellow circle around one of them. Andrew asked where she had heard about the workshop. Audrey said she saw a flyer at her local pet store. It is a positive reinforcement training class, and while at the store, a volunteer let her meet their dog, which she described as very friendly and playful. Andrew said positive reinforcement can really help with bonding and asked whether her dogs would catch on quickly. Audrey said she was sure they would, since they are quick learners who love rewards, and she could not wait to learn how to train them better. She promised to keep Andrew updated on how the class and her pups go, and to share training tips for his future dog. Andrew said he was excited to hear about it, and Audrey said she would make the most of the workshop and believed it was a must-learn for any dog owner. Andrew said she must be a good salesperson because he was almost sold on the class. Audrey explained that she believes pets should learn good behavior through positive reinforcement and that punishment is never the proper way. Andrew agreed that he would not want to be punished, let alone puppies and dogs. Audrey said she does not want to hurt any of her dogs and that just thinking about it pains her. Andrew said he would look into the classes and that they would talk soon, and Audrey said goodbye. As of this session, Andrew still has not confirmed adopting a dog or finding an apartment, though his search continues, and he has not confirmed visiting the dog park Audrey recommended. Fox Hollow remains unconfirmed as hiked by Audrey, and her promise to report back on it is still open. Audrey has promised to share updates on the workshop, her dogs' training progress, and training tips for Andrew's future dog, and Andrew has promised to keep her posted on his dog search and on how the dog park visit goes.

Gina and Jon are friends who have chatted, in person and online, since January 2023. They talk about their careers, their love of dance, and the businesses each is building. Both lost their jobs in January 2023: Jon was a banker, and Gina worked at DoorDash. Since then each has built a business while staying close to dance and supporting the other. Jon is building a dance studio, and Gina is building a clothing business. Their talks are warm and encouraging, and they usually close by promising to keep pushing forward together. The record now runs through thirteen sessions, the most recent on 13 June 2023.

The first conversation took place in person on 20 January 2023, at about 4:04 pm. Jon said he had lost his banking job the day before, on 19 January, and planned to start a dance studio. He has loved dancing since childhood and sees it as both his passion and his escape. He wants to open the studio to teach others the joy dance brings him. He loves all dance styles but names contemporary as his favorite, calling it expressive and powerful. His dance crew took first place at a local competition in 2022, and he shared a photo from that event. He described his ideal studio as one by the water with an ocean view and yoga mats, and he shared a photo of a room like that. He rehearses after work with a small group of dancers who perform everything from contemporary to hip-hop. He was finishing choreography for a February 2023 festival performance and hoped to find a space that would inspire them both.

Gina also lost her job at DoorDash in January 2023. Dance is her main stress relief, and she loves contemporary dance for being expressive and graceful. She has competed in several dance competitions and shows. Her favorite memory is her team winning first place at a regional competition when she was fifteen, performing a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom," which she described as emotional and powerful.

During that conversation, Jon invited Gina to see his moves at a dance session "next Friday," and she agreed. They also talked about taking a dance class together. The date of that Friday was never specified. The most likely date is 27 January 2023, but the record does not confirm that it happened, nor whether the dance class ever took place.

On 29 January 2023, at about 2:32 pm, they chatted online. Gina said things had been hectic because she had launched an ad campaign to grow her clothing store, and she called starting her own store and taking risks both scary and rewarding. Jon said he was still searching for a studio space but had found one with great natural light. He said he had been to Paris "yesterday," which would be 28 January. He wants a dance floor with enough bounce to dance safely, and he prefers Marley flooring, which is grippy but still lets dancers move and is easy to clean. Gina agreed that Marley sounded perfect. Jon described finding a space as a mix of exciting and nerve-wracking, and Gina encouraged him to believe in himself and dance out stress.

Watching the sunset made her feel connected to nature and grateful for life's small moments. John said the picture was chill and recalled the film camera he had as a child, with which he took plenty of beach pictures. He said nature helps people remember small joys, especially when life gets busy. He ended the session by sharing a photo of a group of people standing around a field, without further comment.

In the fourth session, on 9 January 2023 at 7:06 pm, Maria said she had become friends with one of her fellow volunteers, and that they both love helping others. John said he had been busy with work and family, but in roughly the first week of January 2023 he had an unexpected incident on his way home, which reminded him how life can throw unexpected troubles at people. He shared a photo of a car with a broken windshield, and Maria said she was glad he was alright. He then shared a photo of a tattoo with a quote, saying it reminds him to stay strong in tough times. He handled the incident by staying calm and asking for assistance, which helped him get home safely. Maria praised his resilience and resourcefulness. John said he felt relieved and grateful to get through it without incident, and Maria encouraged him to appreciate what he has. Asked what he does to calm down, John said he likes to look at the sunset, which reminds him to enjoy small things. Maria then asked about his political goals. John had been keeping busy looking into local politics, talking to community leaders, and learning about the needs and hopes of his neighborhood. He found it very informative and said he feels optimistic. Maria praised his dedication and said she had been taking notes about local politics in her notebook; she shared a photo of a notebook with a pencil and notepad on a table. John thanked her and said her notes gave him new ideas and plans for the community. He said he has a community meeting coming up the following week, around mid-January 2023, where education and infrastructure upgrades would be discussed, and he shared a photo of a microphone and a charger on a table. He said he will stand up for the community and that discussing these issues is important. Maria said speaking out is admirable and inspiring. John shared a photo of a group of people sitting around a table with a laptop, and Maria said working together as a team could bring positive changes to the neighborhood. He then shared a photo of a man and a woman shaking hands. Maria said unity is essential and that standing together lets them tackle any problems and build a great community. John thanked Maria for being an awesome friend and said her support means a lot. Maria replied that it is nice to help and that they make a great team, and John agreed that they rock as a team and that he is glad to have her.

In the fifth session, on 28 January 2023 at 1:17 pm, John said that since they last spoke he had attended the community meeting he had mentioned. He found hearing everyone's worries and how they affect the area very interesting. It made him realize how crucial the upgrades are, especially for the kids, and he said he is really upset by the state of local education. He shared a photo of a wooden floor against a white wall and asked Maria how they could make things better. Maria said they should fight for more money and resources for schools and raise awareness of the importance of education, which matters for all of us and not just children. John agreed that education is essential for a successful society and said it breaks his heart that kids lack the proper resources. Maria said children are the future and should have the best, and that it is not right that some kids get everything they need while others have nothing to help them succeed. John said his own kids have so much while others do not, and that they really need to do something about it. Maria said that around 21 January 2023 she volunteered at a shelter during an event for kids, which had been a great experience. She shared a photo of three women in green aprons holding pots and cups. John said this was making a big impact and asked what led her to get involved. Maria said she started volunteering to make a difference, and that her aunt, who believed in volunteering, used to help her family when they were struggling; her aunt inspires her, and brightening someone's day makes her happy. John asked about the most impactful moment. Maria described a little girl of about 8 sitting alone and looking sad. Maria sat with her and learned the girl had no other family, which broke Maria's heart. Maria gave her comfort and a listening ear, and they ended up laughing and having a good time. John said it was a touching moment and shared a photo of a little girl kissing a doll with the doll in her lap. He said the photo reminds him of a doll he had as a child that always made him feel better, and that it reminds him to always look out for others, especially when they feel down. Maria said spreading kindness and support can make a real difference, and John agreed that a kind gesture can change someone's day. Maria said kindness is key and that they are on the same page.

In the sixth session, on 5 February 2023 at 2:33 pm, Maria said she had challenged herself the previous Friday (around 3 February 2023) by taking part in a charity event, which she found great and heartwarming, and which made her feel the power of collective effort in helping people in need. John responded warmly and shared a photo of a woman handing a plate of food to a man. John asked whether she knew any organizations that could help him, and Maria said she had linked David, after their talk, with a nearby organization offering housing and support for homeless individuals, and hoped he would find the help he needed. She shared a photo of a woman in a face mask beside a table full of packages of food. He shared a photo of a Thanksgiving potluck and food drive flyer. He said unemployment in the community was the reason behind the initiative. He then said the response had been overwhelming, with many volunteers, and shared a photo of a large group standing around a table and another of a woman in a face mask holding a bag of food. Maria said she would love to lend a hand with networking or at future events, and John gratefully accepted her offer. He shared a photo of a group of men working on a wall. Maria said he is a great friend and that she will always be there for him. John said friendship means a lot to him, that they have each other's backs, and that they can work towards a shared goal. Jon and Gina are friends who have chatted regularly since at least January 2023. Both have been going through career changes, and their conversations are mostly supportive, with each encouraging the other through setbacks. Dance is central to both of them, and both describe dance and fashion or business as their two passions. Their exchanges often end with mutual encouragement such as "don't quit," "keep going," or "you got this."

Jon is a former banker who lost his job on 19 January 2023 and decided to open a dance studio. He has described dance as his passion since childhood and his escape from stress, and he wants to share the joy it gives him. His favorite style is contemporary, and his dance crew took first place at a local competition in 2022. He was rehearsing for a February 2023 festival, said the performance went well on 8 February, and was preparing for a March 2023 competition. On 29 January he said he had found a downtown studio spot with good natural light but still needed to check its size and floor. He prefers Marley flooring. He also said he had been to Paris "yesterday," which would be 28 January, but this was never confirmed. Over the spring he shut down his bank account to help the business grow, began offering workshops to local schools and community centers, and hosted or planned a fair. On 25 April he called running a business "no cakewalk" and admitted to low confidence. On 27 May he said he was reading "The Lean Startup," finishing his business plan, and searching for investors. In mid-June he described one-on-one mentoring alongside classes and workshops, and on 19 June he said he had taken a short trip to Rome the previous week, which conflicts with his earlier Paris claim. He announced that the official opening night of his studio would be 20 June 2023.

Gina lost her DoorDash job earlier in January 2023. She says dance is her go-to for stress relief and that she loves contemporary. She told Jon that her team won first place at a regional competition at age fifteen with a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom," and she has a background in competitive dance. On 29 January she launched an ad campaign for her clothing store. Both women have lost their mothers and keep a physical connection to them: Deborah through her mother's bench and pendant, and Jolene through her mother's room and pendant. Both have also described a mother-linked bench and a pendant as meaningful keepsakes.
