On 27 March 2023 at about 1:10 pm, Audrey and Andrew caught up in a chat. Andrew said he had started a new job as a Financial Analyst the previous week, a big change from his former job. Audrey said she had recently bought new collars and tags for her dogs and sent a photo of them in the grass with their mouths open. The photo showed two dogs, though she named three: Pepper, Precious, and Panda. She had had them for 3 years and said she could not live without them. Audrey lives in the city and described her dogs as city dogs who often explore parks and trails and go on adventures with her very frequently. Andrew said he was a bit jealous of those outings. He had no pets at that time but said he loves animals. His favorite animal is the bird, because he is awed by their ability to soar and explore new places, and his favorite bird is the eagle, which he finds strong and graceful. He shared a photo of two eagles flying against a sun. He had not gone bird-watching on purpose but sees birds when he hikes. He recommended Fox Hollow, a trail he likes for weekend hikes because of its great views. Audrey said she would try Fox Hollow and promised to let Andrew know how she liked it. The conversation ended with both wishing each other well.

On 2 April 2023 at about 2:42 pm, in a new session, Audrey announced that she and her household had adopted another puppy named Pixie, a small white dog, and shared a photo of herself sitting on a carpet. Andrew asked whether she had checked out Fox Hollow, and Audrey said she had not yet, because Pixie had been keeping them busy. Pixie took a few days to get used to the other dogs but then became good friends with them; they love playing and exploring the house. Audrey shared a photo of Pixie playing with a group of other dogs. She said Pepper took a bit of time to get used to Pixie, but the two are now always together, and she shared a photo of two dogs standing in grass near a fence. Andrew said he was considering getting a dog of his own but found it challenging to find a dog-friendly place in the city, so he asked Audrey for tips. Audrey said she and her family had used websites with filters that helped them find a place that allowed dogs, and that they found a perfect spot through them. She shared a photo of a dog sitting in a field of flowers. Andrew said he would try those websites and hoped to find an apartment and a furry friend soon. He shared a photo of his family's dog on a couch and said he misses exploring nature trails with that dog, recalling hiking photos of the two of them. Audrey shared a photo of one of her dogs lying on a couch with a pillow and said taking dogs on hikes must be awesome and made her want to hike with hers. Andrew shared a photo of a man sitting on a rock with a dog and said hiking with a dog is a great way to bond and make memories. He said he needed to find a dog-friendly spot soon and would keep looking until he found it. Audrey wished him the best, and Andrew said he would keep her posted before saying goodbye.

On 16 April 2023 at 4:19 pm, in a new session, Andrew said he had missed chatting and that he and his girlfriend (whom he called "my girl") had tried a new cafe in the city the previous weekend. He said it was super fun but that being out of nature is sad for him, because nature is where he feels he really thrives. He misses the peacefulness of hiking and feels connected and restored outdoors, describing nature as a home for his soul. Audrey agreed that nature's beauty and peace are unbeatable compared with concrete jungles, and said that walking her dogs in the park helps her find her center and recharges her. Andrew said he cannot do that in the city, and that he misses the connection and companionship, sometimes feeling like he is missing out. Audrey asked what he likes to do in the city, and he said he and his girlfriend love discovering new places to eat around town, which helps them try new things and unwind after a long week. They had found a cafe with amazing pastries, and he shared a photo of a bakery display with pastries and coffee. They had eaten croissants, muffins, and tarts. Audrey said she had made some of her favorite treats the week before and proposed a pastry party sometime, sharing a photo of a muffin pan filled with blueberries and muffins. Andrew said he would count himself in. Audrey said her dogs would tag along and would love it, and Andrew said he was excited to see all of them together. Audrey shared a photo of a dog running with three other dogs in the background and said she cannot imagine life without her dogs. Andrew said their happy faces must mean a lot to her. Audrey said she had gotten a tattoo of her dogs on her arm a while ago, which also includes sunflowers and represents her love for her pups and nature's beauty. She shared a photo of the tattoo on a woman's arm and a photo of a woman walking with her dogs in the woods. Andrew said the tattoo looked great and asked why she got it. Audrey said she has always had a strong bond with her dogs, that they make her very happy, and that she wants to see their happy faces even when they are not with her. Andrew said he was glad they bring so much joy into her life. Audrey did not mention Fox Hollow in this session, and Andrew's goal of finding a dog-friendly apartment and a furry friend was still unresolved.

On 3 May 2023 at 5:41 pm, in a new session, Audrey said it had been a long time since they talked and that the previous week she had finally gone on a hike, where she had a memorable encounter with a hummingbird darting around on its wings. She shared a photo of a hummingbird sitting on a branch with its wings spread. She did not name the trail, so it remains unclear whether she hiked Fox Hollow, and her promise to report back on it is not explicitly closed. Andrew said he was glad to hear from her and that he had been feeling down because he could not get out into nature often, but he had found a new open space to hike nearby, which felt refreshing. He shared a photo of a lake and mountains at sunset. He said he usually tries to escape the city at least once a weekend, calling it his much-needed break, and described nature as therapeutic. He shared a photo of a mountain range with a sunset in the background. Audrey said the view captured a calming feeling, and Andrew said he tries to capture special moments in nature and share that feeling with others. Both agreed that spreading peace and positivity is meaningful; Andrew described it as a ripple effect and said even small gestures can make a big difference. Andrew asked what was new with Audrey. She said not much had changed, that she was busy caring for her pets and spending time with them, which she found fulfilling, and she shared a photo of a group of dogs sitting on a lush green field. Andrew asked whether her dogs enjoy hikes. Audrey said they go wild on hikes, love exploring new scents, and that nature is their happy place, which she can tell from their wagging tails and expressions. She shared a photo of a dog running in a field with other dogs. Andrew asked for tips on keeping dogs safe when out and about. Audrey said safety is very important to her and that she had gotten them something special, which looks funny but works; she shared a photo of a dog wearing a leash and shoes. When Andrew asked what else she does when walking them, Audrey said they usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee and meet other dog owners in the park for doggie playdates, which lets her chat with people and lets the dogs make new friends. She shared a photo of a dog catching a frisbee in a field, and said the dogs adore fetch, have lots of energy, and get excited when she brings out the toys. She shared a photo of a dog wearing a party hat on a couch and said the hats do not bother the dogs, who wear them for fun and treats. Andrew asked where the playdates happen, and Audrey recommended the dog park right beside the park they usually walk, which has lots of trees and benches for watching the dogs play. She shared a photo of a dog jumping through a ring in a park. Andrew said he would check out the dog park and thanked her. Audrey asked him to let her know how it goes, and Andrew agreed. The conversation ended with Andrew saying goodbye.

On 6 May 2023 at 10:47 am, in a new session, Andrew said that since they last spoke he had been looking for a dog to adopt, browsing websites, visiting shelters, and asking friends, which he called both fun and annoying. He shared a photo of a dog looking through a cage at the camera. Audrey said it sounded like a fun but demanding task and asked what he could do to make the process smoother. She shared a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouths. Andrew said meeting all these adorable pups had been awesome and gave advice for anyone considering a dog: the size of the living space and the breed's exercise needs matter. For himself, as someone living in an apartment, a smaller dog would be best, but if one is active, a dog that loves to play and run is a good fit. Audrey agreed that it is important to consider a dog's space and energy needs. Andrew said finding a pet-friendly place to live had been tough too, and that he was contacting landlords and checking out neighborhoods. Audrey guessed housing was hard to find and asked which part of town he wanted. Andrew said he was looking for a place near a park or woods, so he could stay close to nature and give a dog a large open space to run around. Audrey said that was a good plan and that she was lucky to have a park near her, which is great for her pup's walks. She said that last Friday they had taken a road trip to a beautiful national park, where her dogs had a blast, and she shared a photo of three dogs running through a field of grass. Andrew asked whether she takes them on road trips often. Audrey said she takes them about once every couple of months, as a great way for them to explore and stay active. Andrew said he really wished he could go on a road trip with a furry companion, and Audrey said it is an amazing experience that makes it fun and exciting. Andrew said he was adding that to his bucket list. Audrey wished him good luck and said she hoped he found the perfect dog. Andrew thanked her for her help and said he would let her know how it goes. Audrey asked him to keep her posted and to ask for suggestions or help if needed, and said she would be expecting a picture of his dog soon. Andrew said he could not wait, and that he would talk later, since he had to check out another shelter soon. Audrey said to have fun, and the conversation ended. As of this session, Andrew still does not have a dog or an apartment, has not confirmed visiting the dog park Audrey recommended, and Fox Hollow remains unconfirmed as hiked by Audrey.

On 11 May 2023 at 2:03 pm, in a new session, Andrew said he had a great hike the previous weekend with some friends and his girlfriend at a spot they had found recently, and that nature was very peaceful, a chance to relax and take it in. The trail is not named, so it is unclear whether it is Fox Hollow. He shared a photo of a dirt path leading to a grassy hill. Audrey said nature is good for the soul and that her week had been good, with taking care of her "four doggies" (her household now includes four dogs, Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie, though earlier photos showed fewer dogs at once) and keeping them happy and healthy taking up most of her free time. She announced that she had signed up for a workshop about bonding with her pet next month, which is June 2023, and said she was eager to learn and strengthen her bond with her pets. She shared a photo of a group of dogs with a yellow circle around one of them. Andrew asked where she had heard about the workshop. Audrey said she saw a flyer at her local pet store. It is a positive reinforcement training class, and while at the store, a volunteer let her meet their dog, which she described as very friendly and playful. Andrew said positive reinforcement can really help with bonding and asked whether her dogs would catch on quickly. Audrey said she was sure they would, since they are quick learners who love rewards, and she could not wait to learn how to train them better. She promised to keep Andrew updated on how the class and her pups go, and to share training tips for his future dog. Andrew said he was excited to hear about it, and Audrey said she would make the most of the workshop and believed it was a must-learn for any dog owner. Andrew said she must be a good salesperson because he was almost sold on the class. Audrey explained that she believes pets should learn good behavior through positive reinforcement and that punishment is never the proper way. Andrew agreed that he would not want to be punished, let alone puppies and dogs. Audrey said she does not want to hurt any of her dogs and that just thinking about it pains her. Andrew said he would look into the classes and that they would talk soon, and Audrey said goodbye. As of this session, Andrew still had not confirmed adopting a dog or finding an apartment, and he had not confirmed visiting the dog park Audrey recommended. Fox Hollow remained unconfirmed as hiked by Audrey, and her promise to report back on it was still open. Audrey had promised to share updates on the workshop, her dogs' training progress, and training tips for Andrew's future dog, and Andrew had promised to keep her posted on his dog search and on how the dog park visit goes.

On 2 June 2023 at 11:27 am, in a new session, Audrey said that the previous day she had taken her pups to the park, where seeing them run and play without a leash filled her heart with joy and brought her a lot of peace. Andrew said moments like that show how amazing animals are, and he asked whether she had mentioned taking them on a hiking trip before. He shared a photo of a sunset over a mountain range with a horse grazing. Audrey confirmed that she had taken them hiking, saying that the previous week she had gone to a national park and reached a beautiful peak, where the sunset was stunning and her furry pals ran around, and that it felt like a slice of paradise, with a nice breeze and birds chirping. Andrew asked whether she had captured it, and she shared a photo of two horses in a field with a fence, calling it one of her favorites. Andrew praised the sunset and scenery. Audrey said nature always cheers her up and makes her feel grateful. She then asked how his search for a furry friend was going. Andrew said he was still hunting, but finding a pet-friendly spot in the city was tough, that he had checked out some places with no luck so far, and that he felt discouraged but was determined to find the right place and dog. Audrey encouraged him to hang in there, and Andrew said he would not give up. Audrey offered to help and asked him to email her his criteria so she could help find a great spot for his future furry friend, and Andrew thanked her warmly. Audrey said they would keep searching and told him to stay positive. As of this session, Andrew still had no dog and no apartment, and he had not yet sent Audrey his criteria. Audrey's hike to a national park the previous week was described as a peak hike with her dogs, but the trail was still not named, so it remained unconfirmed whether she hiked Fox Hollow, and her promise to report back on it was still open. Her June 2023 bonding workshop and her promised updates on it had not yet been reported in this session. The dog park Audrey recommended also remained unconfirmed as visited by Andrew.

On 13 June 2023 at 5:23 pm, in a new session (Session 8), Andrew said it had been a long time since they chatted and that the previous Sunday, 11 June, he and his friends had taken a rock climbing class, where he made it to the top. He called it a fantastic experience and said he was now hooked and planned to try more outdoor activities every week. Audrey said she was always in awe of people who can climb mountains and asked for pictures or videos of the view from the top. Andrew said the climb was a challenge but very satisfying, and that the view was stunning. He shared a photo of the view from the top of the rock he climbed during the class, and a photo of a man climbing on a rock face. Audrey called the view stunning, congratulated him on reaching the top, and remarked that nature reminds us how tiny we are. Andrew said the climb was tricky because he is still a newbie, but he made it with the support and cheer of his friends. Audrey said having a solid support group helps when things get tough and that he was lucky to have such great friends. Andrew said the climb had encouraged him to try more outdoor activities such as kayaking and maybe bungee jumping, adding that nature always pushes him out of his comfort zone. Audrey said he was going all in and wished him fun with kayaking and bungee jumping. She then said that the previous week she had found a great spot for her dogs' walk, a small park with a trail surrounded by trees, which she thought her dogs liked too, and she invited Andrew to come along. Andrew said he would love to join her and the pups for a walk. Audrey said her dogs love meeting new people, and Andrew said he could not wait to meet them and take a stroll in the park. Audrey shared a photo taken during the walk of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouths, and Andrew said they looked like they were enjoying themselves. Audrey said she usually walks them for about an hour, letting them explore at their own pace, and that they need exercise and exploration and always go home smiling and tired. Andrew said an hour was a good amount of time for a nice stroll. Audrey said the dogs' faces brighten as soon as she gets ready for a walk, and that the walk is their favorite part of the day. Andrew agreed that nature makes people and pets happy. Audrey said dogs and nature bring her a lot of joy and peace, and she shared a photo of two dogs playing with a frisbee in a meadow, saying they made her very happy. Andrew said the dogs looked content and that it was great nature brings them joy. Audrey said being outdoors with them puts her in her happy place, peaceful and inspiring. Andrew said being outdoors has a way of inspiring and calming us. Audrey said nature makes us think differently, and Andrew said it refreshes the mind and gives a different outlook, and that whenever he needs a reset he turns to nature. Audrey closed by saying nature makes us feel alive and centered and that we should appreciate what it gives us. This session ended without an explicit goodbye.

As of Session 8, Andrew still has no dog and no apartment, and he has not sent Audrey his criteria for finding a pet-friendly place. He has not confirmed visiting the dog park Audrey recommended, and it remains unconfirmed whether Audrey has hiked Fox Hollow, so her promise to report back on it is still open. Audrey's June 2023 bonding workshop has not yet been reported on, and her promised updates and training tips remain open. Andrew has now gone rock climbing, has considered kayaking and bungee jumping, and has accepted Audrey's invitation to join her and her dogs for a walk in the small park with a tree-lined trail, though no date for that walk is given and it is not confirmed as having happened. Audrey's dogs are named Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie, and Audrey has had them for several years, while Andrew's family dog is a separate animal he misses.

The memory covers seven conversations between Calvin and Dave, from their first meeting on 23 March 2023 through a seventh session on 31 May 2023.

In the first session, at 11:53 am on 23 March 2023, Calvin and Dave met for the first time. Dave said things had been going well and that he had recently attended a car event full of classic cars, where he spoke with owners and heard their stories. Calvin said he had just gone through a big life change and shared a photo of his new mansion, a building with a sign on its front. He framed the change around learning about Japanese culture and getting a chance to expand. Calvin has never been to Japan and is fascinated by its traditions. He planned to leave for Japan in April 2023. His agent found him a place to stay there, and he shared a photo of its cozy living room with a couch, table, and television. In Japan he planned to explore the city, try local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with local musicians. He would stay a few months and then travel to Boston. Dave had been spending a lot of time at a beautiful, calming park with a lake and a few boats, and he shared a photo of it. Calvin had never been there but said he would check it out when he returned. Dave offered more recommendations if Calvin needed them, and they ended by wishing each other well for the trip.

The second session took place at 4:45 pm on 26 March 2023. Calvin said it had been a few days since they last talked and announced that he had just bought a new car, a luxury car he described as a long-held dream come true. He called it smooth and powerful, said driving it made him feel like a rockstar, and said it was what he deserved after all his hard work. He shared a photo of a red sports car parked on the side of the road, taken on 25 March when he first took it for a ride. He did not name the car's make or model when Dave asked. Calvin also said he was on cloud nine. Dave reported that he was doing well and that the previous weekend (around 18 to 19 March) he had gone to a music festival in Boston, which he loved and which reminded him why he loves music. He shared a photo of a large crowd at a concert. Dave said his favorite band there was Aerosmith, whose performance he found incredible. He shared two photos: one of a concert stage with a large eagle, and one of two people on stage with guitars and a microphone. He said he had finally seen them live and that the singer was jamming to one of their hits. Dave said he did not get to hang out with the band after the show. When Dave asked about news in Calvin's life, Calvin said he had got a new ride, had written some new tunes, and had had several studio sessions the previous week. He said he was excited to collaborate and would share the music with everyone once it was ready. He promised to keep Dave updated on how the collaborations went, and the two signed off by wishing each other well and staying safe.

The third session took place at 4:15 pm on 20 April 2023. Calvin said it had been a long time since they had seen each other and reported that he had just been to a music festival in Tokyo, which he called awesome. He did not see any bands there, but he met many talented artists and industry people, and he found the experience enriching. He said he learned a lot and got valuable advice from professionals in the music industry. A producer told him to stay true to himself and sound unique, which got him thinking about where he wants his music to go. His long-term dream is to tour the world, performing for different people and connecting with them, and he hopes his music can reach a global audience and make an impact. He said he was looking forward to an upcoming trip to Boston after he finishes the Frank Ocean tour, and he had heard the music scene there is awesome. Dave responded enthusiastically and offered to show Calvin around Boston and its cool spots. He recommended Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park as places with a great music scene, and said he would be in the front row whenever Calvin performed onstage. Dave shared a photo of a city skyline with a boat in the water, which Calvin admired. Dave also said that the previous weekend (around 15 to 16 April) he had gone to a car show, where he found classic cars charming and admired the dedication people put into restoring them. This is why he is so into auto engineering. He shared a photo of a green Mustang parked in a field of grass. Calvin replied that the car looked great and shared a photo of a red sports car on display at a show, saying he had put a lot of work into it and could not wait to see more cars in Boston. This red car appears to be the same sports car Calvin bought in March, now shown at an event. When Dave asked whether Calvin had seen anything in Boston beyond the gigs, Calvin said not yet, because he had been busy with rehearsals and traveling, but he was looking forward to exploring the city, trying delicious food, and visiting popular attractions. He suggested they grab a bite together when he arrives, and Dave agreed to share his favorite spots in the city. The conversation ended with both expressing excitement about meeting in Boston and seeing each other soon.

The fourth session took place at 6:24 pm on 1 May 2023, and it was a longer, more upbeat exchange in which Dave shared big news about his career. He said it had been a long time since they last talked and announced that he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop, which he described as a dream come true and a spot to work on cars that he finds deeply satisfying. He shared a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it. Calvin congratulated him and shared a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage. Dave thanked him, said the shop had been his dream and that it took a lot of hard work, but that it was worth it. Calvin praised his guts and ambition and shared a photo of a book with a space theme on its cover. Dave said the shop is a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars, which he loves for their design and engineering. Calvin shared a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot and said that going for classic cars was cool. Dave said he is obsessed with classic cars because of their unique charm, and that last year he had been thrilled to restore one, which he called a labor of love that was challenging but worth it. He shared a photo of the restored car's engine, which has a small air filter. Calvin said it looked awesome, and the two exchanged a series of messages about how satisfying it is to see something you worked on come back to life and to see hard work pay off. Dave then shared a photo of his shop, a group of people standing in front of a car, and invited Calvin to come by if he could. Calvin said he would love to visit and asked what cars Dave works on. Dave said he works on all kinds of cars, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars, and that he finds it rewarding to see transformations and to know he is helping people keep their cars in good condition. Calvin encouraged him to keep up the great work. Calvin then shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant and called it stunning. When Dave asked where he got it, Calvin said it was a gift from another artist and a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician. The two closed by encouraging each other to keep pushing, with Calvin saying that they should keep each other motivated.

The fifth session took place at 1:16 pm on 3 May 2023. Dave opened by saying it had been a long time since they talked and announced that he was teaming up with a local garage, sharing a photo of a car being worked on in a garage. Calvin congratulated him, called the news inspiring, and shared a photo of a green car in a garage with a sign in the background. Dave said he was loving the job, getting to work with skilled mechanics and share his knowledge about cars. He shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage, describing it as a cool project that was a bit challenging. Calvin said the car looked awesome and encouraged him to keep up the good work. Dave said he planned to keep learning about auto engineering and hoped to build a custom car from scratch someday, which is his dream. For now he would keep working on the current project and assisting customers. Calvin called him inspiring and told him to relax and enjoy the process. Dave said he needed to take time to chill and asked whether Calvin had hobbies that helped him relax. Calvin said long drives in his red sports car, the one he shared a photo of, really helped him relax, because the wind and open road were freeing and cleared his head. Dave said driving with the wind in your hair was calming and that walking and exploring, taking in the sights and sounds, was a peaceful way for him to destress. Calvin agreed that embracing nature had been calming for him as well, and said he had been loving getting to know Japanese culture. He then admitted that he was stuck with his music, that his creativity felt frozen, and asked for tips. Dave suggested immersing himself in something he loves, such as concerts or favorite albums, which usually jumpstarts his inspiration, and recommended taking a break from music to explore other things and have some fun. Calvin said taking a break was great for getting his mojo back and that he would take the advice and explore. Dave encouraged him to keep pursuing music and never give up. The two agreed to stay in touch, said goodbye, and Calvin signed off with a thank-you.

The sixth session took place at 11:50 am on 16 May 2023, and it was a more mixed exchange. Calvin opened by saying it had been a long time since they chatted and that a lot had happened. He reported that things had not been going smoothly: about a week earlier (around 9 May, "last week") his place had been flooded. He managed to save his music gear and his favorite microphone, and he said it had been tough but he was staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed. Dave sympathized, said he was glad the important gear was saved, and offered help. Calvin said he was waiting on insurance to kick in before starting repairs and hoped it would not take long. He shared a photo of his music studio, a room with a keyboard, a synthesizer, and other musical equipment, which he called his creative haven where he pours his heart into music. Dave said the studio looked awesome and hoped it would be fixed soon. Calvin asked Dave about exciting work, and Dave said he had opened his car shop "last week," invited friends over to celebrate, and found it amazing; he said he was stoked to share his passion and help folks with their rides. (This is a little inconsistent with the 1 May session, where Dave first announced the shop's opening.) Calvin congratulated him. Calvin then said he had an upcoming performance in Tokyo "this month" (May 2023) and hoped to show his music to a new crowd and expand his following. Dave wished him luck and asked to hear how it went, and Calvin promised to keep him posted. Calvin then shared a photo of a city at night full of lights, saying he took it in Tokyo "last night" (15 May) and that the skyline was stunning. Dave said the skyline looked great and that he hoped to visit Tokyo soon, and Calvin encouraged him to visit. Dave said he was adding it to his list.

The seventh session took place at 6:06 pm on 31 May 2023. Calvin opened by saying it had been ages since they chatted and that so much had happened. He said touring with Frank Ocean the previous week (around 24 May) had been wild, and that Tokyo, where he had performed, was unreal, with an insane crowd. He said he felt so alive when performing that he could not find the words to express it. Dave congratulated him and said he had been busy too, sharing a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage. Dave described it as his neighbor's car, which had been having engine trouble, and said he had fixed it himself. Calvin said the fans' energy and love had been crazy. He asked whether the car was the one Dave had been fixing up for a friend, which slightly mixes up the detail, since Dave had said it belonged to a neighbor. Calvin said working on cars helped him chill and clear his head. Dave said helping neighbors with their cars was not difficult for him and that working on cars was therapeutic, and he asked whether it relaxed Calvin as much as it relaxed him. Calvin said fixing cars calmed him down and gave him a real sense of achievement, like meditating, and asked whether Dave had hobbies that gave him the same satisfaction. Dave said fixing things was more than a hobby for him, giving him a sense of achievement and purpose, and that he got a real buzz turning something broken into something that runs smoothly, like giving it a second chance. Calvin said Dave found purpose in transforming things, and that they were both making something great out of nothing. Dave agreed that making something look amazing was cool and said giving things new life made him feel powerful and happy. Calvin said the feeling of power and happiness was amazing and that it was great to see what they had created with their hard work and ideas. Dave said accomplishment kept him motivated, then asked Calvin whether he always enjoyed performing live. Calvin said performing live always fueled his soul, that he loved the rush and connection with the crowd, and called it an absolute high. Dave said the connection between artist and audience must be powerful and shared a photo of a large crowd of people taking pictures at a concert, calling the atmosphere off the charts. Calvin agreed that everyone was part of it, like one big harmony, and shared a photo of a crowd watching a concert under bright lights. Dave said music brought people together and was like therapy for everyone, then shared a photo of a band performing on stage and asked what was next for Calvin's music. Calvin said he could not wait for the tour with Frank and was buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it was like, and that it would be great playing for folks from home. He asked what Dave thought of the Boston music scene. Dave said it was awesome, with plenty of talented musicians and cool places to play, and said he would be there to cheer Calvin on. Calvin thanked him and said Dave's support meant a lot. Dave said he hoped Calvin had a great time in Boston and wanted to hear all about it when he got back. Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details when he returned and signed off with "See you soon!"

Maria and John are friends who reconnected on 17 December 2022 after a long gap. John had returned on 16 December 2022 from a family road trip. Maria volunteers at a homeless shelter, keeps fit, and recently started aerial yoga, which she enjoys. John does kickboxing, which gives him a lot of energy, and Maria called it a good way to stay in shape and de-stress. In the second session, John also mentioned taekwondo as a new activity, separate from kickboxing. On 25 February 2023, John mentioned that his colleague Rob had invited him to a beginner's yoga class, which he had not yet scheduled.

John's main goal is to get into local politics because he loves helping the community. He focuses on improving education and infrastructure. His interest dates back to his childhood, when he saw how a lack of education and crumbling infrastructure affected his neighborhood. He does not want future generations to face the same problems and believes schools and infrastructure should be funded properly. He shared a 2021 photo of a school after it received funding, showing a group of men working on a building; the funding paid for repairs and renovations that made the school safer and more modern. At the time, his next step was to talk with local leaders and organizations to gain support and ideas. Maria asked him to keep her updated on the campaign, and he agreed.

In the second session, on 22 December 2022 at 6:10 pm, Maria said it had been a few days since they last chatted. On 21 December 2022 she donated her old car to the homeless shelter where she volunteers. John said the campaign had been interesting and that he had been networking to get people's input. He had recently talked with someone who shared some amazing stories, which fired up his passion for improving education in their area. He stressed that investing in future generations and giving them the right tools for success is the foundation of progress. Maria encouraged him, and he said her support motivates him. He shared a photo of his family having a picnic in the park and said they are the reason he never gives up; their love gives him strength, helps him stay centered, and reminds him why he is passionate about making a positive impact. He called his family his rock in tough times and said family time means a lot to him. He shared a photo of his family on a playground swing and said they love climbing, sliding, and playing games together. Maria described her family as small but said she loves spending time with friends, usually watching movies, hiking, and hosting game nights at her place, and that quality connections matter most to her. John shared a photo of his family gathered at a kitchen table for dinner and said shared meals help them stay close. He then shared a photo of a table with pizzas and salads, explaining that the family made pizza together and enjoyed picking toppings. Maria said she had recently made peach cobbler. John ended the session by saying he was off to do taekwondo. Both agreed to keep cherishing time with loved ones.

In the third session, on 1 January 2023 at 8:30 pm, John said he had joined a service-focused online group the previous week, around late December 2022, and that it had been an emotional experience. Its members have inspiring stories, which have opened his eyes to new perspectives and given him a sense of connection and purpose. He shared a photo of a man sitting on a bed using a laptop, which seems to show someone in the group or the online setting. Maria called the news amazing and praised the supportive community. John said the group shares a passion for serving and that members share stories, advice, and encouragement. When Maria asked whether he had met any members in person, he said the group had held events. They went to a homeless shelter to hand out food and supplies, and seeing people's smiles showed them they had made a real difference. He shared a photo of a poster on a table with a Santa Claus, which fits the toy drive the group organized for children in need; John said it was wonderful to see the community come together to spread joy. Asked about future projects, John said the group is brainstorming ways to help underserved communities gain access to education, mentorship, job training, and resume building, to empower individuals to reach their aspirations. Maria said empowering people through education and mentorship is crucial, and John said the right assistance and resources can make a lasting impact. Maria agreed that a bit of support can make an amazing change. John then revealed that he had recently failed a military aptitude test, which left him feeling stressed, and said Maria's support means a lot to him. Maria reassured him that she has his back and said nature's beauty reminds her to slow down and enjoy small things. She shared a photo of a sunset over the ocean with a wave coming in, which she took at the beach in December 2022. Watching the sunset made her feel connected to nature and grateful for life's small moments. John said the picture was chill and recalled the film camera he had as a child, with which he took plenty of beach pictures. He said nature helps people remember small joys, especially when life gets busy. He ended the session by sharing a photo of a group of people standing around a field, without further comment.

In the fourth session, on 9 January 2023 at 7:06 pm, Maria said she had become friends with one of her fellow volunteers, and that they both love helping others. John said he had been busy with work and family, but in roughly the first week of January 2023 he had an unexpected incident on his way home, which reminded him how life can throw unexpected troubles at people. He shared a photo of a car with a broken windshield, and Maria said she was glad he was alright. He then shared a photo of a tattoo with a quote, saying it reminds him to stay strong in tough times. He handled the incident by staying calm and asking for assistance, which helped him get home safely. Maria praised his resilience and resourcefulness. John said he felt relieved and grateful to get through it without incident, and Maria encouraged him to appreciate what he has. Asked what he does to calm down, John said he likes to look at the sunset, which reminds him to enjoy small things. Maria then asked about his political goals. John had been keeping busy looking into local politics, talking to community leaders, and learning about the needs and hopes of his neighborhood. He found it very informative and said he feels optimistic. Maria praised his dedication and said she had been taking notes about local politics in her notebook; she shared a photo of a notebook with a pencil and notepad on a table. John thanked her and said her notes gave him new ideas and plans for the community. He said he had a community meeting coming up the following week, around mid-January 2023, where education and infrastructure upgrades would be discussed, and he shared a photo of a microphone and a charger on a table. He said he will stand up for the community and that discussing these issues is important. Maria said speaking out is admirable and inspiring. John shared a photo of a group of people sitting around a table with a laptop, and Maria said working together as a team could bring positive changes to the neighborhood. He then shared a photo of a man and a woman shaking hands. Maria said unity is essential and that standing together lets them tackle any problems and build a great community. John thanked Maria for being an awesome friend and said her support means a lot. Maria replied that it is nice to help and that they make a great team, and John agreed that they rock as a team and that he is glad to have her.

In the fifth session, on 28 January 2023 at 1:17 pm, John said that since they last spoke he had attended the community meeting he had mentioned. He found hearing everyone's worries and how they affect the area very interesting. It made him realize how crucial the upgrades are, especially for the kids, and he said he is really upset by the state of local education. He shared a photo of a wooden floor against a white wall and asked Maria how they could make things better. Maria said they should fight for more money and resources for schools and raise awareness of the importance of education, which matters for all of us and not just children. John agreed that education is essential for a successful society and said it breaks his heart that kids lack the proper resources. Maria said children are the future and should have the best, and that it is not right that some kids get everything they need while others have nothing to help them succeed. John said his own kids have so much while others do not, and that they really need to do something about it. Maria said that around 21 January 2023 she volunteered at a shelter during an event for kids, which had been a great experience. She shared a photo of three women in green aprons holding pots and cups. John said this was making a big impact and asked what led her to get involved. Maria said she started volunteering to make a difference, and that her aunt, who believed in volunteering, used to help her family when they were struggling; her aunt inspires her, and brightening someone's day makes her happy. John asked about the most impactful moment. Maria described a little girl of about 8 sitting alone and looking sad. Maria sat with her and learned the girl had no other family, which broke Maria's heart. Maria gave her comfort and a listening ear, and they ended up laughing and having a good time. John said it was a touching moment and shared a photo of a little girl kissing a doll with the doll in her lap. He said the photo reminds him of a doll he had as a child that always made him feel better, and that it reminds him to always look out for others, especially when they feel down. Maria said spreading kindness and support can make a real difference, and John agreed that a kind gesture can change someone's day. Maria said kindness is key and that they are on the same page.

In the sixth session, on 5 February 2023 at 2:33 pm, Maria said she had challenged herself the previous Friday (around 3 February 2023) by taking part in a charity event, which she found great and heartwarming, and which made her feel the power of collective effort in helping people in need. John responded warmly and shared a photo of a woman handing a plate of food to a man. Maria said serving meals and seeing gratitude on people's faces was rewarding and reminded her how powerful compassion can be. She then asked John what got him into politics. John said he feels a strong urge to serve his country and community, and that running for office was his chance to make an impact; he did not elaborate on whether he was currently running. At the event Maria had talked with a man named David, whose story of hardship and difficult circumstances humbled her, showing her that everyone has a story and deserves understanding. She shared a photo of a man with a cell phone in his hand. John asked whether she knew any organizations that could help him, and Maria said she had linked David, after their talk, with a nearby organization offering housing and support for homeless individuals, and hoped he would find the help he needed. She shared a photo of a flyer with a group of people in a circle. John praised her impact. Asked whether John had ever needed help himself, Maria said that when she was younger her family had money problems and relied on outside help from her aunt, which taught her the importance of helping others who struggle. She shared a photo of a woman in a face mask beside a table full of packages of food. John said we learn a lot from our own struggles and revealed that he had just started helping with a food drive for people who had lost their jobs; he shared a photo of himself at a food bank with a group of people and boxes of tomatoes. Seeing how unemployment affected their neighbors led him to act, and he wanted to help in these tough times through a community food drive. He shared a photo of a Thanksgiving potluck and food drive flyer. He said unemployment in the community was the reason behind the initiative. He then said the response had been overwhelming, with many volunteers, and shared a photo of a large group standing around a table and another of a woman in a face mask holding a bag of food. Maria said she would love to lend a hand with networking or at future events, and John gratefully accepted her offer. He shared a photo of a group of men working on a wall. Maria said she would always help whenever he needed it and shared a photo of a group of people standing outside a house. John said her support means a lot and thanked her for always being there. Maria said he is a great friend and that she will always be there for him. John said friendship means a lot to him, that they have each other's backs, and that they can work towards a shared goal. He ended the session with a photo of a group of people sitting in a park.

In the seventh session, on 25 February 2023 at 8:55 pm, Maria opened by saying she had recently taken a creative writing class, which she found super enlightening. John said he is running for office again, which he described as a wild ride that has left him more excited than ever. He shared a photo of a crowd of people sitting on a sidewalk with umbrellas. Maria congratulated him and asked what made him decide to run again. John said that after his last run he saw the impact he could make in the community through politics, and that it is rewarding to work toward positive changes and a better future. Maria said she had been volunteering at a homeless shelter, which is very rewarding. She told John that while volunteering the previous day (24 February 2023) she had met an amazing woman named Jean, who had been through a lot yet stayed optimistic and resilient, and who showed her the importance of gratitude and connection. She shared a photo of a woman in a blue shirt with a ring on her neck. Maria explained that Jean had gone through a divorce, lost her job, and ended up homeless, yet still values the little things and believes in the good of kindness. John said it was inspiring to see someone stay optimistic even when things get tough, and Maria agreed that it is a reminder that we can still find joy and hope no matter what. John urged Maria to keep up the great work, saying a little kindness and optimism can go a long way and that her volunteer work sounds very influential. Both agreed that positivity and kindness make a difference and that they should keep spreading positivity and helping each other. John shared a photo of a man holding a child on his shoulders. Maria asked whether he had anything fun coming up soon. John said nothing was too soon, but his colleague Rob had invited him to a beginner's yoga class.

On 23 January 2023 at 4:06 pm, Deborah and Jolene met for the first time in a chat. Deborah is a yoga teacher whose goal is to keep teaching and supporting her community, because she is passionate about helping people find peace and joy through yoga. Yoga helped her find peace during a rough time, which inspired her to share it with others. Before that session, Deborah visited her late mother's old house, which holds many memories for her. Her mother passed away a few years earlier. Deborah shared a photo of what she called their last photo together, showing her mother hugging her, with both of them in wheelchairs. Her mother had a special bench near the window where she liked to sit every morning and take in the view. Deborah sometimes sits on that bench herself because it helps her stay connected to her mother. Deborah also has a pendant that reminds her of her mother. Deborah ended that session early, saying she had to run.

Jolene is an electrical engineer who finished a demanding electrical engineering project the week before that session. Her mother passed away in 2022. Jolene shared a photo of her room in her mother's house, which has a bench and a window, and she has many memories of that room. She wears a heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it, which her mother gave her in 2010 in Paris, and it reminds her of her mother. Her jewelry also has a symbol that represents freedom for her, a reminder to pursue her goals and not be held back. Jolene was enthusiastic about Deborah's yoga work and said she was looking forward to the next chat.

Both women have lost their mothers and keep a physical connection to them: Deborah through her mother's bench and pendant, and Jolene through her mother's room and pendant. Both have described a mother-linked bench and a pendant as meaningful keepsakes.

In the second session, on the morning of 27 January 2023 at 9:49 am, Deborah told Jolene that her father had passed away two days earlier, around 25 January, and that his sudden death had left the whole family shell-shocked. She said she was channeling her grief by spending more time with family and cherishing memories, which remind her to live life fully. She shared a photo of a woman hugging another woman seated on a couch. Jolene offered condolences and asked how the family was coping. Deborah said that looking back on good memories is comforting, and that they had been going through the family album. Photos give her peace in hard times. She shared a photo of her parents' wedding in 1993, a bride and groom posing together. Deborah said she and her husband are trying to be as good a family as her parents were. When Jolene asked what she valued in her relationship, Deborah said love and openness have kept her and her husband close over the years, and that being there for each other has made them both happy. Deborah then shared a photo of a handwritten note she received the day before from her group members, thanking her for the positive influence she had on them. She said moments like that remind her why she is so passionate about yoga.

Asked where she most often practices yoga, Deborah shared a photo of a living room with a television and a window, saying it was one of the places she practices. She explained it is her old home, which she visits now and then for her mother, who has passed. Sitting in the spot by the window gives her peace, and she feels her mother's presence there, which comforts her. She then shared a photo of a window seat in a room with a window. Deborah and Jolene are two women who have each lost their mothers, and they have been chatting since 23 January 2023, when they first met. Deborah is a yoga teacher whose goal is to keep teaching and supporting her community. She is passionate about helping people find peace and joy through yoga, which helped her find peace during a rough time and inspired her to share it with others. Jolene is an electrical engineer. She finished a demanding electrical engineering project in the week before their first chat. Her mother passed away in 2022.

In the first session, on 23 January 2023 at 4:06 pm, Deborah said she had visited her late mother's old house, which holds many memories for her. Her mother passed away a few years earlier. Deborah shared a photo of what she called their last photo together, showing her mother hugging her, with both of them in wheelchairs. Her mother had a special bench near the window where she liked to sit every morning and take in the view. Deborah sometimes sits on that bench herself because it helps her stay connected to her mother. She also has a pendant that reminds her of her mother. Deborah ended that session early, saying she had to run. Jolene shared a photo of her room in her mother's house, which has a bench and a window, and said she has many memories of that room. She wears a heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it, which her mother gave her in 2010 in Paris, and it reminds her of her mother. Her jewelry also has a symbol that represents freedom for her, a reminder to pursue her goals and not be held back. Jolene was enthusiastic about Deborah's yoga work and said she was looking forward to the next chat. Both women keep a physical connection to their mothers: Deborah through her mother's bench and pendant, and Jolene through her mother's room and pendant. Both have described a mother-linked bench and a pendant as meaningful keepsakes.

In the second session, on the morning of 27 January 2023 at 9:49 am, Deborah told Jolene that her father had passed away two days earlier, around 25 January. His sudden death left the whole family shell-shocked. Deborah said she was channeling her grief by spending more time with family and cherishing memories, which remind her to live life fully. She shared a photo of a woman hugging another woman seated on a couch. Jolene offered condolences and asked how the family was coping. Deborah said looking back on good memories is comforting, and that the family had been going through the family album. Photos give her peace in hard times. She shared a photo of her parents' wedding in 1993, a bride and groom posing together, and said she and her husband are trying to be as good a family as her parents were. When Jolene asked what she valued in her relationship, Deborah said love and openness have kept her and her husband close over the years, and that being there for each other has made them both happy. Deborah then shared a photo of a handwritten note she had received the day before from her group members, thanking her for the positive influence she had on them. She said moments like that remind her why she is so passionate about yoga.

Asked where she most often practices yoga, Deborah shared a photo of a living room with a television and a window. She said it is one of the places she practices, and that it is her old home, which she visits now and then for her mother, who has passed. Sitting in the spot by the window gives her peace, and she feels her mother's presence there, which comforts her. She then shared a photo of a window seat in a room with a window. Deborah said her mother would sit there every night with a book and a smile, since reading was one of her hobbies, and it was one of her favorite places in the house. The first session had described her mother sitting on the bench every morning to take in the view, so the bench was used both in the morning and at night. Deborah also said travel was her mother's great passion, and she shared a photo of a view of the sky from an airplane window to illustrate it.

Jolene then introduced her pets, which calm her down and make her happy. She shared a photo of a bed with a snake's head poking out, of her snake named Susie. Deborah said having a pet brightens life and asked for a fun moment with Jolene's pet. Jolene described how her second snake, Seraphim, slinked out of its cage and coiled up next to her while she was playing video games, which she found very funny. She shared a photo of Seraphim peeking out of a blanket with its sly eyes, and said she bought Seraphim a year earlier in Paris. Deborah said pets bring so much happiness, and Jolene called snakes very unusual pets. Jolene then shared a photo of herself and her partner gaming the previous week, with a dog watching TV beside them. She said they are both crazy about playing the game "Detroit" on a console. Deborah asked whether her boyfriend had taught her to play. Jolene said that even as a child she learned to play on her own. When Deborah asked whether she played only old games or tried new ones, Jolene said she and her partner planned to play "The Walking Dead" next Saturday. Deborah closed by telling Jolene to take care and keep spreading good vibes, and Jolene said goodbye.

In the third session, on 1 February 2023 at 7:03 pm, Jolene said she had been busy because her engineering professor had given her class a huge robotics project. She called it tough but fun, and said it was making her get creative and problem-solve. She shared a photo of a table with a robot on it and a laptop. When she first received the project she felt a mix of excitement and nervousness, but she now really enjoys it. She described it as like solving a puzzle, figuring out the best design and programming, and said seeing the robot come together is awesome. Deborah said she met her new neighbor Anna the previous day, 31 January, and shared a photo of a yellow sign with a picture of a family. They met at yoga in the park. Deborah said they talked about how yoga has improved their lives and the sense of community it gives. Jolene said it is great to connect with people who share similar interests. She then shared a photo of a purse with a plant on a table. Deborah asked whether Jolene had ever thought about resuming yoga. Jolene replied that she and her partner had planned to play the console together. Deborah said it is good that Jolene has something to do with her partner, and Jolene thanked her for the kind words. Deborah then said she had to run, and Jolene said she would see her soon. Like the first session, Deborah ended this one abruptly.

Current state (as of 11 August 2023): John plays basketball as a shooting guard, having signed with the Minnesota Wolves in May 2023. His reported endorsement status is a Nike basketball shoe and gear deal, with Gatorade talks ongoing and Under Armour a wished-for partner. His Seattle game was planned for August 2023, and its outcome was not reported. His charity partnership is with a local organization, which has not been named. Tim writes fantasy articles for an online magazine. He is reading "The Name of the Wind" (author Patrick Rothfuss, whom he recommended earlier), and he is working on a Harry Potter fan project with a fan he met in California.

Jon and Gina reconnected on 20 January 2023 after both lost their jobs: Jon's banking job on 19 January and Gina's DoorDash job earlier that month. Both use dance to relieve stress and favor contemporary dance. Jon has long wanted to start a dance studio. He invited Gina to see his moves "next Friday," and she replied "Let's boogie!" No session confirmed that the meetup happened.

Jon's dance crew won first place at a local competition in 2022, and he rehearses after work with a small group. He prefers Marley flooring for his hoped-for ocean-view studio. Gina once competed in several competitions, and her favorite memory is her team's first place at a regional contest at fifteen with the contemporary piece "Finding Freedom."

From late January into early February, Gina's clothing store ad campaign kept her busy, and a wholesaler agreed to work with her. Jon was still searching for a studio, though he later said finding one had been tricky. On 8 February he said the festival performance went well, speaking as if he already ran a studio, which conflicts with earlier sessions. He said leaving banking pushed him to turn his passion into a business.

On 16 March, Jon said he had started going to the gym. Gina announced her online clothing store was open, a dream blending dance and fashion. Jon advised her to build a standout brand and nurture customers. He also described his students for the first time, so his studio claim is uncertain.

On 3 April 2023 (Session 8), Jon said he had closed his bank account to focus on his business and was expanding his studio's social media and offering school workshops. He was hosting a competition the next month where his studio and others would be judged, and he invited Gina, who said she's in. Gina launched new offers and promotions, saying dance relieves her stress while fashion fuels her creativity.

On 9 April 2023 (Session 9), Jon said he is turning his love of dance into a business and learning alongside his students. He said losing his job pushed him to do what he loves. Gina shared a photo of a contest trophy, and they pledged to keep pushing each other.

On 25 April 2023 (Session 10), Jon said he had shown off his studio at a fair the day before, which was stressful but great, and had gotten some possible leads. He admitted the business is no cakewalk, that he was having trouble with his project, and that he had been feeling low on confidence. He asked how to stay motivated. Gina congratulated him on the fair and said she had started her own online clothing store. She advised him to keep his big goal and reasons in mind, lean on supportive people, and focus on why he started because he loves it. Jon said he would keep going, and they pledged to keep each other going.

As of the latest session, Jon has performed at the February festival and is preparing for a May competition. He describes an expanding studio and fair leads, but whether he has a permanent studio remains unclear. This is the first session where he openly admits struggling with motivation and confidence. Gina plans to attend his event, and her business has grown through a wholesaler partnership, a March online store, and new promotions.

The memory covers eight conversations between Calvin and Dave, from their first meeting on 23 March 2023 through an eighth session on 9 June 2023.

In the first session, at 11:53 am on 23 March 2023, Calvin and Dave met for the first time. Dave said things had been going well and that he had recently attended a car event full of classic cars, where he spoke with owners and heard their stories. Calvin said he had just gone through a big life change and shared a photo of his new mansion, a building with a sign on its front. He framed the change around learning about Japanese culture and getting a chance to expand. Calvin has never been to Japan and is fascinated by its traditions. He planned to leave for Japan in April 2023. His agent found him a place to stay there, and he shared a photo of its cozy living room with a couch, table, and television. In Japan he planned to explore the city, try local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with local musicians. He would stay a few months and then travel to Boston. Dave had been spending a lot of time at a beautiful, calming park with a lake and a few boats, and he shared a photo of it. Calvin had never been there but said he would check it out when he returned. Dave offered more recommendations if Calvin needed them, and they ended by wishing each other well for the trip.

The second session took place at 4:45 pm on 26 March 2023. Calvin said it had been a few days since they last talked and announced that he had just bought a new car, a luxury car he described as a long-held dream come true. He called it smooth and powerful, said driving it made him feel like a rockstar, and said it was what he deserved after all his hard work. He shared a photo of a red sports car parked on the side of the road, taken on 25 March when he first took it for a ride. He did not name the car's make or model when Dave asked. Calvin also said he was on cloud nine. Dave reported that he was doing well and that the previous weekend (around 18 to 19 March) he had gone to a music festival in Boston, which he loved and which reminded him why he loves music. He shared a photo of a large crowd at a concert. Dave said his favorite band there was Aerosmith, whose performance he found incredible. He shared two photos: one of a concert stage with a large eagle, and one of two people on stage with guitars and a microphone. He said he had finally seen them live and that the singer was jamming to one of their hits. Dave said he did not get to hang out with the band after the show. When Dave asked about news in Calvin's life, Calvin said he had got a new ride, had written some new tunes, and had had several studio sessions the previous week. He said he was excited to collaborate and would share the music with everyone once it was ready. He promised to keep Dave updated on how the collaborations went, and the two signed off by wishing each other well and staying safe.

The third session took place at 4:15 pm on 20 April 2023. Calvin said it had been a long time since they had seen each other and reported that he had just been to a music festival in Tokyo, which he called awesome. He did not see any bands there, but he met many talented artists and industry people, and he found the experience enriching. He said he learned a lot and got valuable advice from professionals in the music industry. A producer told him to stay true to himself and sound unique, which got him thinking about where he wants his music to go. His long-term dream is to tour the world, performing for different people and connecting with them, and he hopes his music can reach a global audience and make an impact. He said he was looking forward to an upcoming trip to Boston after he finishes the Frank Ocean tour, and he had heard the music scene there is awesome. Dave responded enthusiastically and offered to show Calvin around Boston and its cool spots. He recommended Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park as places with a great music scene, and said he would be in the front row whenever Calvin performed onstage. Dave shared a photo of a city skyline with a boat in the water, which Calvin admired. Dave also said that the previous weekend (around 15 to 16 April) he had gone to a car show, where he found classic cars charming and admired the dedication people put into restoring them. This is why he is so into auto engineering. He shared a photo of a green Mustang parked in a field of grass. Calvin replied that the car looked great and shared a photo of a red sports car on display at a show, saying he had put a lot of work into it and could not wait to see more cars in Boston. This red car appears to be the same sports car Calvin bought in March, now shown at an event. When Dave asked whether Calvin had seen anything in Boston beyond the gigs, Calvin said not yet, because he had been busy with rehearsals and traveling, but he was looking forward to exploring the city, trying delicious food, and visiting popular attractions. He suggested they grab a bite together when he arrives, and Dave agreed to share his favorite spots in the city. The conversation ended with both expressing excitement about meeting in Boston and seeing each other soon.

The fourth session took place at 6:24 pm on 1 May 2023, and it was a longer, more upbeat exchange in which Dave shared big news about his career. He said it had been a long time since they last talked and announced that he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop, which he described as a dream come true and a spot to work on cars that he finds deeply satisfying. He shared a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it. Calvin congratulated him and shared a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage. Dave thanked him, said the shop had been his dream and that it took a lot of hard work, but that it was worth it. Calvin praised his guts and ambition and shared a photo of a book with a space theme on its cover. Dave said the shop is a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars, which he loves for their design and engineering. Calvin shared a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot and said that going for classic cars was cool. Dave said he is obsessed with classic cars because of their unique charm, and that last year he had been thrilled to restore one, which he called a labor of love that was challenging but worth it. He shared a photo of the restored car's engine, which has a small air filter. Calvin said it looked awesome, and the two exchanged a series of messages about how satisfying it is to see something you worked on come back to life and to see hard work pay off. Dave then shared a photo of his shop, a group of people standing in front of a car, and invited Calvin to come by if he could. Calvin said he would love to visit and asked what cars Dave works on. Dave said he works on all kinds of cars, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars, and that he finds it rewarding to see transformations and to know he is helping people keep their cars in good condition. Calvin encouraged him to keep up the great work. Calvin then shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant and called it stunning. When Dave asked where he got it, Calvin said it was a gift from another artist and a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician. The two closed by encouraging each other to keep pushing, with Calvin saying that they should keep each other motivated.

The fifth session took place at 1:16 pm on 3 May 2023. Dave opened by saying it had been a long time since they talked and announced that he was teaming up with a local garage, sharing a photo of a car being worked on in a garage. Calvin congratulated him, called the news inspiring, and shared a photo of a green car in a garage with a sign in the background. Dave said he was loving the job, getting to work with skilled mechanics and share his knowledge about cars. He shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage, describing it as a cool project that was a bit challenging. Calvin said the car looked awesome and encouraged him to keep up the good work. Dave said he planned to keep learning about auto engineering and hoped to build a custom car from scratch someday, which is his dream. For now he would keep working on the current project and assisting customers. Calvin called him inspiring and told him to relax and enjoy the process. Dave said he needed to take time to chill and asked whether Calvin had hobbies that helped him relax. Calvin said long drives in his red sports car, the one he shared a photo of, really helped him relax, because the wind and open road were freeing and cleared his head. Dave said driving with the wind in your hair was calming and that walking and exploring, taking in the sights and sounds, was a peaceful way for him to destress. Calvin agreed that embracing nature had been calming for him as well, and said he had been loving getting to know Japanese culture. He then admitted that he was stuck with his music, that his creativity felt frozen, and asked for tips. Dave suggested immersing himself in something he loves, such as concerts or favorite albums, which usually jumpstarts his inspiration, and recommended taking a break from music to explore other things and have some fun. Calvin said taking a break was great for getting his mojo back and that he would take the advice and explore. Dave encouraged him to keep pursuing music and never give up. The two agreed to stay in touch, said goodbye, and Calvin signed off with a thank-you.

The sixth session took place at 11:50 am on 16 May 2023, and it was a more mixed exchange. Calvin opened by saying it had been a long time since they chatted and that a lot had happened. He reported that things had not been going smoothly: about a week earlier (around 9 May, "last week") his place had been flooded. He managed to save his music gear and his favorite microphone, and he said it had been tough but he was staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed. Dave sympathized, said he was glad the important gear was saved, and offered help. Calvin said he was waiting on insurance to kick in before starting repairs and hoped it would not take long. He shared a photo of his music studio, a room with a keyboard, a synthesizer, and other musical equipment, which he called his creative haven where he pours his heart into music. Dave said the studio looked awesome and hoped it would be fixed soon. Calvin asked Dave about exciting work, and Dave said he had opened his car shop "last week," invited friends over to celebrate, and found it amazing; he said he was stoked to share his passion and help folks with their rides. (This is a little inconsistent with the 1 May session, where Dave first announced the shop's opening.) Calvin congratulated him. Calvin then said he had an upcoming performance in Tokyo "this month" (May 2023) and hoped to show his music to a new crowd and expand his following. Dave wished him luck and asked to hear how it went, and Calvin promised to keep him posted. Calvin then shared a photo of a city at night full of lights, saying he took it in Tokyo "last night" (15 May) and that the skyline was stunning. Dave said the skyline looked great and that he hoped to visit Tokyo soon, and Calvin encouraged him to visit. Dave said he was adding it to his list.

The seventh session took place at 6:06 pm on 31 May 2023. Calvin opened by saying it had been ages since they chatted and that so much had happened. He said touring with Frank Ocean the previous week (around 24 May) had been wild, and that Tokyo, where he had performed, was unreal, with an insane crowd. He said he felt so alive when performing that he could not find the words to express it. Dave congratulated him and said he had been busy too, sharing a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage. Dave described it as his neighbor's car, which had been having engine trouble, and said he had fixed it himself. Calvin said the fans' energy and love had been crazy. He asked whether the car was the one Dave had been fixing up for a friend, which slightly mixes up the detail, since Dave had said it belonged to a neighbor. Calvin said working on cars helped him chill and clear his head. Dave said helping neighbors with their cars was not difficult for him and that working on cars was therapeutic, and he asked whether it relaxed Calvin as much as it relaxed him. Calvin said fixing cars calmed him down and gave him a real sense of achievement, like meditating, and asked whether Dave had hobbies that gave him the same satisfaction. Dave said fixing things was more than a hobby for him, giving him a sense of achievement and purpose, and that he got a real buzz turning something broken into something that runs smoothly, like giving it a second chance. Calvin said Dave found purpose in transforming things, and that they were both making something great out of nothing. Dave agreed that making something look amazing was cool and said giving things new life made him feel powerful and happy. Calvin said the feeling of power and happiness was amazing and that it was great to see what they had created with their hard work and ideas. Dave said accomplishment kept him motivated, then asked Calvin whether he always enjoyed performing live. Calvin said performing live always fueled his soul, that he loved the rush and connection with the crowd, and called it an absolute high. Dave said the connection between artist and audience must be powerful and shared a photo of a large crowd of people taking pictures at a concert, calling the atmosphere off the charts. Calvin agreed that everyone was part of it, like one big harmony, and shared a photo of a crowd watching a concert under bright lights. Dave said music brought people together and was like therapy for everyone, then shared a photo of a band performing on stage and asked what was next for Calvin's music. Calvin said he could not wait for the tour with Frank and was buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it was like, and that it would be great playing for folks from home. He asked what Dave thought of the Boston music scene. Dave said it was awesome, with plenty of talented musicians and cool places to play, and said he would be there to cheer Calvin on. Calvin thanked him and said Dave's support meant a lot. Dave said he hoped Calvin had a great time in Boston and wanted to hear all about it when he got back. Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details when he returned and signed off with "See you soon!"

The eighth session took place at 2:31 pm on 9 June 2023. Calvin opened by saying he had met with the creative team for his album the previous day (8 June), a long session that was awesome to see coming together. Dave replied warmly and shared a photo of a pond with a boat in it, surrounded by trees. Calvin said he was feeling stoked about the album, described the team as making some magic in the studio, and shared a photo of a recording studio with a large window and a desk. He pictured an ideal studio by the water.

Gina said she had only been to Rome once and called starting her store both scary and rewarding.
