The memory covers eleven conversations between Calvin and Dave, from their first meeting on 23 March 2023 through an eleventh session on 21 July 2023. Dave and Calvin are friends who often ask about each other's lives, and Dave frequently talks about cars and Calvin about music.

In the first session, at 11:53 am on 23 March 2023, Calvin and Dave met for the first time. Dave said things had been going well and that he had recently attended a car event full of classic cars, where he spoke with owners and heard their stories. Calvin said he had just gone through a big life change and shared a photo of his new mansion, a building with a sign on its front. He framed the change around learning about Japanese culture and getting a chance to expand. Calvin has never been to Japan and is fascinated by its traditions. He planned to leave for Japan in April 2023. His agent found him a place to stay there, and he shared a photo of its cozy living room with a couch, table, and television. In Japan he planned to explore the city, try local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with local musicians. He would stay a few months and then travel to Boston. Dave had been spending a lot of time at a beautiful, calming park with a lake and a few boats, and he shared a photo of it. Calvin had never been there but said he would check it out when he returned. Dave offered more recommendations if Calvin needed them, and they ended by wishing each other well for the trip.

The second session took place at 4:45 pm on 26 March 2023. Calvin said it had been a few days since they last talked and announced that he had just bought a new car, a luxury car he described as a long-held dream come true. He called it smooth and powerful, said driving it made him feel like a rockstar, and said it was what he deserved after all his hard work. He shared a photo of a red sports car parked on the side of the road, taken on 25 March when he first took it for a ride. He did not name the car's make or model when Dave asked. Calvin also said he was on cloud nine. Dave reported that he was doing well and that the previous weekend (around 18 to 19 March) he had gone to a music festival in Boston, which he loved and which reminded him why he loves music. He shared a photo of a large crowd at a concert. Dave said his favorite band there was Aerosmith, whose performance he found incredible. He shared two photos: one of a concert stage with a large eagle, and one of two people on stage with guitars and a microphone. He said he had finally seen them live and that the singer was jamming to one of their hits. Dave said he did not get to hang out with the band after the show. When Dave asked about news in Calvin's life, Calvin said he had got a new ride, had written some new tunes, and had had several studio sessions the previous week. He said he was excited to collaborate and would share the music with everyone once it was ready. He promised to keep Dave updated on how the collaborations went, and the two signed off by wishing each other well and staying safe.

The third session took place at 4:15 pm on 20 April 2023. Calvin said it had been a long time since they had seen each other and reported that he had just been to a music festival in Tokyo, which he called awesome. He did not see any bands there, but he met many talented artists and industry people, and he found the experience enriching. He said he learned a lot and got valuable advice from professionals in the music industry. A producer told him to stay true to himself and sound unique, which got him thinking about where he wants his music to go. His long-term dream is to tour the world, performing for different people and connecting with them, and he hopes his music can reach a global audience and make an impact. He said he was looking forward to an upcoming trip to Boston after he finishes the Frank Ocean tour, and he had heard the music scene there is awesome. Dave responded enthusiastically and offered to show Calvin around Boston and its cool spots. He recommended Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park as places with a great music scene, and said he would be in the front row whenever Calvin performed onstage. Dave shared a photo of a city skyline with a boat in the water, which Calvin admired. Dave also said that the previous weekend (around 15 to 16 April) he had gone to a car show, where he found classic cars charming and admired the dedication people put into restoring them. This is why he is so into auto engineering. He shared a photo of a green Mustang parked in a field of grass. Calvin replied that the car looked great and shared a photo of a red sports car on display at a show, saying he had put a lot of work into it and could not wait to see more cars in Boston. This red car appears to be the same sports car Calvin bought in March, now shown at an event. When Dave asked whether Calvin had seen anything in Boston beyond the gigs, Calvin said not yet, because he had been busy with rehearsals and traveling, but he was looking forward to exploring the city, trying delicious food, and visiting popular attractions. He suggested they grab a bite together when he arrives, and Dave agreed to share his favorite spots in the city. The conversation ended with both expressing excitement about meeting in Boston and seeing each other soon.

The fourth session took place at 6:24 pm on 1 May 2023, and it was a longer, more upbeat exchange in which Dave shared big news about his career. He said it had been a long time since they last talked and announced that he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop, which he described as a dream come true and a spot to work on cars that he finds deeply satisfying. He shared a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it. Calvin congratulated him and shared a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage. Dave thanked him, said the shop had been his dream and that it took a lot of hard work, but that it was worth it. Calvin praised his guts and ambition and shared a photo of a book with a space theme on its cover. Dave said the shop is a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars, which he loves for their design and engineering. Calvin shared a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot and said that going for classic cars was cool. Dave said he is obsessed with classic cars because of their unique charm, and that last year he had been thrilled to restore one, which he called a labor of love that was challenging but worth it. He shared a photo of the restored car's engine, which has a small air filter. Calvin said it looked awesome, and the two exchanged a series of messages about how satisfying it is to see something you worked on come back to life and to see hard work pay off. Dave then shared a photo of his shop, a group of people standing in front of a car, and invited Calvin to come by if he could. Calvin said he would love to visit and asked what cars Dave works on. Dave said he works on all kinds of cars, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars, and that he finds it rewarding to see transformations and to know he is helping people keep their cars in good condition. Calvin encouraged him to keep up the great work. Calvin then shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant and called it stunning. When Dave asked where he got it, Calvin said it was a gift from another artist and a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician. The two closed by encouraging each other to keep pushing, with Calvin saying that they should keep each other motivated.

The fifth session took place at 1:16 pm on 3 May 2023. Dave opened by saying it had been a long time since they talked and announced that he was teaming up with a local garage, sharing a photo of a car being worked on in a garage. Calvin congratulated him, called the news inspiring, and shared a photo of a green car in a garage with a sign in the background. Dave said he was loving the job, getting to work with skilled mechanics and share his knowledge about cars. He shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage, describing it as a cool project that was a bit challenging. Calvin said the car looked awesome and encouraged him to keep up the good work. Dave said he planned to keep learning about auto engineering and hoped to build a custom car from scratch someday, which is his dream. For now he would keep working on the current project and assisting customers. Calvin called him inspiring and told him to relax and enjoy the process. Dave said he needed to take time to chill and asked whether Calvin had hobbies that helped him relax. Calvin said long drives in his red sports car, the one he shared a photo of, really helped him relax, because the wind and open road were freeing and cleared his head. Dave said driving with the wind in your hair was calming and that walking and exploring, taking in the sights and sounds, was a peaceful way for him to destress. Calvin agreed that embracing nature had been calming for him as well, and said he had been loving getting to know Japanese culture. He then admitted that he was stuck with his music, that his creativity felt frozen, and asked for tips. Dave suggested immersing himself in something he loves, such as concerts or favorite albums, which usually jumpstarts his inspiration, and recommended taking a break from music to explore other things and have some fun. Calvin said taking a break was great for getting his mojo back and that he would take the advice and explore. Dave encouraged him to keep pursuing music and never give up. The two agreed to stay in touch, said goodbye, and Calvin signed off with a thank-you.

The sixth session took place at 11:50 am on 16 May 2023, and it was a more mixed exchange. Calvin opened by saying it had been a long time since they chatted and that a lot had happened. He reported that things had not been going smoothly: about a week earlier (around 9 May, "last week") his place had been flooded. He managed to save his music gear and his favorite microphone, and he said it had been tough but he was staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed. Dave sympathized, said he was glad the important gear was saved, and offered help. Calvin said he was waiting on insurance to kick in before starting repairs and hoped it would not take long. He shared a photo of his music studio, a room with a keyboard, a synthesizer, and other musical equipment, which he called his creative haven where he pours his heart into music. Dave said the studio looked awesome and hoped it would be fixed soon. Calvin asked Dave about exciting work, and Dave said he had opened his car shop "last week," invited friends over to celebrate, and found it amazing; he said he was stoked to share his passion and help folks with their rides. (This is a little inconsistent with the 1 May session, where Dave first announced the shop's opening.) Calvin congratulated him. Calvin then said he had an upcoming performance in Tokyo "this month" (May 2023) and hoped to show his music to a new crowd and expand his following. Dave wished him luck and asked to hear how it went, and Calvin promised to keep him posted. Calvin then shared a photo of a city at night full of lights, saying he took it in Tokyo "last night" (15 May) and that the skyline was stunning. Dave said the skyline looked great and that he hoped to visit Tokyo soon, and Calvin encouraged him to visit. Dave said he was adding it to his list.

The seventh session took place at 6:06 pm on 31 May 2023. Calvin opened by saying it had been ages since they chatted and that so much had happened. He said touring with Frank Ocean the previous week (around 24 May) had been wild, and that Tokyo, where he had performed, was unreal, with an insane crowd. He said he felt so alive when performing that he could not find the words to express it. Dave congratulated him and said he had been busy too, sharing a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage. Dave described it as his neighbor's car, which had been having engine trouble, and said he had fixed it himself. Calvin said the fans' energy and love had been crazy. He asked whether the car was the one Dave had been fixing up for a friend, which slightly mixes up the detail, since Dave had said it belonged to a neighbor. Calvin said working on cars helped him chill and clear his head. Dave said helping neighbors with their cars was not difficult for him and that working on cars was therapeutic, and he asked whether it relaxed Calvin as much as it relaxed him. Calvin said fixing cars calmed him down and gave him a real sense of achievement, like meditating, and asked whether Dave had hobbies that gave him the same satisfaction. Dave said fixing things was more than a hobby for him, giving him a sense of achievement and purpose, and that he got a real buzz turning something broken into something that runs smoothly, like giving it a second chance. Calvin said Dave found purpose in transforming things, and that they were both making something great out of nothing. Dave agreed that making something look amazing was cool and said giving things new life made him feel powerful and happy. Calvin said the feeling of power and happiness was amazing and that it was great to see what they had created with their hard work and ideas. Dave said accomplishment kept him motivated, then asked Calvin whether he always enjoyed performing live. Calvin said performing live always fueled his soul, that he loved the rush and connection with the crowd, and called it an absolute high. Dave said the connection between artist and audience must be powerful and shared a photo of a large crowd of people taking pictures at a concert, calling the atmosphere off the charts. Calvin agreed that everyone was part of it, like one big harmony, and shared a photo of a crowd watching a concert under bright lights. Dave said music brought people together and was like therapy for everyone, then shared a photo of a band performing on stage and asked what was next for Calvin's music. Calvin said he could not wait for the tour with Frank and was buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it was like, and that it would be great playing for folks from home. He asked what Dave thought of the Boston music scene. Dave said it was awesome, with plenty of talented musicians and cool places to play, and said he would be there to cheer Calvin on. Calvin thanked him and said Dave's support meant a lot. Dave said he hoped Calvin had a great time in Boston and wanted to hear all about it when he got back. Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details when he returned and signed off with "See you soon!"

The eighth session took place at 2:31 pm on 9 June 2023. Calvin opened by saying he had met with the creative team for his album the previous day (8 June), a long session that was awesome to see coming together. Dave replied warmly and shared a photo of a pond with a boat in it, surrounded by trees. Calvin said he was feeling stoked about the album, described the team as making some magic in the studio, and shared a photo of a recording studio with a large window and a desk. He asked Dave for news since they last talked. Dave said he had been doing well and had been exploring parks on weekends to relax, finding nature very peaceful. He asked whether Calvin knew any chill spots in Boston. Calvin said he had never been to Boston before, had heard the parks were amazing, and could not wait to visit next month (July 2023). He asked Dave for anything he remembered about Boston parks and shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers in the foreground. Dave said the Boston parks are awesome, especially in spring, and are very serene for walking. He said he had gone for a stroll the previous Friday (around 2 June) and it was amazing, and that he loves weekend walks because they recharge him for the whole coming week. Calvin said he was excited to experience that serenity and to take walks in the parks himself, then asked whether Dave had been hiking lately and shared a photo of a path climbing a hill with mountains in view. Dave said he had not gone hiking recently but found it awesome for being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights, and that it clears the mind and brings calm. He asked whether Calvin had been to the mountains, which he had heard were super chill. Calvin said he had not been to the mountains but was keen to go, looking for a way to escape it all and de-stress, and that he wanted to hike somewhere like the place in the photo. He shared a photo of a plane flying over a snowy mountain range and asked what was new and exciting for Dave. Dave said he had booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023), finally going to see those majestic peaks, and expected it to be an amazing experience. Calvin wished him a great time and asked him to take lots of pictures and show him when he got back. Dave agreed to take many photos and to show Calvin on his return. The two signed off with Calvin wishing Dave safe travels and saying they would see each other soon, and Dave thanking him and saying the same.

The ninth session took place at 3:15 pm on 21 June 2023. Calvin opened by saying hello and that some things had happened since they last chatted. He said he had been in a small car accident the previous Friday (around 16 June), which was upsetting but left no one hurt. He said he had been dealing with insurance and repairs, which took a lot of time and energy, and he shared a photo of a red car with a black rim parked on a sidewalk. Dave sympathized, said he was glad nobody was hurt, and asked whether Calvin had run into problems with the insurance process. Calvin said the process was a hassle, took forever, and involved a ton of paperwork, but that it was now sorted and the car was being fixed. He shared a photo of a tow truck parked in a parking lot and said he could not wait to drive the car again. Dave asked how long everything had taken. Calvin said it took only about a week to sort out, and that although he had worried about the cost, it was not too bad. He shared a photo from the auto repair shop of a man working on a car in a garage. Dave asked who the man was, and Calvin said he was the mechanic, someone who knows his stuff and is doing his best to get the car running again. Dave said it was great to have skilled, knowledgeable people working on the car. Calvin said he was feeling much more confident and excited to show off the car, and that he trusted their expertise. Dave said it was awesome to trust the people fixing it and that the car would be back to normal soon. Calvin thanked him and said he appreciated his help. He then shared a photo of a view from his living room, a small town with a mountain in the background, and said it was from a small town in Japan and that the mountain view was unbelievably stunning. Dave asked whether Calvin had visited the place yet. Calvin said he had not been there before and that it was on his to-do list for after his Frank Ocean tour ends, and he said he could not wait to see them in person. He then shared a photo of a person on skis on a snowy mountain and said it looked like a snowy peak. Dave asked whether he had ever tried skiing. Calvin said he had not but that it looked like a lot of fun and he might give it a try once. He then asked Dave what was new in his daily routine. Dave said he had recently joined a rock band and had been practicing guitar, and he shared a photo of the band members, a group of men playing instruments in a room. Calvin said playing guitar in a rock band was awesome and would bring Dave a lot of emotions. Dave said good company and great music lift the mood and bring a lot of positive emotions, and then said he had to go and would see Calvin soon. Calvin said he hoped to keep in touch and wished Dave well.

The tenth session took place at 7:56 pm on 7 July 2023. Dave opened by asking how Calvin's car was doing after the crash and whether he was stoked to be back on the road. Calvin replied that the car was fixed and going strong, that cruising around was the best, and he shared a photo of a red sports car parked on the side of the road. He asked Dave how he had been and whether anything was new. Dave said he had been good and had been hanging out with friends at parks lately, and that he had arranged regular walks together in the park with friends. Calvin said this sounded like a great plan and that fresh air and friends could do wonders, then asked whether Dave had a favorite spot for hanging out. Dave said they were going to that spot that day and shared a photo of a city skyline with a river and boats in the water. Calvin admired the view, said the sunset over the river was gorgeous and the place must be tranquil, and said it reminded him of living in his Japanese mansion with its epic cityscape, which he called a dream come true. He shared a photo he had taken from his backyard of the mansion, showing a boat docked in a canal at sunset. Dave said the peace by the river was nice and that living in a Japanese mansion surrounded by a city skyline must be stunning. Calvin said that whenever he looked out the windows and saw the city lights it was awe-inspiring, described it as luxury and beauty on a whole new level, and shared a photo of the front of the mansion, a large house with many windows and lights. Dave said the mansion looked great, guessed the view from inside was stunning, and asked whether Calvin was looking forward to anything else in Japan. Calvin said he could not wait to try the food and check out the culture, and asked whether Dave had ever been to Japan. Dave said he had never been but was keen to go one day, had heard it was full of vibes, good eats and awesome tech, and that he was hooked on Japanese music. Calvin said Japan had it all and was like stepping into another world, and that he had been working on cool music collaborations with Japanese artists and was excited to hear how they turned out. Dave said working with them was a great chance and he could not wait for the tunes. Calvin promised to share some clips when everything was ready and said collaborating with various artists was always exciting and a chance to create something unique. Dave praised the collaboration and said he could not wait to see or hear the end product. Calvin thanked him, said it was going to be awesome, said he had to get back to work, and signed off. Dave told him to take care, not to overwork himself, to talk soon, and to stay safe.

The eleventh session took place at 6:38 pm on 21 July 2023. Dave opened by saying it had been ages since they spoke and that he had just returned from a road trip with friends through stunning countryside. He called it a lovely break from "the corporate mayhem," and said driving winding roads, taking in the views, and chatting with friends had recharged him and reminded him why he loves cars. He asked what Calvin had been doing. Calvin said a road trip sounded awesome and that recharging with one's passion was great. Dave said the trip reminded him why he is passionate about his work and that the long hours were worth it. He shared a photo of a person riding a motorcycle down a dirt road, calling it a wonderful place they had found, and asked whether Calvin had recently had moments that reminded him what he loves. Calvin said he was happy for Dave and that he was working on a project to transform a Japanese mansion into a recording studio. It has long been his dream to have a space for creating music with other artists, and he described it as his sanctuary that reminds him why he loves music. He shared a photo of a room with a ladder in it, showing his progress. Dave said the progress looked amazing, that having a space of one's own must be very fulfilling, and asked what kind of music Calvin had been creating there. Calvin said he had been experimenting with different genres, pushing himself out of his comfort zone, and adding electronic elements to his songs to give them a fresh vibe, calling it an exciting process of self-discovery and growth. Dave asked whether moving between styles presented challenges. Calvin said switching it up can be tough and that the work is finding the right balance between sticking to his sound and trying new things, which can be intimidating but keeps him motivated. Dave agreed that balance is tricky but keeps things interesting, and asked how Calvin was handling the pressure and staying motivated. Calvin said he started making music to follow his dreams, that he is stoked about how far he has come, and that collaborating with others, learning from them, and surrounding himself with positive energy and passion all help. Dave said this was a great plan, that good vibes and collaboration would give him a boost, and told him to keep going, saying "I'm your biggest fan." Calvin thanked him, said Dave's support meant a lot, and that he would keep pushing toward his goals. The two agreed to chat again soon and signed off with well wishes.

Maria and John are friends who reconnected on 17 December 2022 after a long gap. John had returned on 16 December 2022 from a family road trip. Their conversations are recorded across nine sessions, from December 2022 to 2 April 2023.

In the second session, on 22 December 2022 at 6:10 pm, Maria said it had been a few days since they last chatted. On 21 December 2022 she had donated her old car to the homeless shelter where she volunteers. John said the campaign had been interesting and that he had been networking to get people's input. He had recently talked with someone who shared some amazing stories, which fired up his passion for improving education in their area. He stressed that investing in future generations and giving them the right tools for success is the foundation of progress. Maria encouraged him, and he said her support motivates him. He shared a photo of his family having a picnic in the park and said they are the reason he never gives up. Their love gives him strength, helps him stay centered, and reminds him why he is passionate about making a positive impact. He called his family his rock in tough times and said family time means a lot to him. He then shared a photo of his family on a playground swing, saying they love climbing, sliding, and playing games together. Maria described her family as small but said she loves spending time with friends, usually watching movies, hiking, and hosting game nights at her place, and that quality connections matter most to her. John shared a photo of his family gathered at a kitchen table for dinner and said shared meals help them stay close. He then shared a photo of a table with pizzas and salads, explaining that the family had made pizza together and enjoyed picking toppings. Maria said she had recently made peach cobbler. John ended the session by saying he was off to do taekwondo, which he mentioned as a new activity separate from his kickboxing. Both agreed to keep cherishing time with loved ones.

In the third session, on 1 January 2023 at 8:30 pm, John said he had joined a service-focused online group the previous week, around late December 2022, and that it had been an emotional experience. Its members have inspiring stories, which opened his eyes to new perspectives and gave him a sense of connection and purpose. He shared a photo of a man sitting on a bed using a laptop, which seems to show someone in the group or the online setting. Maria called the news amazing and praised the supportive community. John said the group shares a passion for serving, and that members share stories, advice, and encouragement. When Maria asked whether he had met any members in person, he said the group had held events. They went to a homeless shelter to hand out food and supplies, and seeing people's smiles showed them they had made a real difference. He then shared a photo of a poster on a table with a Santa Claus, which fits the toy drive the group organized for children in need. John said it was wonderful to see the community come together to spread joy. Asked about future projects, he said the group is brainstorming ways to help underserved communities gain access to education, mentorship, job training, and resume building, to empower individuals to reach their aspirations. Maria said empowering people through education and mentorship is crucial, and John said the right assistance and resources can make a lasting impact. Maria agreed that a bit of support can make an amazing change. John then revealed that he had recently failed a military aptitude test, which left him feeling stressed, and said Maria's support means a lot to him. Maria reassured him that she has his back. She said nature's beauty reminds her to slow down and enjoy small things, and she shared a photo of a sunset over the ocean with a wave coming in, which she had taken at the beach in December 2022. Watching the sunset made her feel connected to nature and grateful for life's small moments. John said the picture was chill and recalled the film camera he had as a child, with which he took plenty of beach pictures. He said nature helps people remember small joys, especially when life gets busy. He ended the session by sharing a photo of a group of people standing around a field, without further comment.

In the fourth session, on 9 January 2023 at 7:06 pm, Maria said she had become friends with one of her fellow volunteers, and that they both love helping others. John said he had been busy with work and family, but in roughly the first week of January 2023 he had an unexpected incident on his way home, which reminded him how life can throw troubles at people. He shared a photo of a car with a broken windshield, and Maria said she was glad he was alright. He then shared a photo of a tattoo with a quote, saying it reminds him to stay strong in tough times. He handled the incident by staying calm and asking for assistance, which helped him get home safely. Maria praised his resilience and resourcefulness. John said he felt relieved and grateful to get through it without incident, and Maria encouraged him to appreciate what he has. Asked what he does to calm down, John said he likes to look at the sunset, which reminds him to enjoy small things. Maria then asked about his political goals. John had been keeping busy looking into local politics, talking to community leaders, and learning about the needs and hopes of his neighborhood. He found it very informative and said he feels optimistic. Maria praised his dedication and said she had been taking notes about local politics in her notebook, and she shared a photo of a notebook with a pencil and notepad on a table. John thanked her and said her notes gave him new ideas and plans for the community. He said he had a community meeting coming up the following week, in mid-January 2023, where education and infrastructure upgrades would be discussed, and he shared a photo of a microphone and a charger on a table. He said he will stand up for the community and that discussing these issues is important. Maria said speaking out is admirable and inspiring. John shared a photo of a group of people sitting around a table with a laptop, and Maria said working together as a team could bring positive changes to the neighborhood. He then shared a photo of a man and a woman shaking hands. Maria said unity is essential and that standing together lets them tackle any problems and build a great community. John thanked Maria for being an awesome friend and said her support means a lot. Maria replied that it is nice to help and that they make a great team, and John agreed that they rock as a team and that he is glad to have her.

In the fifth session, on 28 January 2023 at 1:17 pm, John said that since they last spoke he had attended the community meeting he had mentioned. He found hearing everyone's worries and how they affect the area very interesting. It made him realize how crucial the upgrades are, especially for the kids, and he said he is really upset by the state of local education. He shared a photo of a wooden floor against a white wall and asked Maria how they could make things better. Maria said they should fight for more money and resources for schools and raise awareness of the importance of education, which matters for all of us and not just children. John agreed that education is essential for a successful society and said it breaks his heart that kids lack the proper resources. Maria said children are the future and should have the best, and that it is not right that some kids get everything they need while others have nothing to help them succeed. John said his own kids have so much while others do not, and that they really need to do something about it. Maria then said that around 21 January 2023 she had volunteered at a shelter during an event for kids, which had been a great experience. She shared a photo of three women in green aprons holding pots and cups. John said this was making a big impact and asked what led her to get involved. Maria said she started volunteering to make a difference, and that her aunt, who believed in volunteering, used to help her family when they were struggling. Her aunt inspires her, and brightening someone's day makes her happy. John asked about the most impactful moment. Maria described a little girl of about 8 sitting alone and looking sad. Maria sat with her and learned the girl had no other family, which broke Maria's heart. Maria gave her comfort and a listening ear, and they ended up laughing and having a good time. John said it was a touching moment and shared a photo of a little girl kissing a doll, with the doll in her lap. He said the photo reminds him of a doll he had as a child that always made him feel better, and that it reminds him to always look out for others, especially when they feel down. Maria said spreading kindness and support can make a real difference, and John agreed that a kind gesture can change someone's day. Maria said kindness is key and that they are on the same page.

In the sixth session, on 5 February 2023 at 2:33 pm, Maria said she had challenged herself the previous Friday, around 3 February 2023, by taking part in a charity event. She found it great and heartwarming, and it made her feel the power of collective effort in helping people in need. John responded warmly and shared a photo of a woman handing a plate of food to a man. Maria said serving meals and seeing gratitude on people's faces was rewarding and reminded her how powerful compassion can be. At the event she had talked with a man named David, whose story of hardship and difficult circumstances humbled her and showed her that everyone has a story and deserves understanding. She shared a photo of a man with a cell phone in his hand. John asked whether she knew any organizations that could help him, and Maria said she had linked David, after their talk, with a nearby organization offering housing and support for homeless individuals, and hoped he would find the help he needed. She shared a photo of a flyer with a group of people in a circle. John praised her impact. Asked whether John had ever needed help himself, Maria said that when she was younger her family had money problems and relied on outside help from her aunt, which taught her the importance of helping others who struggle. She shared a photo of a woman in a face mask beside a table full of packages of food. John said we learn a lot from our own struggles and revealed that he had just started helping with a food drive for people who had lost their jobs. He shared a photo of himself at a food bank with a group of people and boxes of tomatoes. Seeing how unemployment affected their neighbors had led him to act, and he wanted to help in these tough times through a community food drive. He shared a photo of a Thanksgiving potluck and food drive flyer and said unemployment in the community was the reason behind the initiative. He then said the response had been overwhelming, with many volunteers, and shared a photo of a large group standing around a table and another of a woman in a face mask holding a bag of food. Maria said she would love to lend a hand with networking or at future events, and John gratefully accepted her offer. He shared a photo of a group of men working on a wall. Maria said she would always help whenever he needed it and shared a photo of a group of people standing outside a house. John said her support means a lot and thanked her for always being there. Maria said he is a great friend and that she will always be there for him. John said friendship means a lot to him, that they have each other's backs, and that they can work towards a shared goal. He ended the session with a photo of a group of people sitting in a park. Earlier in this session, when Maria asked what had got him into politics, John said he feels a strong urge to serve his country and community, and that running for office was his chance to make an impact. He did not say at the time whether he was currently running.

In the seventh session, on 25 February 2023 at 8:55 pm, Maria told John that the previous day, 24 February 2023, she had met an amazing woman named Jean at the homeless shelter. Jean had been through a lot yet stayed optimistic and resilient, and she showed Maria the importance of gratitude and connection. Maria shared a photo of a woman in a blue shirt with a ring on her neck. She explained that Jean had gone through a divorce, lost her job, and ended up homeless, yet still values the little things and believes in the good of kindness. John said it was inspiring to see someone stay optimistic even when things get tough, and Maria agreed that it is a reminder that we can still find joy and hope no matter what. John urged Maria to keep up the great work, saying a little kindness and optimism can go a long way and that her volunteer work sounds very influential. Both agreed that positivity and kindness make a difference and that they should keep spreading positivity and helping each other. John shared a photo of a man holding a child on his shoulders. Maria said she had recently taken a creative writing class that she found very enlightening. She asked whether he had anything fun coming up soon. John said nothing was too soon, but his colleague Rob had invited him to a beginner's yoga class. He had not yet scheduled it, but the class was still on his mind. In the same session John said he was running for office again. He called it a wild ride that has left him more excited than ever, and he shared a photo of a crowd of people sitting on a sidewalk with umbrellas. Maria asked what made him decide to run again. He said that after his last run he saw the impact he could make in the community through politics, and that it is rewarding to work toward positive changes and a better future.

In the eighth session, on 6 March 2023 at 6:03 pm, Maria said she had not talked to John in a while. The previous week her grandmother had passed away, and Maria said it had been really hard. She was trying to stay positive but finding it tough, and she shared a photo of a bride and groom walking down the street. John was sorry to hear about her loss and offered his support. He said he was doing well and had just had a picnic with his wife and kids, and he shared a photo of a family sitting on the grass with a baby. Maria asked the baby's name, and John said their one-year-old son is named Kyle. Asked what parenting has been like, John said it has been a wild ride full of ups and downs, but the love and happiness outweigh everything else. He shared a photo of two children playing on playground equipment. The family goes to the park a few times a week, which John said is great for family bonding and lets the kids run around. Last weekend they had a great time, and the kids enjoyed carefree joy. He shared a photo of a young girl and a young boy on a swing and said everyone got a turn. John said it is always fun coming up with activities for his family. He finds ideas by looking for things they will enjoy, such as a walk or picnic in the park, or events in their town and beyond. The week before, he had found a violin concert that the whole family enjoyed, and he said it is all about making memories together. Maria said she had loved doing something similar with her siblings when she was young. She shared a photo of a castle in a shadow box, which she said she made after a trip to England a few years earlier, where she was mesmerized by the castles. She wanted to bring that same magic home as a reminder of the world's beauty. She also made a painting, which she shared as a photo of a castle on a hill. When John asked where it was, Maria said it was in London, and that she wanted to recreate some of the charm of London's architecture and history in her own space. John said having symbols of travel memories at home is cool. He then said that the week before, he had retaken the aptitude test, got great results, and felt drawn to serving his country in this way. He shared a photo of a wooden sign with a flag and an eagle. He had talked it over with his family and friends, who have been supportive and understand why he wants to volunteer, and he said he is proud to have this opportunity. Maria said having people behind her has been great while she volunteers at the homeless shelter, and that positive influences make a big impact. She shared a photo of a group of people standing around a table with food. John praised the connections she has built and the impact she is making at the shelter. Maria explained that she formed those connections slowly by listening and showing compassion, and that building trust and real relationships is the key. She said the little things, like taking the time to hear what people are saying, often make the biggest difference. John agreed that making people feel noticed and listened to can make a real difference, and he shared a photo of a group of people sitting at a table with plates of food.

In the ninth session, on 2 April 2023 at 9:36 am, Maria said she had been taking a poetry class lately to help her put her feelings into words. She said it had been a rough ride but a good one, and asked how John had been. John said he had had quite the adventure since they last spoke, and he shared a photo of a certificate of completion of a university degree. Maria congratulated him, and John said he had graduated the previous week, around late March 2023. He said the journey was quite a process but definitely worth it. He said he is considering going into policymaking because of his degree and his passion for making a positive impact, and that there are many opportunities to make improvements. Improving education and infrastructure is still the area that interests him most. He said his experiences going to community meetings and getting involved in his community have given him a better understanding of the challenges facing education and infrastructure systems, and of the impact these issues have on neighbors, which highlights the need to work toward solutions. Maria praised his dedication. John said it is important to him to put his words into action and find solutions, and that even though it can be hard, it is rewarding to know he is making a difference. Maria agreed that it is satisfying and worthwhile. John said her support is encouraging and that he appreciates having her in his corner. Maria offered to help whenever he needs it, and they agreed that they work well together and that working together would be great. Maria then recalled that they had volunteered together the previous year, which she found a fulfilling experience. She shared a photo of a man and a woman shaking hands in front of a food tray. John remembered it and said it was cool to see how their actions can make a big impact, and that they should keep helping out and making things better. He ended the session by sharing a photo of a woman and a child walking in a park.

Across these sessions John's life has moved from the campaign trail toward graduation and a possible career in policymaking. In December 2022 he was networking for the campaign and balancing kickboxing, taekwondo, and family time. By early 2023 he had failed and then retaken a military aptitude test, passed it with strong results, and felt drawn to serve his country. He ran for office again by late February 2023, and by April he had finished a degree and was weighing policymaking. Maria's life over the same period has centred on volunteering at the homeless shelter, where she met people such as David and Jean and supported her fellow volunteers, along with her creative pursuits in writing and poetry. Her grandmother's death in late February 2023 was a difficult time for her, and she has leaned on the friends and family who have supported her. The two of them have consistently encouraged each other, and in April 2023 they both described themselves as a strong team that works well together.

Jon and Gina reconnected on 20 January 2023, shortly after both lost their jobs. Both use dance to relieve stress and favor contemporary dance. Jon has long wanted to start a dance studio. He invited Gina to see his moves "next Friday," and she replied "Let's boogie!" No session confirmed that the meetup happened.

Jon's dance crew won first place at a local competition in 2022, and he rehearses after work with a small group. He prefers Marley flooring for his hoped-for ocean-view studio. Gina once competed in several competitions, and her favorite memory is her team's first place at a regional contest at fifteen, performing "Finding Freedom."

In early February, a wholesaler agreed to work with Gina on her clothing store ad campaign. SUMMARY:
Andrew (a Financial Analyst at a new job since about March 2023) and Audrey have chatted periodically from late March 2023 through 26 June 2023, the most recent session. Their topics are pets, nature, hiking, and Andrew's search for a dog.

Audrey's dogs and life: She has had Pepper, Precious and Panda for 3 years as of March 2023. They are city dogs who explore often. In early April 2023 her family adopted a puppy, Pixie, who took a few days to fit in. Pepper took a while to warm up to her but now they are always together. By 11 May 2023 Audrey had four dogs. She calls them quick learners who love rewards, and says caring for them is fulfilling and keeps her busy. She takes them on road trips about once every couple of months. In early May she described a recent national park road trip. The dogs love hikes, new scents, fetch with a ball or frisbee, and doggie playdates at the park. She uses a safety item on them that looks funny but works, and they wear party hats for fun and treats. She has a tattoo of her dogs on her arm, representing her love for them and for nature. Walking them in the park recharges her, and she wants to see their happy faces even when they are apart. In early April she had not tried Fox Hollow yet because Pixie kept them busy. In early May she recommended a dog park beside the park they usually walk, with trees and benches. In April she made favorite treats and proposed a pastry party, which Andrew agreed to, with her dogs coming too. In May she signed up for a positive reinforcement training workshop on bonding with pets, held in June 2023. She saw the flyer at her local pet store, where she also met a friendly, playful dog. She says punishment is never the right way to train pets and that she could not bear to hurt them. In early June she took the dogs to the park, where they ran off-leash. She also described a national park peak hike with them, with a stunning sunset, and shared photos. Nature cheers her up and makes her grateful. On 2 June she offered to help Andrew find a dog-friendly spot if he emailed his criteria. On 13 June she said she had recently found a small park with a tree-lined trail for the dogs' walks, and invited Andrew to join. Their walks usually last about an hour, with the dogs exploring at their own pace. She shared photos of the dogs running with a ball and playing with a frisbee in a meadow. She says being outdoors with the dogs puts her in her happy place. On 26 June 2023 she said she had moved to a new house with a bigger backyard for the dogs, where they love the space to run and sniff new smells. She set up a doggy play area in the backyard with agility equipment and toys. She is still unpacking boxes. She shared a photo of two dogs on the grass in front of the house. She said she wants to take the dogs to the doggy daycare Andrew mentioned. She shared a photo of a rock overlooking a lake. She recalled a hike a few years back with friends, where they found a stunning mountain lake and sat by it, and she said the peace was exactly what she needed. She also said that people should appreciate the small things in life. She said she does not understand people who hate or hurt pets, and that pets are like family to people.

Andrew's life and interests: In March 2023 he said he had no pets but loves animals, and that eagles fascinate him. He recommended the Fox Hollow trail for weekend hikes. In early April he said his family has a dog, and he misses hiking with it. He was considering getting a dog but found it hard to find dog-friendly places in the city. In mid-April he and his girlfriend ("my girl") tried a new city cafe and enjoy finding new places to eat. They loved its croissants, muffins and tarts. He said city life makes it hard to get out into nature, where he feels most at home and connected. He agreed to the pastry party. In early May he had found a new open space to hike nearby and usually tries to escape the city at least once a weekend. He calls nature therapeutic. On 6 May he said he had been searching for a dog through websites, shelters and friends. As someone living in an apartment, he thinks a smaller dog would suit him, though an active dog would want to play and run. He is contacting landlords and checking neighborhoods for a pet-friendly place near a park or woods. He wishes he could road trip with a dog and added it to his bucket list. On 11 May he had a great hike with friends and his girlfriend at a spot they had recently found. He was almost convinced to take Audrey's training class and said he would look into classes. On 13 June he and friends took a rock climbing class on Sunday 11 June, and he reached the top. He is now "hooked" and wants to do outdoor activities every week. He has been encouraged to try kayaking and maybe bungee jumping. He shared a photo of the view from the top, and said the climb was tricky because he is still a newbie. He said friends supported him. He agreed to join Audrey and her dogs for a walk in the park. On 26 June 2023 he said that last Friday (23 June) he hiked with friends. The weather was great, and they took photos he has not yet gone through. He said he has been missing his connection with nature and the peace it brings, and is looking forward to exploring more. He shared photos of a doggy daycare near him with a large indoor play space, and of a flower bed in a park in his neighborhood. He offered to help Audrey find more dog places. He said not everyone shares their love for animals.

Status as of 26 June 2023 (latest): Audrey has moved to a new house with a bigger backyard, has set up a doggy play area, and is unpacking. She wants to try the doggy daycare Andrew suggested. Andrew hiked with friends on Friday 23 June and is missing nature. He is keen on more outdoor activities, including rock climbing, which he took up in June. His search for a dog and a pet-friendly place in the city was discouraging as of 2 June. He has not mentioned a dog or a new home since then, and no dog has been reported as adopted.

Deborah and Jolene are two women who have each lost their mothers. They have been chatting since 23 January 2023, when they first met, and have kept in touch across eight sessions so far. Deborah is a yoga teacher whose goal is to keep teaching and supporting her community. She is passionate about helping people find peace and joy through yoga, a practice that helped her through a rough time and inspired her to share it with others. Jolene is an electrical engineer whose mother passed away in 2022. She finished a demanding electrical engineering project in the week before their first chat. Later sessions describe her as still an engineering student balancing school, exams, and projects with her life outside class.

In the first session, on 23 January 2023 at 4:06 pm, Deborah said she had visited her late mother's old house, which holds many memories for her. Her mother had passed away a few years earlier. Deborah shared a photo of what she called their last photo together, showing her mother hugging her, with both of them in wheelchairs. Her mother had a special bench near the window where she liked to sit every morning and take in the view. Deborah sometimes sits on that bench herself because it helps her stay connected to her mother. She also has a pendant that reminds her of her mother. Deborah ended that session early, saying she had to run. Jolene shared a photo of her room in her mother's house, which has a bench and a window, and said she has many memories of that room. She wears a heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it, which her mother gave her in 2010 in Paris, and it reminds her of her mother. Her jewelry also has a symbol that represents freedom for her, a reminder to pursue her goals and not be held back. Jolene was enthusiastic about Deborah's yoga work and said she was looking forward to the next chat. Both women keep a physical connection to their mothers: Deborah through her mother's bench and pendant, and Jolene through her mother's room and pendant. Both have described a mother-linked bench and a pendant as meaningful keepsakes.

In the second session, on the morning of 27 January 2023 at 9:49 am, Deborah told Jolene that her father had passed away two days earlier, around 25 January. His sudden death left the whole family shell-shocked. Deborah said she was channeling her grief by spending more time with family and cherishing memories, which remind her to live life fully. She shared a photo of a woman hugging another woman seated on a couch. Jolene offered condolences and asked how the family was coping. Deborah said looking back on good memories is comforting, and that the family had been going through the family album. Photos give her peace in hard times. She shared a photo of her parents' wedding in 1993, a bride and groom posing together, and said she and her husband are trying to be as good a family as her parents were. When Jolene asked what she valued in her relationship, Deborah said love and openness have kept her and her husband close over the years, and that being there for each other has made them both happy. Deborah then shared a photo of a handwritten note she had received the day before from her group members, thanking her for the positive influence she had on them. She said moments like that remind her why she is so passionate about yoga.

Asked where she most often practices yoga, Deborah shared a photo of a living room with a television and a window. She said it is one of the places she practices, and that it is her old home, which she visits now and then for her mother, who has passed. Sitting in the spot by the window gives her peace, and she feels her mother's presence there, which comforts her. She then shared a photo of a window seat in a room with a window. Deborah said her mother would sit there every night with a book and a smile, since reading was one of her hobbies, and it was one of her favorite places in the house. SUMMARY

This memory covers 30 sessions between Calvin and Dave, running from late March 2023 to mid-November 2023. Both speakers are friendly and chatty, and most sessions open with a check-in and close with encouragement. Many messages include photos, and the photos are often described only in brackets, so some details below come from the spoken text rather than the images. Where the two speakers' accounts seem to conflict or the timeline is unclear, that is noted.

Calvin's story

In the first session, Calvin announced a big life change and shared a photo of a new mansion. He said he would be moving to Japan the following month, staying in a place his agent had found, and then going on to Boston. In late March he shared a photo of a red sports car after a ride, and he said he had written new tunes and held studio sessions. Over the spring and summer he described his professional life. In April he attended a music event in Tokyo, where he met artists and industry people and received advice from a producer to stay true to himself and sound unique. He said he was looking forward to a Boston trip after finishing a Frank Ocean tour. In May he reported that his home had been flooded, that he had saved his music gear and favorite microphone, and that insurance was needed before repairs could begin. He also mentioned an upcoming Tokyo performance that month, and he shared a gold necklace with a diamond pendant that another artist had given him. Later in May and early June, he described the Frank Ocean tour as wild, said the Tokyo crowd was insane, and mentioned meeting his creative team for his album.

Calvin also reported a car accident in June, saying no one was hurt and that the insurance and repair process took about a week. He later said the car was fixed and running well. In June he also shared a photo of a view from a small town in Japan and said he had not yet visited it. In July he mentioned collaborations with Japanese artists. In his messages he repeatedly described a project to transform his Japanese mansion into a recording studio, which he described as his sanctuary and dream. He said he had been experimenting with electronic elements in his songs. In August he mentioned taking his Ferrari in for service, which he found stressful because he was attached to it. He also said his plan was to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase. Later in August he reported that he had secured a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean, which he called a dream come true. He said the two had met at a Tokyo festival. He also said the tour was ending soon, that he was heading to Boston, and that he had recorded a podcast with friends about the rap industry.

In late August he said he had started shooting a video for his new album in Miami, on a beach he had picked. He also shared a photo of a custom guitar with an octopus design made by a Japanese artist friend. In early September he said he had booked a flight to Boston. On the 11th of September his album was released, which he described as a wild feeling. He then announced an upcoming tour and said he would go to explore and grow his brand afterward. In late September he said his trip to Japan had been incredible and that he was longing to go back. He also mentioned a childhood memory of a road trip with his dad listening to "California Love" by Tupac and Dr. Dre. Dave and Calvin discussed jamming together.

In early October Calvin said he had met incredible artists in Boston the previous day and talked about collaborating with them. Shortly after, on 15 October, he said he had recently bought a new Ferrari, calling it a masterpiece on wheels. In October he also said the tour with Frank Ocean had started and that he planned to go to Tokyo the month after the tour ended. He mentioned Shibuya Crossing and Shinjuku as places he wanted to see, and said he had not yet tried ramen. He described fame and touring as challenging, saying he relied on his friends and team for support. He said he was using his music to work through emotions, and said he had been inspired by people's struggles. On 25 October he said he had visited sights in Boston with a high school friend. Later, he mentioned a performance with someone he admired, which he called a dream come true.

In late October Calvin said his album was almost finished and that he would send previews. On 2 November he said he had thrown a party at his Japanese house for the album release, which had been a joyful event. Mid-November he said he had invited his old high school friend to see him perform in Boston and called the experience insane. He also said he had been supporting young musicians from a music program and was making beats for a young artist. On 17 November he said he had attended a gala in Boston the previous day and had made interesting connections. He then announced he had accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston, which he called an unforgettable musical experience.

Dave's story

Dave's messages describe a steady focus on cars, with an increasing emphasis on his own business and creative projects. In the first session, Dave talked about attending a classic car event and speaking with owners about their stories. He also mentioned spending time at a calm park and sharing a photo of it. In late March he said he had attended a music festival in Boston and that Aerosmith was his favorite act there. He described seeing them live and said he wished he had met them afterward, though he didn't.

In early May Dave said he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop. He said opening the shop had been a long-held dream and that it was a step toward his larger goal of working on classic cars and building a custom car from scratch someday. He described the shop as a place where he worked on everything from routine maintenance to full restorations. He mentioned he had restored a classic car the previous year. Around 3 May he said he was teaming up with a local garage and enjoying the work, and he mentioned an ongoing project. In mid-May he said he had opened the shop the previous week and had celebrated with friends. Dave gave Calvin advice about creative blocks, suggesting he immerse himself in things he loved, like concerts and favorite albums, and take a break from music.

In June Dave said he had booked a trip to a mountainous region for the following month and was looking forward to seeing the peaks. He also said he had been exploring parks on weekends to relax, and he described taking walks that recharged him for the week ahead. In late June he said he had recently joined a rock band and had been practicing guitar. In early July he said he had arranged regular walks in the park with friends. In late July he returned from a road trip with friends through stunning countryside, which he described as recharging him and reminding him why he loved cars.

In early August Dave shared that he had grown up working on cars with his dad and that refurbishing them gave him a sense of fulfillment. He recalled spending a summer restoring an old car together with his father. On 11 August he said he had been picked for a car mod workshop. In mid-August he described attending a car workshop in San Francisco, saying it was inspiring to see different restoration techniques. He said a restoration project was going well and expected to be finished by the end of the following month. In his later messages, Dave described working on a classic muscle car with engine swaps, suspension modifications, and body modifications, and said he was giving it a modern twist. He also said he had returned from San Francisco with insights on car modification to share.

In mid-September Dave shared a photo of his garage and invited Calvin to visit, and said he had attended a rock concert in Boston the previous weekend. He also shared a photo of a Coca-Cola sign in his garage. He said he and his band had been jamming, though they had not recorded the session. On 22 September he described a frustrating setback with a vintage Mustang, which made a strange noise after he thought he had fixed the engine. He later said he had found a Ford Mustang in a junkyard and was working to restore it.

In early October Dave said he had attended a car show the previous Friday, where he had seen cars and worked on mods. He described one of his cars as restored and modified with a custom exhaust and performance upgrades. He also talked about his childhood, when he spent hours in his dad's garage tinkering with engines. On 15 October he said a competing car maintenance shop had won a deal the two of them had been trying to secure for months, which left him discouraged. He asked whether he was wasting his time and Calvin encouraged him to keep going. Dave also said he had just attended a music festival, where the Fireworks headlined.

In late October Dave said he had attended a conference in Detroit, where he learned a lot. He described himself as an automotive engineer and said his interest in cars began when his dad took him to his first car show at age ten. He also said he had sold a restored car to a collector and was working on something new. Dave also mentioned he had been fascinated with machines since he was ten and had once fixed an old car he found in a neighbor's garage. He described concerts and talked about how music connects people. He also said he had recently had a good conversation with neighbors about current events and politics.

On 29 October Dave said he had been getting into photography and had taken photos of Boston, including a sunset shot of the clock tower. He also said his car project was finished and looked amazing. In early November he said he had started a blog about car mods and was getting attention from readers, including people who were inspired to start their own DIY projects. He shared photos of a restored blue car and described cleaning and polishing its headlights. He also said he had joined a rock band whose logo he had helped create, and described his home studio habits, including writing lyrics and listening to vinyl while working on cars. He mentioned enjoying classic rock. By mid-November Dave had taken up photography in earnest, sharing scenery pictures from a nearby park, a waterfall, and a sunset over rocks. He also bought a vintage camera that month and mentioned a Japanese garden spot he wanted to visit with Calvin.

Shared threads

Both speakers talk often about support and encouragement, and their conversations tend to end with mutual praise and promises to stay in touch. They share an interest in cars and music, and Dave repeatedly offered to show Calvin his garage and cars, while Calvin offered to visit Dave's shop. Dave expressed interest in visiting Japan, and Calvin repeatedly described his time there. Both discussed parks, walks, and relaxing activities. In several sessions they compared how their work, whether music or car restoration, produced a sense of fulfillment. Plans to meet in Boston came up repeatedly, starting with Dave offering to show Calvin around in April and recommending places such as Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park. The plans continued through Calvin's later Boston visits and performances. Calvin's most recent message says he has accepted a Boston performance invitation and looks forward to catching up with Dave when he is in Boston.

Timeline notes and inconsistencies

Several details are unclear or shift across sessions. Calvin's home is called a mansion in Japan in early messages, but in some later messages he also describes living in Japan and planning a Boston trip, and a Tokyo performance was mentioned several times. Dave said he opened his shop in early May and again in mid-May, which may refer to the same event described differently. The car Dave worked on in August was described as a restoration project due by the end of September, and later he described a classic muscle car project. Calvin's Ferrari appears in August as one he took for service, and again in October as a new purchase, so the timing of the purchase is unclear. Calvin also said in one session that he had never been to Boston, but later he described visiting Boston sights with a high school friend. Dave described attending a music festival in Boston in March and another in October. These differences are recorded as the speakers stated them.

Latest state

As of mid-November 2023, Calvin's album has been released and he is preparing for an upcoming performance in Boston. He recently said he has been supporting young musicians and that he is always busy with his music work. He has a new Ferrari and has been touring with Frank Ocean. Dave's most recent update is that he is photographing scenery, has started a car mod blog, is part of a rock band, and has finished restoring his car project. He said he has sold a previously restored car and is now focused on a new project. Both speakers said they hoped to meet up in Boston, and Dave said he would like to catch one of Calvin's shows there.
