Deborah then offered a method she uses when overloaded, which helps sort out what is important and urgent. Jolene did not know it, asked what it was about, and asked Deborah to explain. Deborah described the Eisenhower Matrix, which sorts tasks into four boxes according to urgency and importance, and shared a photo of a pair of scissors resting on a sheet of paper as a visual breakdown. Jolene said the visualization helped, and Deborah said she hoped it would help Jolene stay focused and less stressed. Jolene said she would give it a go and thanked her. Deborah reminded her to take it easy and look after herself. She then shared a moment from her own life: she and Anna had recently been sitting by the sea watching the sunset, talking about each other, and realized they inspire each other. Deborah said the experience matters as much as the end result, to take it step by step and have fun, and told Jolene she could do it. Jolene thanked her for the boost.

Taken together, the memory shows a steady arc. Deborah's grief over her mother and then her father, and her loss of a friend in February, sits alongside her yoga teaching, her new neighborhood class, her friendship with Anna, and her routines of meditation and jogging. Jolene's grief for her mother sits alongside her engineering work, from the robotics project and water purifier to her plans for a volunteer STEM program, her friendships and relationship with her partner, her snakes, and her growing efforts to manage stress and time. Across sessions, Jolene moved from sharing achievements toward asking for help with stress and organization, and Deborah moved from openly grieving to offering practical tools and encouragement. Several promises remain open: the mug Deborah pledged to send, the time-management conversation Jolene said she would schedule, Jolene's plan to try beach yoga in Bali, her hope to learn surfing, and Deborah's expanding neighborhood yoga work.

Session 6 (16 May 2023): A catch-up about two weeks later.
Calvin: His place was flooded the week before, but he saved his music gear and favorite microphone. He is waiting for insurance before repairs can start, and he is staying positive. He has an upcoming performance in Tokyo this month (May 2023) and hopes it will grow his following. He shared a photo of a Tokyo skyline taken the previous night.
Dave: He said he opened his car shop "last week" and invited friends to celebrate. This conflicts with Session 4, where he had already announced the shop, so the exact opening date is unclear. He wished Calvin luck with the Tokyo show.

Calvin: He had toured with Frank Ocean, and his Tokyo performance was "unreal," with an insane crowd. He said performing live "always fuels my soul." He said working on cars helps him chill, like meditating. He is excited to perform in Boston for people from home.
Dave: He shared a photo of a man fixing a car engine, saying it was his neighbor's car. Calvin later called it a friend's car, so the owner is inconsistent. He said Boston's music scene is awesome and promised to cheer Calvin on there.

Calvin: He met with the creative team for his album "yesterday" (8 June 2023) and said he is feeling stoked about it. He shared a photo of the recording studio. He has never been to Boston and said he "can't wait to visit next month" (July 2023). This does not match his earlier plan to go to Boston after the Frank Ocean tour. He wants to walk in the parks to recharge, has never been to the mountains, and wants to hike.
Dave: He shared a photo of a pond with a boat and said he has been exploring parks on weekends. He said the Boston parks are awesome in spring, and that he went for a stroll "last Friday" (2 June 2023). He has not hiked recently. He said: "I booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month!" (July 2023). Calvin asked him to take lots of pictures and show them when he returns, and Dave agreed.

Session 9 (21 June 2023): The most recent chat, about twelve days after Session 8.
Calvin: He had a minor car accident "last Friday" (16 June 2023). It was upsetting, but no one was hurt. He said the insurance process was a hassle with a lot of paperwork, but everything was sorted in about a week, and the cost was not too bad. He trusts the mechanic, who is "doing his best to get my car running again," and he is excited to drive again. He shared photos of his red car, a tow truck, the mechanic, and a small Japanese town with a mountain, seen from his living room. He has not been to that town yet and plans to visit after the Frank Ocean tour ends. He shared a photo of a person skiing and said he has never tried skiing but might give it a try.
Dave: He was sorry about the accident and glad nobody was hurt. He asked about the insurance process and said the repair work sounded great. He asked about the Japanese town and whether Calvin had been there. He said he recently joined a rock band, has been practicing guitar, and shared a photo of the band. He said he had to go and would see Calvin soon.

Nate and Joanna are friends who reconnected after a long gap. They share interests in movies, stories, and creative hobbies, and they often trade recommendations and photos.

Session 1 took place on 21 January 2022 at 7:31 pm. Joanna opened by saying she had been working on a project that was pretty cool, without naming it. Nate said he had won his first video game tournament the previous week, a team shooter called Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, and that he and his team had a blast to the very end. Joanna congratulated him but said she is not really into games. Nate's main hobbies are playing video games and watching movies. He especially loves action and sci-fi films, likes how their effects look, and enjoys classics. Joanna's hobbies are writing, reading, watching movies, and exploring nature. Her favorite genres are drama and romantic comedy, and she enjoys being immersed in a story's feelings and plots. They agreed they share similar interests. Joanna recommended a romantic drama about memory and relationships and sent a photo of its poster, which shows a man and a woman sitting on a bench. She did not name the film. She first watched it around 2019, bought a physical DVD copy, has watched it a few times, and considers it one of her favorites, especially for its idea and acting. Nate said he would check it out soon, and Joanna asked him to tell her whether he likes it. As of the latest session, there has been no follow-up on that recommendation.

Session 2 took place on 23 January 2022 at 2:01 pm. Joanna said they had not talked in a few days and that a lot had happened to her. She announced that she had finished her first full screenplay and printed it the previous Friday, around 21 January. She had been working on it for a while and felt relieved to have it done, and she shared a photo of a book with a page of text on it. The screenplay mixes drama and romance. It is probably the project she mentioned in Session 1, though she did not say so directly. She described a mix of relief, excitement, and some anxiety about finishing it. Her plan was to submit it to film festivals and hope producers and directors would check it out. Nate congratulated her and said he hoped they would love it.

In the same session, Nate said he likes having small pets around to keep him calm when things are important and he is nervous. He shared a photo of a turtle and a baby turtle sitting on a rock. He has had them for 3 years, and they bring him a lot of joy. He said both have big personalities and recommended a pet like this for stressful times. Joanna said she would think about getting pets of her own soon, if she can find ones she is not allergic to. Joanna has a serious allergy to animals. She is allergic to most reptiles and to animals with fur, and around them her face gets puffy and itchy, so she has always stayed away from them. She said this can be a drag but that she finds other ways to be happy. Her main sources of joy are writing and hanging out with friends. Writing lets her express herself through stories and create wild worlds with awesome characters, and she said it is a great way to express her feelings. She cannot imagine life without it and plans to keep pursuing it, since it means a lot to her. Nate said he is glad she has other ways to get through anxious times despite not being able to have animals. Nate also said that at the tournament he started hanging out with people outside his usual circle, whom he finds pretty cool. He said some competitors are more competitive than others, so he tends to stick with the more relaxed players. When Joanna asked whether he would cheer for them even if he lost, Nate said yes. He does not expect to win big and just likes playing for fun. Nate asked how bad her allergies are, which led to the details above.

Session 3 took place on 7 February 2022 at 9:27 am. Joanna said the screenplay she had sent to a film festival had been on her mind all day, every day. She kept bouncing between relief, excitement, and worry, and she hoped a producer or director would fall in love with it and get it onto the big screen. So by this date she had submitted the screenplay to a film festival. Nate offered support and said he hoped someone would like it enough to put it on the big screen. Joanna thanked him and said she had put a lot of effort into it. Nate said not much had changed for him, but he had just discovered that he could make coconut milk ice cream and had tried it. He shared a photo of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon in it. He said it was pretty good and that he was proud of himself. Joanna said it looked delicious. Nate described it as rich and creamy and said it might become his new favorite snack. He said he would make it again and wanted to try different flavors and toppings. When Joanna asked about his favorite flavors for dairy-free desserts, he said he loves coconut milk and also enjoys chocolate and mixed berry flavors. Joanna said she was tempted to try dairy-free flavors and shared a photo of a piece of cake with berries on a plate. Nate said he had made a dairy-free chocolate cake with berries on top the other day and thought she might like it. Joanna called it yummy and said she should try making one or come over to try one herself. Nate said he enjoys experimenting in the kitchen. Joanna then asked whether he had seen any good movies lately. He had not recently and asked for recommendations. Joanna said she had just watched "Little Women," which she called amazing, a great story about sisterhood, love, and reaching for your dreams, and a must-see. Nate said he would add it to his list. Joanna said she is always happy to give movie recommendations. Nate said he would let her know whenever he runs out of things to watch, and Joanna asked him to tell her what he thinks of "Little Women" when he finishes it. Nate promised she would be the first to know. The session ended with friendly goodbyes. Nate has not yet confirmed whether he watched the romantic drama Joanna recommended in Session 1, and the recommendation remains open.

John and James have been chatting since Thursday, 17 March 2022. Their conversations cover gaming, programming, pets, hobbies, travel, work, and shared plans. Across eight sessions, the most recent on Friday, 29 April 2022, they have stayed friendly and supportive, often encouraging each other through challenges and sharing photos.

In their first conversation, on Thursday, 17 March 2022 at 3:47 pm, John said he was glad to finally talk with James. James said video games keep him motivated because they bring him joy and excitement, and John said games help him relax after a long day. James was absorbed in The Witcher 3, which he praised for its story and atmosphere. John had not played it yet but planned to. John had just signed up for a programming class, having done some HTML and CSS a few years earlier, and he wanted to refresh those skills. James said he first tried programming in college and that it is now central to his life. He has worked with Python and C++, has built a website, and has created game mods, and he shared a photo of a mod's game scene. He has not used other languages but hopes to in the future. John suggested they might someday develop mobile applications together, and James liked the idea. James has two dogs, Max and Daisy, and he shared a photo of them tied to a fence. He proposed an app for dog walking and pet care that would connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and offer helpful pet-care information. Its distinguishing feature is a personal touch: users enter their pet's preferences and needs so the app feels customized for each owner and pet. He shared a photo of a handwritten note on a notepad related to this idea. James finds deep satisfaction in creating something and seeing it come to life. He writes his goals in a notebook and enjoys checking them off, and he shared a photo of himself holding the notebook. He is working on a computer game based on characters he sketched as a child, when he drew comics. He wants to combine his two favorite passions, gaming and storytelling, and he finds the challenge enjoyable. He promised to keep John updated and said he might later invite John to help with HTML for the game, which John agreed to and said he looked forward to. John also shared a photo of a medical chart with procedure instructions, which was not explained.

During that first conversation they also discussed the previous day, 16 March 2022. James had gone bowling and got two strikes, and he said he loves bowling. John said he does not enjoy bowling and cannot bowl well because his fingers are too big, and he said he might start running in the mornings for exercise. James was sorry they could not bowl together, so John suggested slot machines and arcades instead. James said he once got so absorbed in slot machines that someone pickpocketed his wallet, and John joked that he would watch James's pockets. John suggested VR gaming, which he had tried a few times and found very immersive, and James said it feels remarkably real. They agreed to try VR together "next Saturday." Since the first conversation was on Thursday, 17 March 2022, this could mean Saturday 19 March or Saturday 26 March, and the conversations do not settle which.

In a second conversation on 20 March 2022 at 9:26 pm, James said that since they last talked he had made a game avatar and joined a new online platform. He said exploring it and chatting with other gamers feels like a new adventure each time and makes him part of a super cool online community. Gamers there share tips, strategies, and stories, and James said gaming is their shared language and passion and has been a refuge for him in tough times. He said games are his go-to when he feels overwhelmed, that they work like therapy, and that they let him relax, forget his troubles, and get lost in another world. John said gaming also helps him escape stress and calms him during hard times. When John asked about new interests, James said he had been trying different styles of games, enjoying something fresh and testing himself in other ways. John said his new hobby is metal detecting, which he does by walking along beaches with a metal detector he recently bought. So far he has found mostly bottle caps, a couple of coins, and once a gold ring. James wished him good luck. James then shared photos of his two dogs, which he calls his best buddies and says are the best pals ever. One photo shows them running in a field with a ball in their mouths. He said they can do tricks such as sit, stay, paw, and rollover, that he has trained them, and that they learn quickly. He also shared a photo of Daisy waiting for a treat and a photo of a dog lying on a bed with a name tag, and he described the dogs as like family. John said he wants a pet very much but is not there yet, and he hopes to have one someday. James said a pet would be great for John and offered to help him find the perfect one. John thanked him and said he would keep the offer in mind, and James said to let him know whenever John needs help.

In a third conversation on 27 March 2022 at 12:40 am, John said he had recently had a big win in his game the previous week, advancing to the next level, which boosted his confidence and made him feel he had achieved something. James said he was challenging himself by learning a musical instrument, which he described as quite the journey, and he shared a photo of a drum kit with a white drum and a black drum. John said he also plays drums and shared a photo of his own drum set sitting on a table. John said he had been playing for a month and found it tough but fun. James said he had started only a few days earlier, was practicing daily, and was seeing improvements, calling it tough but rewarding. James did not name the instrument in the conversation, but he shared a drum kit photo. John said that since they last spoke he had attended a gaming convention, where he tried many games, met developers, and took part in a tournament. He shared a photo of a crowded convention hall. He said he competed in an intense tournament playing his favorite game, CS:GO, and was inspired by watching skilled players, which motivated him to improve his own skills. James said he had recently got a new cutting-edge gaming system with incredible graphics, had been playing all kinds of new games as a way to relax after work, and enjoyed connecting with friends who share his passion for gaming. James said he stays motivated by setting small goals and tracking his progress. He said he was now getting into different kinds of games, especially RPGs and strategy games, and was excited to explore new genres. John said he tries to keep up his commitment to his hobbies and other goals, and he asked James to update him on his adventures with the new genres. James agreed to keep him updated, and they ended the conversation with a goodbye.

In a fourth conversation on 4 April 2022 at 2:13 pm, John opened by asking what was new and whether James had been playing any new games, and James said he had been busy. James said that the day before, on 3 April 2022, he had joined an online gaming tournament, which he found very intense and fun, and he shared a group photo from it. He said he did pretty well, made it to the semifinals, and won some rounds, and he shared a screenshot of his character. The final rounds were tough and he did not make it, but he said it was close and that he had a blast competing with talented players and was looking forward to the next tournament. James said he met the whole team and regretted not getting a photo with them, but one member gave him a couple of gaming tips, which John said would help his development. The team also gave James autographs, which made him very happy, and he shared a photo of a notepad and pen. The most important advice James remembered was that you always need to communicate correctly with the team and never put your ego above team success. John agreed that communication and teamwork are essential in gaming. James said he usually communicates with his team through voice chat, which he finds fast and effective. His favourite game, which he plays with his team, is Apex Legends, and he described it as intense, with awesome graphics and super fast-paced gameplay that makes it stand out among other games. He shared a screenshot of his team playing it. James said he is always excited to try new games and was thinking of trying RPGs or MOBAs, and he shared a photo of a game cover. John said RPGs and MOBAs can offer an engaging story or epic multiplayer fights, and he asked James to let him know how he likes them. James agreed to share his thoughts once he tries them and to keep John updated on all the new games. They said goodbye, and John told James to stay safe.

In a fifth conversation on Tuesday, 12 April 2022 at 9:52 am, James said he had adopted a pup from a shelter in Stamford the previous week and that his days had been much happier with him in the family. He named the pup Ned and shared a photo of a dog and a cat sitting on a dog bed. He asked about John's gaming goals. John said he had not made much progress lately because work and other things had been busy, but he said gaming is a good way to forget life's stresses. James said gaming helps people forget stress and likened it to heading into another world. John said he was playing a new RPG with a very cool story and world, which he compared to being transported to a futuristic dystopia, and he shared a photo of a city at night. James asked whether he would like it, and John said he would love it, citing its fun story, awesome world, and tough gameplay. John warned that the game was a little laggy and sometimes produced errors, and he shared a photo of a computer screen showing one error he had come across the day before. James said the game must still be raw and that he would rather wait until the bugs were fixed. John said the graphics looked great and the gameplay was super immersive, and he offered to send James a link. James agreed to wait for the link and to try the game, and he said he would tell John what he thought. They said goodbye.

Jon and Gina reconnected on 20 January 2023, shortly after both lost their jobs. Both use dance to relieve stress and favor contemporary dance. Jon has long wanted an ocean-view dance studio with Marley flooring, and his crew won first place at a local competition in 2022. He invited Gina to see his moves "next Friday," and she replied "Let's boogie!" No later session confirmed that the meetup happened. Gina's favorite memory is her team's first-place finish at a regional contest when she was fifteen.

Gina's business has grown in stages. In early February 2023 a wholesaler agreed to an ad campaign with her, and on 16 March she announced her online clothing store was open. On 10 May she mentioned a design internship interview, with no outcome recorded. On 27 May she said she had been accepted for a part-time fashion department position at an international company, feeling excited but nervous, and she has not mentioned it since. On 13 June she promised to send a video presentation on styling her fashion pieces, which has not been confirmed as sent. On 21 June she shared photos of a black hoodie from her own limited edition line and a camouflage-print hoodie, and encouraged Jon to never give up. In the latest session, on 9 July 2023, she said fashion editors had noticed her the previous week, which she called amazing but scary.

Jon's studio story shifted over time. On 8 February he spoke of his festival performance as if he already ran a studio, which conflicted with earlier sessions. On 16 March he mentioned students for the first time, leaving the claim uncertain. On 3 April he said he had closed his bank account to focus on his business and was offering school workshops. On 25 April he reported some fair leads but low confidence and struggled with motivation. On 27 May he was finishing a business plan and prepared for a May competition whose outcome is not recorded. On 13 June he described preparing his studio, working with young dancers, and offering classes and mentoring. On 19 June he said his studio's official opening was the next day, 20 June, and Gina promised to attend. In the 21 June session he said he had attended networking events, which he called tough but worthwhile, and he felt confident. He did not mention whether Gina attended the opening, so that event remains unconfirmed.

In the 9 July session Jon said he was going full-time with his business, had started learning marketing and analytics tools, and was excited to mentor aspiring dancers. Gina praised him and encouraged him repeatedly. Neither mentioned the studio opening, his location, or Gina's internship or promised video.

As of 9 July 2023, Jon has performed at a February festival, prepared for a May competition with an unrecorded outcome, and says his studio opened on 20 June. Whether he has a permanent location remains unclear, and his finances and investor situation are uncertain. Gina plans to attend his events, has grown her online business, and now reports attention from fashion editors. Her part-time fashion internship has unclear status, and her promised video presentation has not been confirmed as sent.

Nate and Joanna are friends who reconnected after a long gap. They share interests in movies, stories, and creative hobbies, and they often trade recommendations, recipes, and photos. They have been warm and encouraging with each other, and their conversations move between their creative work, food, pets, and small personal updates.

Session 1 took place on 21 January 2022 at 7:31 pm. Joanna opened by saying she had been working on a project that was pretty cool, without naming it. Nate said he had won his first video game tournament the previous week, a team shooter called Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, and that he and his team had a blast to the very end. Joanna congratulated him but said she is not really into games. Nate's main hobbies are playing video games and watching movies. He especially loves action and sci-fi films, likes how their effects look, and enjoys classics. Joanna's hobbies are writing, reading, watching movies, and exploring nature. Her favorite genres are drama and romantic comedy, and she enjoys being immersed in a story's feelings and plots. They agreed they share similar interests. Joanna recommended a romantic drama about memory and relationships and sent a photo of its poster, which shows a man and a woman sitting on a bench. She did not name the film. She first watched it around 2019, bought a physical DVD copy, has watched it a few times, and considers it one of her favorites, especially for its idea and acting. Nate said he would check it out soon, and Joanna asked him to tell her whether he likes it. Nate has not confirmed whether he watched it, so the recommendation remains open.

Session 2 took place on 23 January 2022 at 2:01 pm. Joanna said they had not talked in a few days and that a lot had happened to her. She announced that she had finished her first full screenplay and printed it the previous Friday, around 21 January. She had been working on it for a while and felt relieved to have it done, and she shared a photo of a book with a page of text on it. The screenplay mixes drama and romance. It is probably the project she mentioned in Session 1, though she did not say so directly. She described a mix of relief, excitement, and some anxiety about finishing it. Her plan was to submit it to film festivals and hope producers and directors would check it out. Nate congratulated her and said he hoped they would love it.

In the same session, Nate said he likes having small pets around to keep him calm when things are important and he is nervous. He shared a photo of a turtle and a baby turtle sitting on a rock. He has had them for 3 years, and they bring him a lot of joy. He said both have big personalities and recommended a pet like this for stressful times. Joanna said she would think about getting pets of her own soon, if she can find ones she is not allergic to. Joanna has a serious allergy to animals. She is allergic to most reptiles and to animals with fur, and around them her face gets puffy and itchy, so she has always stayed away from them. She said this can be a drag but that she finds other ways to be happy. Her main sources of joy are writing and hanging out with friends. Writing lets her express herself through stories and create wild worlds with awesome characters, and she said it is a great way to express her feelings. She cannot imagine life without it and plans to keep pursuing it, since it means a lot to her. Nate said he is glad she has other ways to get through anxious times despite not being able to have animals. Nate also said that at the tournament he started hanging out with people outside his usual circle, whom he finds pretty cool. He said some competitors are more competitive than others, so he tends to stick with the more relaxed players. When Joanna asked whether he would cheer for them even if he lost, Nate said yes. He does not expect to win big and just likes playing for fun. Nate asked how bad her allergies are, which led to the details above.

Session 3 took place on 7 February 2022 at 9:27 am. Joanna said the screenplay she had sent to a film festival had been on her mind all day, every day. She kept bouncing between relief, excitement, and worry, and she hoped a producer or director would fall in love with it and get it onto the big screen. So by this date she had submitted the screenplay to a film festival. Nate offered support and said he hoped someone would like it enough to put it on the big screen. Joanna thanked him and said she had put a lot of effort into it. Nate said not much had changed for him, but he had just discovered that he could make coconut milk ice cream and had tried it. He shared a photo of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon in it. He said it was pretty good and that he was proud of himself. Joanna said it looked delicious. Nate described it as rich and creamy and said it might become his new favorite snack. He said he would make it again and wanted to try different flavors and toppings. When Joanna asked about his favorite flavors for dairy-free desserts, he said he loves coconut milk and also enjoys chocolate and mixed berry flavors. Joanna said she was tempted to try dairy-free flavors and shared a photo of a piece of cake with berries on a plate. Nate said he had made a dairy-free chocolate cake with berries on top the other day and thought she might like it. Joanna called it yummy and said she should try making one or come over to try one herself. Nate said he enjoys experimenting in the kitchen. Joanna then asked whether he had seen any good movies lately. He had not recently and asked for recommendations. Joanna said she had just watched "Little Women," which she called amazing, a great story about sisterhood, love, and reaching for your dreams, and a must-see. Nate said he would add it to his list. Joanna said she is always happy to give movie recommendations. Nate said he would let her know whenever he runs out of things to watch, and Joanna asked him to tell her what he thinks of "Little Women" when he finishes it. Nate promised she would be the first to know. The session ended with friendly goodbyes. Nate has not yet confirmed whether he watched "Little Women" or the romantic drama Joanna recommended in Session 1, and both recommendations remain open.

Session 4 took place on 25 February 2022 at 1:07 pm. Nate apologized for not being around lately and said he had made ice cream for a friend, who loved it. He said he had whipped up a chocolate and vanilla swirl and shared a photo of a person holding a chocolate and vanilla ice cream cone. Joanna said it looked delicious but that she cannot have dairy, so she could not eat ice cream, and she asked whether he had a dairy-free recipe she could try. This is a different restriction from her animal allergy and was not mentioned in earlier sessions, where she had only said she was tempted to try dairy-free flavors. Nate offered a recipe he knows that uses coconut milk and asked whether she wanted it sent to her. Joanna said yes, she was keen to try it and is always up for something sweet. Nate said he would send it. Joanna said she would keep him posted on what she thinks, and she complimented his creations. Nate said it meant a lot that she enjoys the desserts he bakes. The transcript does not show that he actually sent the recipe, so it is still pending as far as the record goes. Joanna then shared that she cannot stop thinking about the screenplay and has started writing a second one while she waits to hear back about how the first one did. This means the first screenplay had not yet received a result by late February. Nate said that taking her mind off something like that is very challenging and asked what the new one is about. Joanna said it is about a thirty-year-old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss, somewhat similar to the first screenplay. She explained that it is her own story, inspired by personal experiences and her own journey of self-discovery. The main character deals with loss and with figuring out who they are, and they take a road trip to heal and grow. Nate called it a deep topic, said he loves stories that tackle important issues, and said it takes guts. He said he cannot wait to see it come together and is also eager to see how the first screenplay does. Joanna thanked him for his support and said she is hoping her screenplay gets noticed and makes it to the screen. Nate said he is crossing his fingers and hopes the screenplay finds a fan and gets its due.

Session 5 took place on 18 March 2022 at 6:59 pm. Joanna said it had been a while and that she had wrapped up her second script. She described mixed feelings: sometimes relief, and other times anxiety about what comes next, a blend of excitement and terror about her work getting noticed and reaching the big screen. Nate congratulated her on finishing the second one and said her hard work and dedication would get noticed. Joanna said she had been decompressing but finds it hard to switch off, with a constant tug-of-war between hope and doubt. Nate said doubts are normal and encouraged her to believe in herself. He then shared a photo of two tortoises lying on the ground in a jungle, saying that walking them always reminds him to enjoy the small stuff. Joanna said they looked relaxed and asked what made him choose them as pets. Nate said he is drawn to turtles because they are unique, their slow pace is a nice change from the rush of life, and they are low-maintenance and calming. He shared a second photo, of three turtles sitting on rocks in a pond. Note that this differs from Session 2, where he described two turtles, one adult and one baby, that he had kept for 3 years, and the session also mentions walking "them" without clarifying the animal. Joanna asked whether caring for them is tough. Nate said it is not, that they just need their area kept clean, proper feeding, and enough light, and that it is actually kind of fun. Joanna said she wished she were not allergic and would get two turtles today if she could. She also said she had recently found out she is allergic to cockroaches, so she is unsure whether she will ever have a pet. Nate apologized, suggested she might consider other animals, and offered to send her pictures of his turtles so she could watch them grow without getting too close. Joanna liked the idea and said she was already invested in them. Nate asked about the next steps for her script. Joanna said she had been doing a lot of research and networking for it, which is tough but something she is determined to make happen. Nate encouraged her to keep going and said that would hopefully get more eyes on the script. Joanna said his support means a lot and that having someone to support her through the process gives her the motivation to keep pushing. Nate told her not to quit and said the path forward would show up soon. He said he was there for her. Joanna ended the session with a photo of a cinema ticket on a chair and said goodbye. She did not say whether she has heard back about the first screenplay, and the record still does not show any result for it.

Open items as of the latest session: Nate has not confirmed whether he watched the romantic drama Joanna recommended in Session 1 or "Little Women" from Session 3. He has not confirmed sending the dairy-free coconut milk recipe promised in Session 4, which Joanna requested because of her dairy restriction. He has offered to send Joanna pictures of his turtles, and the record does not show that he has yet. Joanna has submitted her first screenplay to a film festival and is awaiting news, and she has finished a second screenplay and is researching and networking to get both noticed.

Jon and Gina are friends who catch up in person and by message, and both love dance. Both lost their jobs in January 2023 and turned to building their own businesses. Across fourteen sessions from January to 16 June 2023, their conversations have stayed warm and encouraging, and each has been a steady source of support for the other. Session 14, on the evening of 16 June, was the first since 13 June.

Jon lost his job as a banker on 19 January 2023 and decided to start a dance studio. He has loved dance since childhood and sees it as both his passion and his escape. His favorite style is contemporary, though he enjoys all styles. His ideal studio is a space by the water with an ocean view and yoga mats, but he has not found it. On 8 February he said leaving his secure job had pushed him to grow, though the path "ain't been a walk in the park." On 11 May he called the studio a dream he is finally pursuing and said dance is his stress-buster. On 27 May he said he was wrapping up his business plan and seeking investors, and that the search had been tough but he stayed hopeful.

Jon's location search has been a major thread. On 29 January he found a downtown place with great natural light, but he still needed to check its size and floor quality. He wants a bouncy Marley floor for safe movement. No location has been confirmed in any session. On 13 June he said he was prepping for his studio "more than ever," that "opening the dance studio's been a great experience," and he spoke of "our young dancers." These words could mean the studio is running in some form, but no venue, opening date, or investor outcome was ever named, so whether a studio is open remains unclear. That session he also described planned classes, workshops, and one-on-one mentoring, plus organizational tools including a whiteboard, color-coded progress, and a cork board of pictures and words.

In session 14, Jon said he had been mentored by an experienced business person on 15 June and found it inspiring. He described "doing some promotion" and called the process a crazy ride he was hanging in there through. When he asked Gina for marketing tips, she recommended social media and working with influencers. Jon said he had started posting some of his dance videos online and that they were creating a bit of a stir. Whether the mentorship led to concrete plans was not stated. Jon then asked whether Gina had thought about being an entrepreneur. She said she had been one since losing her job, and that her online clothing store had been great. For someone just starting out, she advised staying passionate, focused, and resilient, and staying open to learning. She also shared an old photo from her dancing days, and Jon said it reminded him how much he loves performing.

Jon dances with a small crew he rehearses with after work, performing everything from contemporary to hip-hop. The crew won first place in a local competition in 2022. In February 2023 he prepared choreography for dancers at a nearby festival, which went well. On 4 February he mentioned a March 2023 competition near him, but nothing confirms he entered. On 3 April he said he would host his own competition the following month to showcase local talent, and he invited Gina, who said she was definitely coming. Later sessions never mentioned it, so whether it happened is unknown. On 11 May Jon offered to send Gina a video of his routines, which she agreed to watch, but the video has not been mentioned since. On 25 April he said he had gone to a fair to show off his studio and got some possible leads, though whether they became deals was never stated.

Gina also lost her job at DoorDash in January 2023. She used to compete in dance competitions and shows, and her favorite memory is her team's first place at a regional competition when she was fifteen, performing a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom." Dance is her main stress reliever, which she said on 11 May is "like air" to her. Rather than look for another job, she started her own clothing business. On 1 February a wholesaler agreed to work with her, and by 16 March her online store was open, though whether a physical store has expanded is not stated. On 3 April her new offers were bringing more sales. On 27 May she said she had been accepted for a part-time fashion internship at an international company, and she felt a mix of excitement and nerves. On 13 June she made a video presentation on styling her fashion pieces and promised to send it to Jon. On 16 June she said growing her customer base was tough but going well.

The two have encouraged each other throughout. On 8 February Gina urged Jon not to stop dreaming. On 16 March Jon said Gina's success inspired him. On 23 March he said he was "gonna make it happen," and when Gina asked for business advice, he suggested a strong brand identity and staying positive. On 25 April, after Jon admitted he sometimes felt low on confidence, Gina advised him to keep his big goal in mind and lean on supporters. On 27 May, when Jon felt discouraged, Gina encouraged him to keep learning. On 13 June she urged him not to quit on his dreams. On 16 June Jon said her encouragement keeps him going, and Gina answered that his determination and passion for dance are inspiring.

Both have been working toward their goals while leaning on each other. Gina's love of contemporary dance remains central to her identity, and her online store remains her main venture while she prepares for her internship. Jon's dance life remains active, and he now describes himself as promoting his business and building an online presence. His studio's status is still uncertain: he speaks as though it is running and has young dancers, but no confirmed location has ever been named, and as of 27 May he was still seeking investors.

Open questions include whether Jon's studio has a physical home and is actually open, whether investors will come through, whether the mentorship led to concrete changes, whether the fair leads became business, whether he entered the March 2023 competition, whether his May competition took place, whether the video routine was sent, whether Gina's presentation reached Jon, whether her clothing business continues alongside her internship, and whether her physical store has expanded.

Nate said he had won his first video game tournament the previous week, a team shooter called Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, and that he and his team had a blast to the very end. Joanna congratulated him but said she is not really into games. Nate's main hobbies are playing video games and watching movies. He especially loves action and sci-fi films, likes how their effects look, and enjoys classics. Joanna's hobbies are writing, reading, watching movies, and exploring nature. Her favorite genres are drama and romantic comedy, and she enjoys being immersed in a story's feelings and plots. They agreed they share similar interests. Joanna recommended a romantic drama about memory and relationships and sent a photo of its poster, which shows a man and a woman sitting on a bench. She did not name the film. She first watched it around 2019, bought a physical DVD copy, has watched it a few times, and considers it one of her favorites, especially for its idea and acting. Nate said he would check it out soon, and Joanna asked him to tell her whether he likes it. Nate has not confirmed whether he watched it, so the recommendation remains open.

Session 2 took place on 23 January 2022 at 2:01 pm. Joanna said they had not talked in a few days and that a lot had happened to her. She announced that she had finished her first full screenplay and printed it the previous Friday, around 21 January. She had been working on it for a while and felt relieved to have it done, and she shared a photo of a book with a page of text on it. The screenplay mixes drama and romance. It is probably the project she mentioned in Session 1, though she did not say so directly. She described a mix of relief, excitement, and some anxiety about finishing it. Her plan was to submit it to film festivals and hope producers and directors would check it out. Nate congratulated her and said he hoped they would love it.

In the same session, Nate said he likes having small pets around to keep him calm when things are important and he is nervous. He shared a photo of a turtle and a baby turtle sitting on a rock. He has had them for 3 years, and they bring him a lot of joy. He said both have big personalities and recommended a pet like this for stressful times. Joanna said she would think about getting pets of her own soon, if she can find ones she is not allergic to. Joanna has a serious allergy to animals. She is allergic to most reptiles and to animals with fur, and around them her face gets puffy and itchy, so she has always stayed away from them. She said this can be a drag but that she finds other ways to be happy. Her main sources of joy are writing and hanging out with friends. Writing lets her express herself through stories and create wild worlds with awesome characters, and she said it is a great way to express her feelings. She cannot imagine life without it and plans to keep pursuing it, since it means a lot to her. Nate said he is glad she has other ways to get through anxious times despite not being able to have animals. Nate also said that at the tournament he started hanging out with people outside his usual circle, whom he finds pretty cool. He said some competitors are more competitive than others, so he tends to stick with the more relaxed players. When Joanna asked whether he would cheer for them even if he lost, Nate said yes. He does not expect to win big and just likes playing for fun. Nate asked how bad her allergies are, which led to the details above.

John and James have been chatting since Thursday, 17 March 2022, across nine sessions, the most recent on Wednesday, 4 May 2022. They have stayed friendly and supportive, often encouraging each other through challenges, sharing photos, and talking about gaming, programming, pets, travel, and plans for the future.

He shared a photo of a handwritten note on a notepad related to this idea. James finds deep satisfaction in creating something and seeing it come to life. He writes his goals in a notebook and enjoys checking them off, and he shared a photo of himself holding the notebook. He is working on a computer game based on characters he sketched as a child, when he drew comics. He wants to combine his two favorite passions, gaming and storytelling, and he finds the challenge enjoyable. He promised to keep John updated and said he might later invite John to help with HTML for the game, which John agreed to and said he looked forward to. John also shared a photo of a medical chart with procedure instructions, which was not explained.

Nate said his main hobbies were playing video games and watching movies, especially action and sci-fi films with cool effects. Joanna said she preferred dramas and romantic comedies because she likes getting immersed in feelings and plots. She recommended a romantic drama about memory and relationships, shared a poster photo, and said she had first watched it about three years earlier and owned a physical DVD copy. She said she had watched it several times and liked both its idea and its acting. Nate said he loves classic films and planned to watch it soon.

On 23 January 2022, Joanna said she had finished her first full screenplay, a mix of drama and romance, and had printed it the previous Friday. She shared a photo of a printed page, and said it was a relief to have it done. She planned to submit it to film festivals and hoped producers and directors would notice it. Nate shared a photo of his two turtles, a turtle and a young one, and said he had owned them for three years. He said they calmed him during stressful moments and recommended having a small pet for stressful times. Joanna said she might get a pet of her own if she could find one she was not allergic to. Nate also said he had started hanging out with people outside his usual circle at tournaments, and that he preferred the more relaxed players to the highly competitive ones. Joanna explained that she is allergic to most reptiles and animals with fur, which makes her face puffy and itchy, so she has always avoided pets. She said writing and time with friends bring her joy.

On 7 February 2022, Joanna said the screenplay she had sent to a film festival was on her mind all day, every day. Nate said he had made coconut milk ice cream and was proud of it, and that he liked chocolate and mixed berry flavors. He said he was looking forward to trying new flavors and toppings. He also said he had made a dairy-free chocolate cake topped with berries. Joanna said she was tempted to try dairy-free desserts. She said she had recently watched "Little Women" and strongly recommended it, and Nate said he would watch it and tell her what he thought.

On 25 February 2022, Nate said he had made chocolate and vanilla swirl ice cream for a friend, who loved it. Joanna said she cannot eat dairy, so she asked for a dairy-free recipe, and Nate agreed to send his coconut milk version. Joanna said she had started writing a second screenplay while waiting to hear back about the first. The new story is about a thirty-year-old woman on a road trip of self-discovery after a loss, and Joanna said it was inspired by her own personal experiences. Nate said he was looking forward to seeing both projects come together.

On 18 March 2022, Joanna said she had finished her second script and felt a mix of relief, excitement, and anxiety. She said she had been researching and networking for it, and that she was trying to decompress but found it hard to switch off. Nate shared photos of two tortoises in a jungle and three turtles on rocks in a pond, and said walking his turtles reminds him to enjoy small things. Joanna said she wished she could have a turtle of her own, but she had recently discovered she is also allergic to cockroaches. Nate offered to send her photos of his turtles so she could still watch them grow. Joanna also shared a photo of a cinema ticket at the end of the session.

On 24 March 2022, Joanna said she had an audition the previous day for a writing job and felt both excited and anxious about it. Nate said he was competing in the video game tournament again and that it was intense. Joanna shared a photo of her bookshelf, which she called her go-to source of writing inspiration, and gave Nate advice on writing: read widely, try different genres, share work even with friends, and gather feedback. Nate said he would keep working at it.

On 15 April 2022, Nate said he had dyed his hair the previous week and shared a selfie of himself with purple hair and glasses. He said he chose a bright, bold color to stand out. Joanna said his boldness inspired her, and she shared a photo of a sunset she had seen while hiking. She said writing was consuming most of her time and she was hoping for good news about her projects soon. Nate said he looked forward to hearing more.

On 17 April 2022, Joanna said she had been reading a lot and had found a hiking trail in her hometown the day before. She said nature is her haven and a way to reset. Nate said he is not really into hiking but would like to see the trail, and he mentioned a trail just north of where he lives. Joanna suggested he join her someday. Nate said he likes nature and that his pets help him take breaks from reality. Nate then shared photos of his turtles and a bowl of coconut ice cream. He gave Joanna his dairy-free recipe: coconut milk, vanilla extract, sugar, and a pinch of salt, chilled and then churned in an ice cream maker until scoopable. Joanna said she would try making it that evening and promised to report back.

On 21 April 2022, Joanna said she had joined a writers group and felt like she finally belonged somewhere. She described working on a script called "Finding Home" about a girl searching for her true home. Nate said he had a gaming tournament the next month, which would be his fourth. Joanna shared a photo of a man in a striped suit on stage and said she was the person in it. She said acting was her first passion, though she now focuses on writing, and that she once forgot her lines during a first play. Nate asked whether she would return to acting. Joanna said she might someday. Nate said he loves fantasy and sci-fi, and that video games are his creative outlet. He recommended a trilogy and a book series, and Joanna said she would check them out.

On 2 May 2022, Joanna said she had watched "The Lord of the Rings" trilogy the previous night at Nate's suggestion and loved it. Nate said it was probably the greatest trilogy ever and shared a photo of his gaming room. He said he had won his second tournament the week before, a local Street Fighter tournament. He usually plays CS:GO but said he had surprised himself by winning in a different game, and that the other finalist shook his hand afterward. Joanna shared a photo of a dairy-free vanilla cake with strawberry filling and coconut cream frosting, and said she had been using Nate's coconut milk recommendation. She described baking and cooking as her creative outlets and said she enjoys seeing people's faces when they taste her desserts.

On 12 May 2022, Joanna said she had gone hiking and found more trails in her town. She shared a photo of a waterfall called Whispering Falls, which she described as peaceful. She said that being outside made her feel like a different person and gave her ideas for drama stories. Nate said he gets deep in thought and thinks about his life or new recipes when he is out. Nate then suggested they hike together sometime, and Joanna invited him to join her on the trails. Nate agreed.

On 20 May 2022, Nate introduced Max, a dog he had adopted. He said Max was full of energy and was even keeping his other pets active. Joanna said she did not want a pet because of her allergies. Nate asked how she finds comfort without animals. Joanna said writing and supportive friends help her through hard times. She then shared a photo of her new screenplay, her third, which is about loss, identity, and connection, and which she said drew on a personal story she had carried for years. Nate said she seemed to like writing about sadness and loss, and she said she writes best when she is honest with herself even if it is hard.

On 25 May 2022, Nate said he had met a friendly couple with a dog while walking Max, and they had agreed to doggy playdates because they live nearby. Joanna said connecting with other pet owners is rewarding. Nate said the couple did not have much in common with him apart from their love of animals, but that was enough. He then sent Joanna a photo of a stuffed animal puppy and said it was meant to remind her of good vibes. Joanna said she would cherish it, and the two talked about how small joys make life better. Joanna linked this to finishing her screenplay, which she said made her realize the journey was worth it. Nate said he was there to support her.

Nate encouraged her to keep going. Nate then said he had won another regional video game tournament the previous week, met new people there, and was happy with his progress. He said some of the players he met wanted to hang out and asked for tips, which he agreed to give. Joanna said she was hiking with friends that weekend on a new trail with a waterfall. Nate said he was organizing a gaming party two weekends later and planned to invite tournament friends, old friends, and former teammates. He also said he was giving everyone custom controller decorations as party favors.

On 5 June 2022, Joanna said that a few bits she had written for a screenplay had appeared on the big screen the previous day, which felt nerve-wracking and inspiring. She shared a Spider-Man poster. Nate noticed a Spider-Man pin on her purse at an earlier meeting and asked about her favorite superhero. Joanna said Spider-Man was a favorite but she liked superheroes in general. Nate said Iron Man is his top pick and shared a photo of an Iron Man toy figure. Joanna asked what he liked about it, and Nate said the figure reminded him of his goals. Joanna described her cork board of quotes, photos, and keepsakes, and shared a photo of a framed family picture on it. She said the picture reminds her of her family's love and encouragement. Nate said he should start a cork board of his own, and Joanna recommended it as long as he was willing to explain it to friends.

On 24 June 2022, Joanna said she had submitted her recent screenplay to a film contest. Nate reported that his gaming party had been a success. Seven people attended, six said they wanted to do it again next month, and afterward the group played chess for fun. Nate said he had made vegan ice cream the previous Friday and shared it with his vegan diet group. Joanna asked for the recipe, and Nate agreed to send it the next day. Joanna said she planned to make it for her family that weekend.

Joanna said she had taken a road trip for research for her next movie while Nate was competing. She had visited Woodhaven, a small Midwestern town, where she saw historic buildings and a library with an old book collection. She shared a photo of a book from the 1900s with stories and sketches of the town. She said the town's history sparked ideas for her next script. Joanna then said she had started writing a book because her movie had done well. She described it as a story about loss, redemption, and forgiveness, and said it might be her first published book. Nate shared a photo of himself holding a small turtle at the end of the session.

Joanna said it reminded her of why she loves writing. Nate said he had started teaching people how to make dairy-free desserts and was having fun doing it. He shared a photo of a dessert with whipped cream and chocolate sauce and sent Joanna a new coconut milk ice cream recipe. Joanna said she would surprise her family with it.

Joanna recommended finding a fantasy book series to relax with. Nate recommended a series of his own with battles and interesting characters. Both said they would check out each other's suggestions.

On 5 September 2022, Nate said he had a setback in a video game tournament and was trying to stay positive. He shared a photo of two turtles on a rock. Joanna said she had been revising old recipes and shared a photo of a strawberry and chocolate cake. She said working on recipes was helping her find comfort. Nate said he had taught people vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show the previous Monday. He said he felt nervous but enjoyed it. Nate said he also loves a dairy-free chocolate mousse. Joanna said her favorite was a chocolate raspberry tart with an almond flour crust, and she shared a photo. She also described a dairy-free chocolate raspberry cake made with almond flour and coconut oil, which she often makes for birthdays. She then shared a photo of a blueberry dessert with coconut milk and a gluten-free crust.

On 6 October 2022, Joanna said her newest dairy-free recipe had been a hit with her family. Nate said he had won a large video game tournament the previous week and earned a lot of money, and that he was saving some of it. He said he had watched "Little Women" recently and enjoyed it. Joanna said she had watched it too, and that it explored sisterhood, love, and chasing dreams. She also said she had finished writing her book the previous week after many late nights and edits. Nate said he was proud of her. Nate then shared a whiteboard drawing he had made for Joanna, with arrows and words meant to encourage her. Joanna said she would keep it. Joanna also shared a photo of a bookmark she had made for a member of her writing club.

Joanna asked whether they were competitive, and Nate said he generally does not get intense about games because gaming is his escape from life's struggles. Nate suggested Joanna attend a writing convention, and she said she would look into it. Nate said he had recently watched "Inception" and was playing "Cyberpunk 2077." Joanna then said she had received another rejection, this time from a production company. Nate asked if it was the film contest submission. Joanna said it was hard but she would keep going. Nate said he admired her ability to bounce back.

Joanna agreed to visit the next day and said she would bring her recipes, including her chocolate raspberry cake.

Nate asked about her turtles and said they bring him calm and fascination. Joanna said she had submitted more scripts the previous week and expected some rejections. Nate said he had taken his pets to the park, which made a memorable day. Both said they would start writing down favorite memories.

Joanna said she had pitched a script to producers the previous day and they liked it. She said she was writing a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town. Joanna shared a photo of a sunflower at sunset from a hike near Fort Wayne the previous summer. Nate then said he had bought a third turtle from a pet store and shared a photo. Joanna asked whether she could visit to watch the turtles from a distance, because she is allergic. Nate agreed and said he would bathe the turtles before she came.

She said an actor had told her how much she liked the script, which gave her chills. Nate said he had taken his turtles to the beach in Tampa the previous day. He offered Joanna a taste of the ice cream, and Joanna thanked him. The two ended the conversation warmly.

Jon and Gina are friends who catch up in person and by message, and both love dance. Both lost their jobs in January 2023 and turned to building their own businesses. Across fifteen sessions from January to 19 June 2023, their conversations have stayed warm and encouraging, and each has been a steady source of support for the other. Session 15 took place on the morning of 19 June, the first since 16 June.

Jon lost his job as a banker on 19 January 2023 and decided to start a dance studio. He has loved dance since childhood and sees it as both passion and escape. His favorite style is contemporary, though he enjoys all styles. His ideal studio is by the water with an ocean view and yoga mats, but he has not found it. On 8 February he said leaving his secure job had pushed him to grow, though the path "ain't been a walk in the park." On 11 May he called the studio a dream he is finally pursuing and dance his stress-buster. On 27 May he was wrapping up his business plan and seeking investors, and the search had been tough but he stayed hopeful.

Jon's location search has been a major thread. On 29 January he found a downtown place with great natural light, but he still needed to check its size and floor. He wants a bouncy Marley floor for safe movement. No location was confirmed before session 15. On 13 June he said he was prepping for his studio "more than ever," spoke of "our young dancers," and described planned classes, workshops, one-on-one mentoring, and organizational tools such as a whiteboard and cork board.

In session 14, on 16 June, Jon said a business mentor had inspired him on 15 June and described "doing some promotion" as a crazy ride he was hanging in there through. Gina recommended social media and influencers for marketing. Jon said his dance videos were creating a bit of a stir online, but whether the mentorship led to concrete plans was not stated. When Jon asked whether Gina had thought about being an entrepreneur, she said she had been one since losing her job and her online clothing store had been great. She advised someone starting out to stay passionate, focused, resilient, and open to learning. She also shared an old dancing photo that reminded Jon how much he loves performing.

Session 15 brought the first explicit scheduling of a studio opening. Jon said he had taken a short trip to Rome the previous week to clear his mind. When Gina asked when the studio would open, he said the official opening night was 20 June and shared a photo of young dancers in a studio. Gina congratulated him and said she was pumped for the launch. Jon called it a wild ride but said he was ready to give his best. Gina urged him to savor the moment, and Jon thanked her for always having his back. Gina said she would be right by his side and shared a photo of a group of people in a studio. Jon shared a photo of a man in a native costume high-fiving another man, which was not explained. They agreed to make memories at the grand opening, and Jon invited Gina. No venue, city, or investor was named, and no later session confirms whether the grand opening happened.

Jon dances with a small crew he rehearses with after work, performing everything from contemporary to hip-hop. The crew won first place in a local competition in 2022. In February 2023 he prepared choreography for dancers at a nearby festival, which went well. On 4 February he mentioned a March 2023 competition near him, but nothing confirms he entered. On 3 April he said he would host his own competition the following month and invited Gina, who said she was definitely coming; whether it happened is unknown. On 11 May he offered to send Gina a video of his routines, which she agreed to watch, but it has not been mentioned since. On 25 April he went to a fair to show off his studio and got possible leads, whose outcome was never stated.

Gina also lost her job at DoorDash in January 2023. She used to compete in dance competitions and shows, and her favorite memory is her team's first place at a regional competition at fifteen, performing a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom." Dance is her main stress reliever, which she called "like air" on 11 May. Rather than look for another job, she started a clothing business. On 1 February a wholesaler agreed to work with her, and by 16 March her online store was open; whether a physical store has expanded is not stated. On 27 May she was accepted for a part-time fashion internship at an international company and felt a mix of excitement and nerves. On 13 June she made a video presentation on styling her fashion pieces and promised to send it to Jon. On 16 June she said growing her customer base was tough but going well.

The two have encouraged each other throughout. On 8 February Gina urged Jon not to stop dreaming. On 16 March Jon said Gina's success inspired him, and on 23 March he said he was "gonna make it happen" and suggested a strong brand identity when she asked for business advice. On 25 April Gina advised him to keep his big goal in mind after he admitted feeling low on confidence. On 27 May she encouraged him to keep learning when he felt discouraged, and on 13 June she urged him not to quit. On 16 June Jon said her encouragement keeps him going, and on 19 June he thanked her for always having his back.

Both have been working toward their goals while leaning on each other. Gina's love of contemporary dance remains central to her identity, and her online store remains her main venture while she prepares for her internship. Jon's dance life remains active, and he now describes promoting his business and building an online presence. As of 19 June he presents the studio as about to open on 20 June, with young dancers attending, but no confirmed location has ever been named, and as of 27 May he was still seeking investors, so its real status remains uncertain.

Open questions include whether Jon's grand opening on 20 June took place and where, whether the studio has a permanent home, whether investors came through, whether the mentorship led to concrete changes, whether the fair leads became business, whether he entered the March 2023 competition, whether his May competition happened, whether the video routine was sent, whether Gina's presentation reached Jon, whether her clothing business continues alongside her internship, and whether her physical store has expanded.
