Jon and Gina are friends who catch up in person and by message, and both love dance. Both lost their jobs in January 2023 and turned to building their own businesses. Across nineteen sessions, from January to 23 July 2023, their conversations have stayed warm and encouraging, and each has been a steady source of support for the other.

Jon lost his job as a banker on 19 January 2023 and decided to start a dance studio. He has loved dance since childhood and sees it as both passion and escape. His favorite style is contemporary, and he wants a bouncy Marley floor. On 29 January he found a downtown space with great natural light but still needed to check its size and floor. On 8 February he said leaving his secure job had pushed him to grow, though the path "ain't been a walk in the park." On 27 May he was seeking investors, and the search had been tough. On 13 June he said he was prepping for the studio "more than ever," with planned classes, workshops, and one-on-one mentoring. In session 14, on 16 June, a business mentor inspired him, and Gina recommended social media and influencers. In session 15, on 19 June, Jon scheduled the official studio opening for 20 June and invited Gina to the grand opening. No venue or investor was named for that event, and no later session confirms it happened.

Jon dances with a small crew that rehearses after work, performing everything from contemporary to hip-hop. The crew won first place in a local competition in 2022. In February 2023 he prepared choreography for dancers at a nearby festival, which went well. On 3 April he said he would host his own competition the following month and invited Gina, who said she was definitely coming; whether that happened is unknown. On 25 April he went to a fair to show off his studio and got possible leads, but the outcome was never stated. On 11 May he offered to send Gina a video of his routines, which she agreed to watch, but it has not been mentioned since.

Gina also lost her job at DoorDash in January 2023. She used to compete in dance competitions and shows, and her favorite memory is her team's first place at a regional competition when she was fifteen, performing a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom." Dance is her main stress reliever. Rather than look for another job, she started a clothing business. On 1 February a wholesaler agreed to work with her, and by 16 March her online store was open. In session 18 she said she had built a website where customers could place orders. On 27 May she was accepted for a part-time fashion internship at an international company. On 13 June she made a video presentation on styling her fashion pieces and promised to send it to Jon. On 21 June she shared a photo of a limited edition piece that was not for sale, and said making it was tough but worth it.

On 20 June Jon said he had chosen to attend networking events to make things happen, which had been tough but kept him determined. Gina praised the guts networking takes and urged him not to quit.

The two have encouraged each other throughout. On 8 February Gina urged Jon not to stop dreaming. On 16 March Jon said Gina's success inspired him. On 25 April Gina advised him to keep his big goal in mind after he admitted feeling low on confidence. On 13 June she urged him not to quit, and on 19 June Jon thanked her for always having his back.

In session 17, on 9 July, Gina said fashion editors had noticed her, which felt amazing but scary. Jon said he was going full-time with his business idea, had started learning marketing and analytics tools, and would not quit even when it was hard.

Session 18, on 21 July, brought a notable shift. Jon said the studio is on "tenuous grounds," and he had taken a temp job to cover expenses while still looking for investors. Gina said networking had been a lifesaver for her in sourcing products. Jon said he had met some investors and got good advice at a recent event, but no investor is named and no commitment is mentioned. He said he was refining his business plan and investor pitch and building an online platform for the studio. Gina suggested Instagram, TikTok, and local influencers, and offered to help make content and manage his accounts. Jon accepted warmly.

Session 19, on Sunday 23 July, was a shorter, lighter exchange. Jon said he had been rehearsing hard and working on business plans. Gina sent "Just do it" messages and attributed the slogan to Shia LaBeouf, a claim that is unverified. She said a creative space for dancers matters a great deal and that Jon's studio would be a go-to spot for self-expression. Jon said he could not wait until his studio started welcoming dancers, which suggests the studio has not yet opened to the public. Jon promised he would not quit whatever came his way. Neither mentioned Gina's business, her internship, Jon's investors, or the content offer.

As of 23 July, Jon's studio is still unopened and uncertain, and no confirmed location has ever been named. He is balancing a temp job, a business plan he is refining, investor outreach, and an online presence, while keeping his dance crew active. Gina's clothing business remains her main venture, with a working order website, a limited edition collection, and attention from fashion editors, and her internship is ongoing. Her love of contemporary dance remains central to her identity. Gina serves as a steady cheerleader, and Jon repeatedly promises not to quit.

Open questions include whether Jon's grand opening took place and where, whether the studio has a permanent home, whether investors came through and on what terms, whether the fair leads or networking led to funding, whether he hosted his May competition, whether the video routine was sent, whether Gina's presentation reached Jon, whether the fashion editors' interest led to coverage, whether her business continues alongside her internship, whether the limited edition line has sold, and whether Gina's offer to help with Jon's content became an active collaboration.

Calvin and Dave have had fifteen recorded conversations, from their first meeting on 23 March 2023 through a fifteenth session at 11:06 am on 22 August 2023, which is the most recent. They are friends who often ask about each other's lives and usually close with good wishes, safe travels, and promises to talk soon. Dave talks most often about cars, car maintenance, classic cars, restoration, and the outdoors. Calvin talks most often about music, his tours, his studio, his albums, and his collaborations. Each session below records what was said and when, followed by the places where later details changed or conflicted with earlier ones.

In the first session, at 11:53 am on 23 March 2023, Calvin and Dave met for the first time. Dave said things had been going well and that he had recently attended a car event full of classic cars, where he spoke with owners and heard their stories. Calvin said he had just gone through a big life change and shared a photo of his new mansion, a building with a sign on its front. He framed the change around learning about Japanese culture and getting a chance to expand. Calvin had never been to Japan and was fascinated by its traditions. He planned to leave in April 2023. His agent had found him a place to stay, and he shared a photo of its cozy living room. In Japan he planned to explore the city, try local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with local musicians, staying a few months before traveling to Boston. Dave had been spending time at a calm park with a lake and a few boats, and he shared a photo of it. Calvin had never been there but said he would check it out when he returned. They ended by wishing each other well for the trip.

The second session took place at 4:45 pm on 26 March 2023. Calvin said he had just bought a new car, a luxury car he described as a long-held dream come true. He called it smooth and powerful, said driving it made him feel like a rockstar, and said it was what he deserved after his hard work. He shared a photo of a red sports car parked on the side of the road, taken on 25 March when he first took it for a ride. He did not name the make or model when Dave asked, and he said he was on cloud nine. Dave reported that around 18 to 19 March he had gone to a music festival in Boston, which reminded him why he loves music. He shared photos of a large concert crowd and a concert stage with a large eagle, and said his favorite band there was Aerosmith, whose performance he found incredible. He said he had finally seen the band live, but did not get to hang out with them afterward. Calvin said he had written new tunes and held several studio sessions the previous week, and he promised to share the music once it was ready and keep Dave updated on the collaborations. They signed off by wishing each other well and staying safe.

The third session took place at 4:15 pm on 20 April 2023. Calvin said he had just been to a music festival in Tokyo. He did not see any bands there, but he met many talented artists and industry people and got valuable advice. A producer told him to stay true to himself and sound unique, which got him thinking about where he wants his music to go. His long-term dream is to tour the world and connect with people. He was looking forward to a trip to Boston after finishing the Frank Ocean tour, having heard the music scene there was awesome. Dave responded enthusiastically, offered to show Calvin around, and recommended Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park. He said he would be in the front row whenever Calvin performed. Dave also said that around 15 to 16 April he had gone to a car show, where he admired the dedication people put into restoring classic cars, which is why he is so into auto engineering. He shared a photo of a green Mustang parked in a field of grass. Calvin replied with a photo of a red sports car on display at a show, saying he had put a lot of work into it. This appears to be the same car he bought in March. When Dave asked whether Calvin had seen anything in Boston beyond the gigs, Calvin said not yet, but he looked forward to exploring the city and trying delicious food. He suggested they grab a bite together when he arrived, and Dave agreed to share his favorite spots.

The fourth session took place at 6:24 pm on 1 May 2023. Dave shared big career news: he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop, which he described as a dream come true. He shared a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it. Calvin congratulated him and shared a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage. Dave said the shop had taken a lot of hard work but was worth it, and that it was a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars, which he loves for their design and engineering. Dave said that the previous year he had been thrilled to restore one, a labor of love that was challenging but worth it. He shared a photo of the restored engine. The two exchanged messages about how satisfying it is to see something you worked on come back to life. Dave then shared a photo of his shop and invited Calvin to visit. He said he worked on everything from regular maintenance to full classic restorations. Calvin then shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant and called it stunning. He said it was a gift from another artist and a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician. The two closed by encouraging each other to keep pushing.

The fifth session took place at 1:16 pm on 3 May 2023. Dave said he was teaming up with a local garage, sharing a photo of a car being worked on there. Calvin called the news inspiring. Dave said he was loving the job, getting to work with skilled mechanics and share his knowledge about cars. He said he hoped to build a custom car from scratch someday, which is his dream. Calvin told him to relax and enjoy the process. Dave asked whether Calvin had hobbies that helped him relax. Calvin said long drives in his red sports car really helped him relax, because the wind and open road cleared his head. Dave said walking and exploring was his own peaceful way to destress. Calvin agreed that embracing nature had been calming for him too, and said he had been loving getting to know Japanese culture. He then admitted that he was stuck with his music, that his creativity felt frozen, and asked for tips. Dave suggested immersing himself in something he loves, such as concerts or favorite albums, and recommended taking a break from music to have some fun. Calvin said a break was great for getting his mojo back. Dave encouraged him to never give up. The two agreed to stay in touch.

The sixth session took place at 11:50 am on 16 May 2023, and it was a more mixed exchange. Calvin said that around 9 May, "last week," his place had been flooded. He managed to save his music gear and his favorite microphone, and he said he was staying positive. Dave sympathized and offered help. Calvin said he was waiting on insurance before starting repairs. He shared a photo of his music studio, a room with a keyboard, a synthesizer, and other equipment, which he called his creative haven. Dave said he had opened his car shop "last week," invited friends over to celebrate, and found it amazing. This is a little inconsistent with the 1 May session, where Dave first announced the shop's opening. Calvin said he had an upcoming performance in Tokyo "this month," meaning May 2023, and hoped to expand his following. Dave wished him luck. Calvin then shared a photo of a city at night full of lights, saying he had taken it in Tokyo "last night," meaning 15 May. Dave said he hoped to visit Tokyo soon, and Calvin encouraged him to visit.

The seventh session took place at 6:06 pm on 31 May 2023. Calvin said touring with Frank Ocean the previous week, around 24 May, had been wild, and that Tokyo, where he had performed, was unreal, with an insane crowd. He said he felt so alive when performing that he could not find the words to express it. Dave shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage. He described it as his neighbor's car, which had been having engine trouble, and said he had fixed it himself. Calvin asked whether the car was the one Dave had been fixing up for a friend, which slightly mixes up the detail, since Dave had said it belonged to a neighbor. Dave said working on cars was therapeutic, and Calvin said fixing cars gave him a real sense of achievement, like meditating. Dave said fixing things gave him a sense of purpose, and that he got a real buzz turning something broken into something that runs smoothly. Calvin said they were both making something great out of nothing. Dave then asked whether Calvin always enjoyed performing live. Calvin said performing live always fueled his soul, and he called it an absolute high. Calvin agreed that the crowd was part of it, like one big harmony. Dave said music was like therapy for everyone, then asked what was next for Calvin's music. Calvin said he could not wait for the tour with Frank and was buzzing to perform in Boston. Dave said the Boston music scene was awesome and that he would be there to cheer Calvin on. Calvin said Dave's support meant a lot and signed off with "See you soon!"

The eighth session took place at 2:31 pm on 9 June 2023. Calvin said he had met with the creative team for his album the previous day, 8 June, in a long session that was awesome to see coming together. He said he was feeling stoked about the album and shared a photo of a recording studio with a large window and a desk. Dave said he had been exploring parks on weekends to relax, finding nature very peaceful. He asked whether Calvin knew any chill spots in Boston. Calvin said he had never been to Boston before and could not wait to visit next month, meaning July 2023. Dave said the Boston parks are awesome, especially in spring. He had gone for a stroll the previous Friday, around 2 June, and said weekend walks recharge him for the whole coming week. Calvin then asked whether Dave had been hiking lately and shared a photo of a path climbing a hill with mountains in view. Dave said hiking clears the mind and brings calm. Calvin said he had not been to the mountains but was keen to go and escape it all. Dave said he had booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month, July 2023, and expected it to be amazing. Calvin asked him to take lots of pictures, and Dave agreed. The two signed off with safe travels and promises to see each other soon.

The ninth session took place at 3:15 pm on 21 June 2023. Calvin said he had been in a small car accident the previous Friday, around 16 June, which was upsetting but left no one hurt. He had been dealing with insurance and repairs, which took a lot of time and paperwork, and he shared a photo of a red car with a black rim parked on a sidewalk. Dave asked whether the insurance process had caused problems. Calvin said it was now sorted and the car was being fixed. He said it took only about a week to sort out, and that although he had worried about the cost, it was not too bad. He shared a photo from the auto repair shop of a man working on a car, and said he trusted the mechanic's expertise. He then shared a photo of the view from his living room, a small town with a mountain in the background, and said it was from a small town in Japan. He said it was on his to-do list for after his Frank Ocean tour ends. He also shared a photo of a person on skis on a snowy mountain and said he might give skiing a try once. Calvin then asked what was new in Dave's routine. Dave said he had recently joined a rock band and had been practicing guitar, and he shared a photo of the band members playing instruments in a room. Calvin said playing in a rock band would bring Dave a lot of emotions. Dave said good company and great music lift the mood, and then said he had to go and would see Calvin soon.

The tenth session took place at 7:56 pm on 7 July 2023. Dave opened by asking how Calvin's car was doing after the crash. Calvin said the car was fixed and going strong. Dave said he had been hanging out with friends at parks lately and had arranged regular park walks with them. Calvin then asked whether Dave had a favorite spot. Dave shared a photo of a city skyline with a river and boats in the water. Calvin said it reminded him of living in his Japanese mansion with its epic cityscape, which he called a dream come true. He shared a photo he had taken from his backyard of the mansion, showing a boat docked in a canal at sunset. He said that whenever he looked out the windows and saw the city lights, it was awe-inspiring, and he shared a photo of the front of the mansion. Dave asked whether Calvin was looking forward to anything else in Japan. Calvin said he could not wait to try the food and check out the culture, and asked whether Dave had ever been to Japan. Dave said he had never been but was keen to go one day, and that he was hooked on Japanese music. Calvin said he had been working on music collaborations with Japanese artists and promised to share clips when everything was ready. He then signed off to get back to work. Dave told him to take care, not to overwork himself, and to stay safe.

The eleventh session took place at 6:38 pm on 21 July 2023. Dave said he had just returned from a road trip with friends through stunning countryside. He called it a lovely break from "the corporate mayhem," and said driving winding roads had reminded him why he loves cars. Dave said the trip reminded him why he is passionate about his work and that the long hours were worth it. Calvin said he was working on a project to transform a Japanese mansion into a recording studio. It has long been his dream to have a space for creating music with other artists, and he described it as his sanctuary. He shared a photo of a room with a ladder in it, showing his progress. Calvin said he had been experimenting with different genres, pushing himself out of his comfort zone, and adding electronic elements to his songs. He said the work is finding the right balance between sticking to his sound and trying new things. Dave told him to keep going, saying "I'm your biggest fan." Calvin said Dave's support meant a lot. The two agreed to chat again soon.

The twelfth session took place at 1:12 pm on 3 August 2023. Calvin opened with "long time no see" and said he had just taken his Ferrari in for a service, which had been stressful, since he was fairly attached to it. This is the first time Calvin names the make of his car. Earlier sessions described only an unnamed red sports car bought in late March 2023 and photographed at a show in April. The Ferrari is very likely the same car, though the memory has never confirmed that directly. Calvin asked what hobbies gave Dave a feeling of being restored. Dave said fixing cars was like therapy for him. He said that growing up he had worked on cars with his dad, and that refurbishing them gave him fulfillment. This is the first mention of Dave's father and of Dave working on cars as a child. He described one summer when he and his dad restored an old car together, which was hard work but very satisfying. Dave shared a photo of a man and a child posing together. Calvin shared a photo of the red car raised on a lift in a garage, saying it was a reminder of his hard work and dedication. Calvin said seeing it every day kept him pushing forward. Dave then asked about Calvin's biggest goal. Calvin said his plan for now was to expand his brand worldwide, grow his fanbase, and work with artists from around the globe. He shared a photo of a band playing on stage under lights, saying it showed how he had performed with "the boys" the previous night, 2 August. This is the first mention of a band Calvin performs with, separate from the Frank Ocean tour and the Tokyo performances. Dave encouraged him to keep making a difference, and told him to stay focused because he had this.

The thirteenth session took place at 5:22 pm on 11 August 2023. Dave opened by saying it had been ages since they talked, though only about eight days had passed since the previous session. He announced that he had been picked for a car mod workshop, which he said would help him learn something new. Calvin congratulated him and asked whether there were any mods or projects he was excited about. Dave said the workshop was a dream come true, since he had always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car. He said he had been doing engine swaps and suspension modifications on a car and was now learning about body modifications. He described giving a classic muscle car a modern twist as a challenge that was also fun, and he shared a photo of a silver Corvette parked in front of a building. This is the first time Dave names a make for a car he is working on. It differs from the green Mustang he photographed in April. The current project is a modification of an existing classic muscle car, not the custom build from scratch he has long hoped for. Calvin praised the silver finish and the hard work. Dave then offered help with Calvin's music, sharing a photo of his own desk with a keyboard, a monitor, and a keyboard pad. He described it as an awesome music studio setup. This is the first time Dave has shown a music setup of his own and offered to work on Calvin's music. Calvin thanked him for the offer but said he was super busy with his music and would keep it in mind. The two exchanged short farewells, with Dave telling Calvin to stay awesome.

The fourteenth session took place at 12:35 am on 14 August 2023, about three days after the thirteenth. Dave said that since they last talked he had gone to a car workshop in San Francisco, the first time the memory places him in that city. He said it was great to see different restoration techniques, and he found the people there passionate and dedicated. Calvin then described his recent life as an amazing experience touring with "a well-known artist," which fits the Frank Ocean tour but is not named in this session. He said the tour ended with a show in Japan, after which he got to explore his new place, which he called a dream come true. Dave asked how Tokyo reacted to his music. Calvin said the crowd sang along when he played one of his songs, which he called a magical moment. He shared a photo of a crowd at a concert with their hands up, saying these moments are why he loves his job. He asked about Dave's project. Dave said he was restoring a car and shared a photo of a car with a broken engine in the woods, describing the transformation from a beat-up mess to a real beauty. Dave expected the restoration to be finished by the end of next month, which would be September 2023. Calvin said he was excited to see the end result and called Dave talented. He said he would always be there and told Dave to keep growing. The session ended with "See ya!"

The fifteenth session took place at 11:06 am on 22 August 2023, about eight days after the fourteenth. Dave opened by saying they had not talked in a while, though the gap was only about a week. He said that last Friday, around 18 August, he had hosted a card night with friends that was great fun, and he shared a photo of a group of men sitting at a table with playing cards. Calvin replied warmly and then announced his biggest news so far: he had landed a deal to continue his collaboration with Frank Ocean, which he called a dream come true after working hard. Calvin said he had met Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo, that the two clicked, and that they had been sharing ideas. They arranged a meeting and recorded a song in the studio at Calvin's mansion. Calvin described Tokyo as buzzing with energy and said the festival crowd felt like fuel for his soul. He shared a photo of a crowd of people sitting on the grass at night. Dave asked whether any other collaborations had come out of the performance. Calvin said someone at the festival had noticed his performance and that he was now working with them. He said his tour would end soon and that he was heading to Boston, and he suggested they meet up there. Dave said he would like to hear the details and meet when Calvin arrived. Calvin then mentioned that the day before, 21 August, he and his friends had recorded a podcast about the rapidly evolving rap industry, and said he would share when it would be uploaded. Dave said he looked forward to listening. The two said goodbye with "See ya then!"

Taken together, the sessions show how the two friends' lives moved over these months. Calvin began in March 2023 about to leave for Japan, moved into a Japanese mansion, performed at a Tokyo festival in April and again in Tokyo in May, toured with Frank Ocean in late May, and by July was building a recording studio in the mansion and collaborating with Japanese artists. By August he was performing with a band he called "the boys," and by mid-August he was describing a tour with a well-known artist that ended in Japan. By 22 August he had landed a deal to continue working with Frank Ocean after meeting him at a Tokyo festival, recorded a song at his mansion studio, and started a podcast about rap with friends. His car went from a newly bought red sports car in March to one in a crash in June, repaired in about a week, and by August he was calling it a Ferrari. His music moved from creative block in May to album meetings in June and experiments with new genres in July. Dave began in March talking about classic cars and a calming park. In April he described a car show and a plan to meet in Boston, and in May he announced the opening of his own car maintenance shop and then a partnership with a local garage. In June and July he talked about weekend parks, a mountain trip, joining a rock band, and a road trip with friends. In August he described childhood work on cars with his father, reported being picked for a car mod workshop and working on a classic muscle car, and in mid-August described attending a car workshop in San Francisco and restoring a car with a broken engine that he expected to finish by September 2023. In late August he hosted a card night with friends.

Several details are inconsistent or uncertain. Calvin's 3 May session described a red car, but its make was not named until August, and the memory has never directly confirmed that the Ferrari is the same red sports car he bought in March. Calvin said in April that he would visit Boston after the Frank Ocean tour, and in June he said again that he had never been there and planned to go in July, so the timing moved. In the 22 August session he said he was heading to Boston once his tour ended, so the memory still does not confirm that any Boston visit has happened. Dave said in May that he had fixed a neighbor's car, and Calvin later asked whether it belonged to a friend. Calvin said in June that he hoped to visit the mountain town in his living-room photo after his tour, but no session confirms whether that trip took place. In the 21 July session Dave had just returned from a road trip, which he had earlier described as a planned mountain trip. Dave's account of the shop's opening also conflicts slightly, since the 1 May session presents it as news and the 16 May session says he opened "last week." Calvin placed himself in a small Japanese town in June and at his mansion with a city skyline in July, so the mansion's location has not been clearly placed, and the memory should not assume a specific city. In August Calvin described performing "with the boys," and Dave described being in a rock band. The memory does not confirm whether these are the same group. In the thirteenth session Dave said it had been ages although the previous session was only about eight days earlier, and in the fifteenth he said the same about a gap of roughly a week. The memory does not establish whether Dave's green Mustang and silver Corvette are the same car, or whether his current project is the restoration he described in May. In the fourteenth session Dave's restoration project, a car with a broken engine that he expects to finish by September, conflicts with the thirteenth session, where his current work was modifying a silver Corvette. The memory does not establish whether these are two separate projects or one car described differently. The memory does not confirm whether the Tokyo show Calvin described in the fourteenth session is the May 2023 performance or a later one.

The fifteenth session adds further tension. In April Calvin said he had not seen any bands at the Tokyo festival, but in August he said he met Frank Ocean there, so the memory does not establish when that meeting happened or whether it was the same festival visit. In the fourteenth session Calvin said the tour had already ended with a show in Japan, but in the fifteenth he said the tour would end soon and he was heading to Boston afterward, so the memory cannot be sure whether the tour is finished. Calvin also described recording a song with Frank Ocean in his mansion studio, which has not been dated. The memory does not confirm whether the Frank Ocean collaboration is connected to the Japanese artist collaborations he described earlier, or whether the rap podcast is connected to any of his earlier music plans. Dave's card night is recorded only as a single event on about 18 August, and the memory does not know the other people involved beyond the photo.

Calvin tends to describe his feelings in strong terms, such as being on cloud nine, feeling like a rockstar, finding performing an absolute high, or calling a deal a dream come true. He has consistently valued his car and his studio as symbols of hard work and dedication, and he has often asked Dave about hobbies and relaxation. In the thirteenth session he politely declined Dave's offer to help with his music, saying he was busy. He tends to talk about spreading joy and motivation through his art, and he usually responds to Dave's news with warm congratulations. Dave tends to describe his interests in terms of calm, purpose, and the satisfaction of restoring things, and he often offers encouragement, telling Calvin to keep going or never give up. Dave has repeatedly offered to show Calvin around Boston and to be at his shows, and in July he called himself Calvin's biggest fan. Dave also tends to share a photo with nearly every message and to pair enthusiasm with a practical offer, whether a shop invitation, a park recommendation, or a music studio he offered to share. Calvin, in turn, usually responds to Dave's car news with praise and asks about progress or timelines. The two have repeatedly promised to share updates, photos, and music with one another, and Calvin has promised more than once to meet Dave in Boston.

On 8 May 2023 at 1:56 pm, Caroline and Melanie caught up in person. Melanie said she was swamped with her kids and work. Caroline reported that she had attended an LGBTQ support group the previous day, 7 May 2023, and found it very powerful. She said the transgender speakers' stories were especially inspiring, and she felt happy and thankful for the support. She shared a photo of a dog walking past a wall with a painting of a woman. Caroline said the group made her feel accepted and gave her the courage to embrace herself, and Melanie praised her courage. Caroline said she plans to continue her education and explore career options. She is keen on counseling or mental health work because she wants to support people facing similar issues. Melanie said Caroline would make a great counselor because of her empathy and understanding. Melanie shared a photo of a sunset over a lake, a painting she made of a lake sunrise in 2022. She said painting is her creative outlet, expresses her feelings, and helps her relax after long days. Caroline said relaxing and self-expression are key. Caroline then left to do research, and Melanie said she was going swimming with her kids.

On 25 May 2023 at 1:14 pm, Melanie and Caroline chatted again. Melanie said that since their last talk she had a lot going on. The previous Saturday, around 20 May 2023, she ran a charity race for mental health, which she found rewarding and which made her think about taking care of our minds. Caroline praised her for taking part and raising awareness. Melanie said the event was thought-provoking and that she was realizing self-care is really important. She described it as a journey: when she looks after herself, she can better look after her family. Caroline agreed that taking care of ourselves matters even when it is not easy. Melanie said she is carving out daily me-time, including running, reading, or playing her violin, which refreshes her and helps her stay present for her family. She called it a work in progress but said she is doing her best. Her kids are excited for summer break, and her family is thinking about going camping next month, in June 2023. She asked Caroline about her summer plans.

Caroline replied that she is researching adoption agencies, and that giving a loving home to kids who need one has been a dream of hers for a long time. Melanie called her kind and said her future family would be lucky to have her. Caroline said her goal is to give kids a loving home, that she is grateful for the support of friends and mentors, and that the hard work now is turning her dream into reality. She said she feels hopeful and optimistic though it is a lot to take in. She shared a photo of a sign for a new arrival at an adoption agency she is looking into, described as a photograph of a sign for a new arrival and an information and domestic building. Melanie asked what made her pick that agency. Caroline said she chose it because it helps LGBTQ+ people with adoption, and its inclusivity and support spoke to her. Caroline said she is thrilled to build a family for kids who need one, and that it will be tough as a single parent, but she is up for the challenge. Melanie encouraged her, saying she will be an awesome mom. Caroline thanked her and said she will do her best to make sure the kids have a safe and loving home. Melanie said Caroline has a caring heart and that the kids will get all the love and stability they need, and she said she was excited for this new chapter.

In Session 3, on 9 June 2023 at 7:55 pm, Caroline opened by telling Melanie about a school event she had spoken at the previous week, around late May or early June 2023. She described it as awesome: she talked about her transgender journey and encouraged students to get involved in the LGBTQ community, and she enjoyed seeing their reactions. She said the event made her reflect on how far she has come since she started transitioning three years earlier, in about 2020. Melanie praised her for spreading awareness and told her to keep inspiring people. Caroline said she felt powerful giving the talk, shared the struggles she had faced and how much she has grown since coming out, and was glad the audience related and wanted to be better allies. She said conversations about gender identity and inclusion are necessary and that she is thankful to be able to give a voice to the trans community. Caroline said sharing stories is not always easy but important for understanding and acceptance. She said she has been blessed with love and support and wants to pass it on, and she described the aim of building a strong, supportive community of hope. Melanie said that vulnerable moments are where people bond, and that sharing stories shows people they are not alone. Caroline said she plans to keep using her voice to make a change and lift others up, and she named Melanie as part of that effort. Melanie said she was proud to be part of the difference Caroline is making, and both agreed to keep motivating and helping each other. Caroline said they can tackle life's challenges together.

Melanie then asked Caroline what motivates her. Caroline said her friends, family, and mentors are her rocks, and she shared a photo of a family posing in a yard, taken when they met up the previous week, around early June 2023. Melanie asked how long Caroline has had this support system. Caroline said she has known these friends for four years, since she moved from her home country, and that they have been there through everything, including a tough breakup, and she is very thankful. Caroline asked Melanie who supports her. Melanie said her husband and kids keep her motivated, and she shared a photo of a man and a little girl standing in front of a waterfall. Caroline admired the family picture and asked how long Melanie has been married. Melanie said it has been five years, and she shared a wedding photo of herself as a bride holding a bouquet, saying it feels like only yesterday she put on that dress. Caroline congratulated her and wished her many happy years. Melanie shared a photo of a man and a woman sitting on a blanket eating food, and said family moments make it all worth it. Caroline asked how the day was, and Melanie said it was fun: they played games, ate good food, and hung out together. Both agreed that cherishing time with loved ones is what makes them feel alive and happy, and Caroline said family is everything.

Sam and Evan are longtime acquaintances who have been catching up across twelve sessions. Nine took place in 2023 between 18 May and 27 August, one on 11 September, one on 6 October, and one on 8 October. Sam's health and habits have been the main thread since May. Evan has repeatedly offered encouragement, practical tips, and his own health story as a model, and his personal life, hobbies, and travels have grown into major topics. Evan's photos often do not match his descriptions, and several of his accounts shift from one session to the next. His claims should be treated as his own description rather than verified fact.

The first session took place in person on 18 May 2023 at 1:47 pm, after a long gap in contact. Evan had recently bought a new Prius after his old car broke down, which was repaired and then sold. He had returned from a family trip to the Rockies, where they hiked during the week before 18 May. He shared a photo of a lake with rocks and mountains behind it. He said he had painted in watercolor for a few years, after a friend introduced him to the medium and gave him early advice, and he called painting a great stress-buster. He shared a photo of his watercolor of a desert cactus. Sam said they loved hiking but had not gone in ages. Their most special hike was with their dad when Sam was ten, covering a good distance, and Sam still treasures it. Sam shared a photo of a man and a child walking through a forest, presumably the two of them. Sam had no hobbies yet but was considering painting and shared a photo of a paint set in a store. Evan encouraged Sam to keep trying new things until one sparked excitement. They agreed to catch up again soon, and Sam promised to keep Evan posted on new hobbies. No date for the next meeting was set.

The second session took place by text on 24 May 2023 at 7:11 pm. Evan said that on the weekend of about 20 and 21 May he had taken his family on a road trip to Jasper, Alberta, driving the Icefields Parkway and seeing glaciers and lakes. He shared a photo that he said showed a glacier, but it actually shows a person holding a book in front of a lake, with no glacier visible. Sam said they had never been to Jasper and that it looked breathtaking. Sam then said their week had been tough. A few days earlier, a check-up with their doctor had shown their weight was not where it should be, which Sam called pretty eye-opening. Evan said it is never too late to make positive changes and recommended finding a fitness routine one truly enjoys and making small, smarter dietary choices. Sam said they had been looking for a hobby to stay motivated and asked whether painting would help them de-stress. Evan said yes, painting relieves stress and builds creativity, but exercise was also needed. Sam said they would try painting and report back. Sam has never reported back on painting from this exchange.

The third session took place by text on 6 June 2023 at 3:55 pm. Evan said life had been a rollercoaster, and the previous week he had a sudden heart palpitation episode, a serious wake-up call about his lifestyle. He shared a photo of a person holding a bottle of medicine. He said he was trying to eat less processed food and fewer sugary snacks, though he admitted he loved ginger snaps. Sam said they were trying to eat healthier but still enjoyed soda and candy. Evan suggested swapping soda for flavored seltzer water and candy for dark chocolate with high cocoa content, and Sam agreed to try. Evan shared a photo of a bearded man holding a dumbbell and said exercise clears the mind. Sam asked for help getting started, and Evan offered to get together and show Sam some basic exercises. No date for that get-together has ever been set. Sam then described a frustrating supermarket trip where all the self-checkout machines were broken, and Evan said he was sorry.

The fourth session took place by text on 27 July 2023 at 10:52 am. Sam said friends had mocked Sam's weight the previous Friday, which hurt and made Sam realize they needed to change. Evan apologized, said progress takes time, and offered to work on it together. He said he had struggled with his own health a few years earlier but had stuck with it. He shared a photo he described as his gym membership card, though it shows a set of five cards reading "let it shine." When Sam asked what had made the biggest difference, Evan said cutting sugary snacks and eating more vegetables and fruit had helped a lot, and he shared a photo of a table of fresh produce. Sam said they were reducing soda and candy and were determined, though it was tough. Evan recommended flavored seltzer with air-popped popcorn or fruit as low-calorie snacks. He mentioned a mystery novel he could not stop thinking about and said it was *The Great Gatsby*, though he had earlier called it a mystery, and his photo showed fruit and a bottle of alcohol rather than a book. Sam said they would read it sometime and wanted to focus on progress, not perfection. Evan asked whether Sam had thought about exercise. Sam said that starting the next day, 28 July, they would go to the gym and exercise regularly. Whether that routine began has never been confirmed.

The fifth session took place by text on 7 August 2023 at 7:52 pm. Evan said that the previous week he had traveled to Canada and met an awesome Canadian woman, which he described as something out of a movie, and that being with her made him feel alive. He shared a photo of a couple holding hands in the snow. Sam congratulated him and said they were sorry he had been dealing with health issues. Evan said the relationship was a welcome change and that his health struggles had made him appreciate good moments more. He shared a photo of a woman and a child on a swing set, and Sam said his kids seemed to be having a great time. Sam asked how long Evan had been prioritizing his health. Evan said two years, with ups and downs. He shared a photo of a fitness watch box and said his family and the watch's progress tracking motivated him. He also named a thirst for adventure on interesting hikes, and shared a photo of a bonsai tree that he said symbolizes strength and resilience. He signed off with "Catch ya later!" Sam has not mentioned the gym, painting, or the seltzer and snack swaps since.

The sixth session took place by text on 13 August 2023 at 4:09 pm. Evan opened with "long time no talk" and said he had just returned from a vacation in Canada with his new significant other, whom he now called his "SO." They had hiked and biked together. He shared a photo of a tent in a grassy field, though he did not mention camping. Sam said things had been challenging and some of it had been hard on their health. Evan asked whether there was anything he could do. Sam shared a photo of a notepad with a quote that had been helping them stay motivated: "Don't fear it, just take the first step. It's been helping me move forward to healthier habits!" Evan agreed with "progress over perfection" and encouraged Sam to celebrate small wins. He then said he was "losing it every week" after searching for his keys for half an hour. Sam mentioned a dream about soaring over skyscrapers, which had felt incredible, and Evan suggested a dream interpretation book. Sam said they would look into it. The dream remains unexplored.

The seventh session took place by text on 15 August 2023 at 4:20 pm, two days after the sixth. Evan said his son had hurt his ankle in a soccer accident the previous Saturday, which was hard for Evan to watch, and that he had been looking after his son and taking him to the doctor. He shared a photo of a person with a cast on their foot, which he described as a photography image. Sam said things had not been easy either. They had a rough week and a doctor's appointment that was a wake-up call. Sam said they were taking a cooking class and had made a grilled dish the previous night, and shared a photo of salmon with vegetables. Evan said he wanted to eat healthier and asked for recipes. Sam offered a roasted vegetable recipe, which has never actually appeared in the conversation. Evan said the ankle was improving but still sore. Sam said they felt a mix of concern about their health and motivation to change, and were taking things one step at a time. The session ended without a formal goodbye.

The eighth session took place by text on 19 August 2023 at 6:17 pm. Sam said they were now on a diet and living healthier, which had been tough but they were determined. They shared a photo of a bowl of spinach, avocado, and strawberries, and reported more energy and less sluggishness after meals. This is the first session in which Sam describes a diet in plain terms with measurable benefits. Sam offered a grilled chicken and veggie stir-fry recipe. When Evan asked for the sauce recipe, Sam sent it, but the accompanying photo shows a recipe card with a drawing of a vase of flowers, so the actual ingredients are not recorded. Evan then brought news about painting. He said he had started painting classes a few days earlier. He said a friend had once given him a painting, which inspired him to start, and that he joined the classes to meet like-minded people. This conflicts with the May account, in which a friend introduced him to watercolor and he had been painting for a few years. He shared photos of a forest scene on an easel, brushes and pencils that do not clearly show painting supplies, and a table of watercolor paints. He said he loves landscapes and shared photos of an ocean sunset and a tree with pink flowers. SUMMARY:

Overview: Nate and Joanna are friends who talk about her screenwriting, his gaming, their pets, food, hiking, and films. Across thirteen sessions from January to late May 2022, Joanna moved from finishing a first screenplay to writing a third, and Nate moved from casual gaming to competing in several tournaments. Both have said they would like to see each other in person, but no date has been set.

Session 1 (21 January 2022): Nate said he won his first video game tournament the week before, a Counter-Strike: Global Offensive event played with his team. Joanna said she had been working on a project but did not describe it. She recommended a romantic drama about memory and relationships, which she first watched about three years earlier and owns on physical media. The title was never given, and Nate did not confirm whether he watched it.

Session 2 (23 January 2022): Joanna said she finished her first full screenplay and printed it the Friday before. It is a mix of drama and romance. She felt relief, excitement, and some anxiety, and planned to submit it to film festivals. Nate said he has had his pets for three years and they bring him tons of joy. Joanna said she is allergic to most reptiles and animals with fur, but she finds other ways to be happy. Nate said he does not expect to win big and just plays for fun.

Session 3 (7 February 2022): Joanna said the screenplay she sent to a film festival is always on her mind, and she hopes a producer or director falls for it. No result was reported. Nate said he made coconut milk ice cream and was proud of it. He loves coconut milk and also enjoys chocolate and mixed berry flavors. Joanna said she had just watched "Little Women," calling it amazing and a must-see.

Session 4 (25 February 2022): Joanna said she cannot have dairy and asked for a dairy-free recipe. Nate offered a coconut milk recipe. Joanna said she had started a second screenplay while she waits to hear back about the first. It is about a thirty-year-old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss, who takes a road trip to heal and grow. She said it is her own story.

Session 5 (18 March 2022): Joanna said she wrapped up her second script and felt both relief and anxiety, with a tug-of-war between hope and doubt. Nate said he is drawn to turtles because they are unique, slow-paced, low-maintenance, and calming. Joanna said she wishes she were not allergic and would get two turtles if she could. She recently learned she is allergic to cockroaches too.

Session 6 (24 March 2022): Joanna said she had an audition for a writing gig "yesterday," meaning 23 March. It went alright, with mixed excitement and anxiety. No result was reported. Nate said he is in the video game tournament again and it is intense. Joanna advised him to read widely, build a understanding of literature, write and share, gather feedback, and have faith in himself. She was giving general writing advice.

Session 7 (15 April 2022): Nate said he dyed his hair the week before in a bright, bold color to stand out. Joanna said his boldness inspired her, and she mentioned a sunset she saw while hiking. She has no vacation lined up because her writing is consuming her, and she hopes for good news soon. Nate replied "See you soon?" and no date was set.

Session 8 (17 April 2022): Joanna said she found an awesome hiking trail in her hometown on 16 April and called nature a great way to reset. Nate said he is not really into hiking but was curious about a trail just north of where he lives. He said spending time with his pets and hobbies lets him take a break from reality. He gave his dairy-free coconut ice cream recipe: coconut milk, vanilla extract, sugar, and a pinch of salt, chilled, churned, then frozen until scoopable. Joanna said she would try it that night. No result was reported.

Session 9 (21 April 2022): Joanna said she had just joined a writers group whose members really get her writing, and she feels she finally belongs somewhere. The group is working on "Finding Home," a script about a girl on a journey to find her true home. Nate said he has a gaming tournament next month, around May 2022, which will be his fourth. Joanna said she forgot her lines at her first play, and that acting was her first passion; she may return to it someday. Nate said he loves fantasy and sci-fi and that video games express his creativity. He named a trilogy as a favorite and recommended a book series, but neither title was given. Joanna said the series has been on her list forever.

Session 10 (2 May 2022): Joanna said she watched "The Lord of the Rings" trilogy the night before, 1 May, on Nate's recommendation, and called it awesome. Nate said it is probably the greatest trilogy of all time. He said gaming is his focus and he won his second tournament the week before, a local Street Fighter event. He usually plays CS:GO but was surprised to find he was really good at Street Fighter. Joanna shared a photo of a dairy-free vanilla cake with strawberry filling and coconut cream frosting, and said cooking and baking are her creative outlets.

Session 11 (12 May 2022): Joanna said she went hiking again, found more trails in her town, and called herself an expert hiker now. She shared a photo of Whispering Falls and said the rushing water was soothing and that she could write a whole movie out in places like that. Nate said he gets deep in thought about his life or new recipes when he is out. He suggested they go hiking together sometime, and said he might write a drama himself. Joanna invited him to join her on the trails, and Nate accepted. No date was set.

Session 12 (20 May 2022): Nate shared a photo of Max, a dog he adopted, lying on a couch. He said Max is full of energy and keeping his other pets active. Joanna said she had just finished something, which she called a pretty wild journey. She said allergies mean she does not really want a pet, and that writing and supportive friends get her through tough times. She shared a photo of a notepad with a dog on it and said this is her third script. It is a very personal story about loss, identity, and connection, and writing it was hard. Nate told her to keep going and said she has tons of talent and potential.

Session 13 (25 May 2022): Nate said he took Max for a walk, met a super nice couple with a dog who live close by, and they agreed to do doggy playdates. He said the couple had little in common with him besides loving animals, but that was enough to become good friends. Nate shared a photo of a stuffed animal on a bed and said it is "joy in your pocket" meant to remind Joanna of good vibes. Joanna said she will cherish it. The two discussed how small joys and the tough times of finishing her screenplay make the journey worth it. Joanna said she wants to show Nate the screenplay and values his opinion. Nate said he cannot wait to see it and offered his support.

- Joanna's first screenplay, a drama and romance, was submitted to film festivals in early 2022. No result has been reported.
- Joanna's second screenplay, a self-discovery story about a thirty-year-old woman after a loss, is finished. Her audition for a writing gig on 23 March has no reported result.

- Joanna is allergic to most reptiles, animals with fur, and cockroaches, and cannot have dairy. She has no pets. She has said she would get two turtles if she could. No result has been reported from her trial of Nate's coconut ice cream recipe.
- Joanna is an active hiker. Hiking inspires her writing.
- Joanna watched "The Lord of the Rings" trilogy on 1 May 2022 after Nate recommended a trilogy. The book series Nate recommended in April remains unnamed, and Joanna has not reported on it.
- Nate has pets, including turtles, that he has had for about three years. He adopted Max, a dog he introduced on 20 May 2022. In late May he set up doggy playdates with a nearby couple.
- Nate is a casual gamer who plays for fun. He won his first tournament in January 2022, a Counter-Strike: Global Offensive event. He said his next tournament, around May 2022, would be his fourth. He reported winning a local Street Fighter tournament in late April 2022. The tournament count is not fully consistent across messages. He dyed his hair in early April 2022. He is not really into hiking but is curious about a trail north of where he lives. He prefers fantasy and sci-fi films.
- Nate has not confirmed whether he watched Joanna's January romantic drama recommendation, and he has not reported on "Little Women."
- Neither has set a date to meet in person. Joanna invited Nate to join her on the trails, and he accepted.
- Nate gave Joanna a stuffed animal in late May 2022, which she said she will cherish.

Audrey and Andrew are friends who chat periodically about their love of animals, nature, and the outdoors. Across fourteen sessions, from 27 March 2023 to 4 August 2023, their conversations follow a consistent pattern. Andrew shares his longing to be outdoors and his search for a dog, Audrey shares life with her four dogs, and both trade photos of animals, scenery, food, and outings. Andrew's search for a dog and a pet-friendly home was the running storyline through the spring and early summer. On 11 July 2023 he announced that he had adopted a puppy named Toby, and on 4 August he identified Toby as a German Shepherd. Whether he has found a pet-friendly apartment has never been stated. Several promises remain open, and the two often close conversations warmly without a formal goodbye.

Andrew began the sessions by describing a change in his working life. In the week before 27 March 2023 he had started a new job as a Financial Analyst, a big change from his former job. By July he said work had been piling up and he had been stuck inside, missing the peace and freedom a hike gives him. He lives in the city and has said more than once that being away from nature makes him sad. He describes nature as a home for his soul, where he feels connected and restored. He often says he tries to escape the city at least once a weekend. In the 4 August session he said hiking is the best thing he does outdoors, that reaching the top of a challenging trail makes his worries vanish, and that nature is a break from city life. He also said he wishes he could be outdoors more often, which sits a little uneasily with his earlier mentions of hikes and picnics, though both can be true given how busy his job has been.

Andrew has a girlfriend whom he calls "my girl." The two enjoy discovering new cafes, restaurants, and bakeries, and they share picnics and hikes. In April he said they had found a cafe with excellent pastries, and on 16 April he shared a photo of a bakery display. In May he described a great hike with friends and his girlfriend at a spot they had recently found. On 7 July 2023 he had a picnic with her, which he called amazing. On 27 July he said the two had volunteered at a pet shelter on Monday, 24 July, loved spending time with the animals, and saw volunteering as a way of giving back. On 4 August he said the two of them, with Toby, were going camping that weekend, and he shared a photo of a woman setting up a tent on a rocky hill. That is the only image in the conversations that shows her.

Andrew also has a family dog, separate from Toby, whom he misses, especially the hikes they took together. In the 2 April session he shared a photo of that dog lying on a couch. His favorite animal is the bird, and his favorite bird is the eagle, which he finds strong and graceful. He shared a photo of two eagles flying against a sun and said he is awed by birds' ability to soar and explore new places. He does not go bird-watching on purpose, but he notices birds on hikes, and in late June he enjoyed hearing bird songs on a hike with friends.

Andrew's dog search runs through most of the conversations. In the first session he had no pets but loved animals. By 2 April he was considering a dog but found it challenging to find a dog-friendly place in the city, and Audrey told him about websites with filters that she and her family had used. On 6 May he reported browsing websites, visiting shelters, and asking friends, which he called both fun and annoying. He offered advice to anyone considering a dog: living space and exercise needs both matter, and as someone in an apartment he thought a smaller dog would suit him best. He was contacting landlords and checking neighborhoods near a park or woods. On 2 June he had checked out some places with no luck and felt discouraged but determined. Audrey offered to help if he emailed his criteria, and he thanked her. On 3 July he still could not find a dog-friendly rental, and on 8 July he said a few parks allowed a pup on a leash, but that this was not the same as an open area to run and play.

On 11 July 2023 Andrew announced that he now has a puppy named Toby. He shared a photo of a dog sitting on a leash in a room and said he couldn't resist taking him home, "city living and all." Audrey responded enthusiastically. On 4 August Andrew said Toby is a German Shepherd, which he called smart and loyal, and said he hoped to take Toby hiking. Audrey agreed that German Shepherds are loyal and fond of new journeys, and said she could see him and his pup conquering trails together. Toby's exact age and size have not been given. Andrew has not said whether he has moved into a new pet-friendly place. He mentioned city living, which suggests he is still in the city, but how he found a home that allows a dog is not described. In the 4 August session he said he planned a small hike with Toby at the local trail.

Andrew said he wanted to avoid limiting Toby's growth while also not taking him out too little. That remark is somewhat ambiguous, and the conversation did not clarify it.

Andrew has taken up several new hobbies since the spring. In June he described rock climbing for the first time. The climb encouraged him to consider kayaking and maybe bungee jumping, though neither has been mentioned as something he has actually tried. In July he said cooking had become a new hobby since he could not get out on trails as often. He calls himself a rookie, has been trying new recipes, and is always looking for healthier meal ideas.

On 3 July she said she was taking a dog training course that was challenging but rewarding, and that her dogs were already doing better. The memory covers conversations between Caroline and Melanie from 8 May 2023 through 27 June 2023.

On 8 May 2023 at 1:56 pm, Caroline and Melanie caught up in person. Melanie said she was swamped with her kids and work. Caroline reported that she had attended an LGBTQ support group the previous day, 7 May 2023, and found it very powerful. She said the transgender speakers' stories were especially inspiring, and she felt happy and thankful for the support. She shared a photo of a dog walking past a wall with a painting of a woman. Caroline said she plans to continue her education and explore career options. She is keen on counseling or mental health work because she wants to support people facing similar issues. Caroline then left to do research, and Melanie said she was going swimming with her kids.

Caroline praised her for taking part and raising awareness. Melanie said the event was thought-provoking and that she was realizing self-care is really important. Melanie said she is carving out daily me-time, including running, reading, or playing her violin, which refreshes her and helps her stay present for her family. She called it a work in progress but said she is doing her best. Her kids are excited for summer break, and her family was thinking about going camping in June 2023. She asked Caroline about her summer plans. Caroline replied that she is researching adoption agencies, and that giving a loving home to kids who need one has been a dream of hers for a long time. Melanie called her kind and said her future family would be lucky to have her. Melanie asked what made her pick that agency. Caroline said she chose it because it helps LGBTQ+ people with adoption, and its inclusivity and support spoke to her. Caroline said she is thrilled to build a family for kids who need one, and that it will be tough as a single parent, but she is up for the challenge. Melanie encouraged her, saying she will be an awesome mom. Caroline thanked her and said she will do her best to make sure the kids have a safe and loving home. She said the event made her reflect on how far she has come since she started transitioning three years earlier, in about 2020. Melanie praised her for spreading awareness and told her to keep inspiring people. Caroline said she felt powerful giving the talk, shared the struggles she had faced and how much she has grown since coming out, and was glad the audience related and wanted to be better allies. She said conversations about gender identity and inclusion are necessary and that she is thankful to be able to give a voice to the trans community. Caroline said sharing stories is not always easy but important for understanding and acceptance. She said she has been blessed with love and support and wants to pass it on, and she described the aim of building a strong, supportive community of hope. Melanie said that vulnerable moments are where people bond, and that sharing stories shows people they are not alone. Caroline said she plans to keep using her voice to make a change and lift others up, and she named Melanie as part of that effort. Melanie said she was proud to be part of the difference Caroline is making, and both agreed to keep motivating and helping each other. Caroline said they can tackle life's challenges together.

Melanie then asked Caroline what motivates her. Caroline said her friends, family, and mentors are her rocks, and she shared a photo of a family posing in a yard, taken when they met up the previous week, around early June 2023. Melanie asked how long Caroline has had this support system. Caroline said she has known these friends for four years, since she moved from her home country, and that they have been there through everything, including a tough breakup, and she is very thankful. Caroline asked Melanie who supports her. Melanie said her husband and kids keep her motivated, and she shared a photo of a man and a little girl standing in front of a waterfall. Caroline congratulated her and wished her many happy years. Melanie shared a photo of a man and a woman sitting on a blanket eating food, and said family moments make it all worth it. Caroline asked how the day was, and Melanie said it was fun: they played games, ate good food, and hung out together. Both agreed that cherishing time with loved ones is what makes them feel alive and happy, and Caroline said family is everything.

In Session 4, on 27 June 2023 at 10:37 am, Caroline opened by saying it had been a long time since they talked and that a lot had been happening in her life. She shared a photo of a necklace with a cross and a heart. She said it was a gift from her grandmother in her home country, Sweden, given to her when she was young, and that it stands for love, faith, and strength, serving as a reminder of her roots and of the love and support she gets from her family. Melanie asked whether Caroline had other treasured objects. Melanie said they explored nature, roasted marshmallows around the campfire, and went on a hike, and that the view from the top was amazing. Caroline said she has been looking into counseling and mental health as a career because she wants to help people who have gone through the same things she has. She shared a photo of a bookshelf with many books. Melanie asked what kind of counseling and mental health services she wants to pursue. Caroline said she is still working out the details but is thinking about working with trans people, helping them accept themselves and supporting their mental health. Last Friday, around 23 June 2023, she attended an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop that she found enlightening. It covered different therapeutic methods and how best to work with trans people, and she was moved by how passionate the professionals were about creating a safe space for people like her. Melanie praised her dedication and asked what motivated her to pursue counseling. Caroline said her own journey and the support she received made a huge difference, and that counseling and support groups improved her life, which led her to care more about mental health and understanding herself. She now wants to create a safe, inviting place for people to grow. Melanie said Caroline has gained a great deal from her own experience and is making a big impact, and Caroline thanked her. Melanie congratulated Caroline for going after what she really cares about and shared a photo of a bookshelf filled with books in a room.
